1673.title: Theater of the Absurd
1673.description: Three women in early 20th-century attire and hats sit in red velvet theater seats, observing a surreal landscape. A large glossy purple sphere containing fish and a green bear floats above a grassy field while a white rabbit emerges from a swirling brown vortex in the foreground.

1674.title: Bubble Wonderland Projection
1674.description: Three women in 1920s cloche hats and coats sit in a wooden theater row, gazing at a giant translucent purple bubble floating above a stylized landscape. Inside the bubble is a whimsical miniature world with fish, flowers, a top-hatted figure, and swirling paths, while a brown rabbit and a green frog in a circular frame appear on the right.

1675.title: Surreal Meadow Gathering
1675.description: Three women in early 20th-century attire sit in red theater seats on the left, observing a large translucent maroon sphere floating in a grassy field. Inside the sphere swim turquoise fish and orange butterflies while a brown rabbit emerges from a swirling vortex beside a circular window containing a green cartoon monster.

1677.title: Bubble World Spectators
1677.description: Three women in early 20th-century attire sit in red velvet theater seats, observing a large iridescent soap bubble containing a miniature landscape with fish, plants, and small creatures. To the right, a brown spiral frame holds a realistic rabbit beside a circular porthole displaying a waving green cartoon bear against an orange background.

1676.title: Bubble Fish and Rabbit
1676.description: Three women in 1920s flapper attire sit in red velvet seats watching a giant purple bubble containing colorful fish and aquatic plants. A brown rabbit emerges from a swirling earthy wave beside them, with a green beaver-like creature in a circular emblem in the corner.

1678.title: Surreal Cinema in Meadow
1678.description: Three women in 1920s flapper attire sit in red velvet theater seats placed in a grassy field, watching a large iridescent bubble containing swimming fish. A wooden tunnel-like structure on the right reveals a realistic rabbit looking out, with mountains and a sunset sky in the background.

1679.title: Bubble of Memories
1679.description: Three women in 1920s attire sit on red velvet chairs in a grassy field, gazing at a giant transparent bubble containing swimming goldfish and faint interior scenes. A white rabbit peers from behind a large swirling brown wave-like form on the right, under a pastel sky with a crescent moon.

1680.title: Flappers and Fishbowl
1680.description: Three 1920s flapper women in elegant dresses and cloche hats sit on ornate red chairs in a grassy field, one applying makeup, as a giant transparent sphere filled with colorful swimming fish rests beside them. A large stylized brown rabbit peeks from behind a swirling scroll-like structure under a pastel sunset sky.

1681.title: Surreal 1920s Cinema
1681.description: Three women in 1920s flapper attire sit in red velvet theater seats in a grassy field, watching a giant purple bubble containing a floating castle and two crowned fish. A rabbit peers over a striped hill in the foreground while small fish swim through the grass.

1682.title: Surreal Fantasy Cat Scene
1682.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an orange and white cat with a flaming mane and tail, perched on a red cushion. Swirling orange energy flows toward a large purple bubble containing a fish and a white bird, while a rabbit emerges from a brown swirl, three women in vintage dresses sit on a couch in a grassy field, and a castle floats in the distant sky.

1563.title: Cabbage Bear Vision
1563.description: A vibrant surreal painting centers on a large bear's head constructed entirely from layered green cabbage leaves, featuring bright blue eyes with one glowing red. Floating around it are transparent purple orbs containing more cabbage heads, stylized female faces, geometric diagrams, and celestial motifs against a swirling psychedelic background.

1683.title: Surreal Bear and Bubble
1683.description: A large green bear with a third eye on its forehead emerges from a giant cabbage, with a small rabbit peeking from its leaves. In a grassy field, three women in 1920s flapper dresses sit on a red couch while a large transparent bubble filled with swimming fish floats nearby.

1684.title: Bear Spirit Dream Bubble
1684.description: A large, vibrant green bear with a leafy texture and glowing red third eye sits in a misty meadow, observing a group of people seated inside a large transparent bubble containing swirling patterns and fish. A brown rabbit perches on the bear's back while colorful bubbles and ribbons float across the foreground of this surreal landscape.

1685.title: Kaleidoscopic Meadow Gathering
1685.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant bear's head made of green cabbage leaves with a pink lotus on its forehead, resting on a grassy hill. Four women sit in red armchairs watching a large rabbit formed of swirling brown patterns blow iridescent bubbles containing a golden fish, set against a mountainous sunset landscape.

1686.title: Green Bear and Bubble World
1686.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green bear with a third eye, its head and shoulders composed of leafy textures. The bear blows a transparent bubble containing colorful fish, coral, and aquatic plants, while a brown rabbit observes from the right against a background of floating orbs and swirling rainbow patterns.

1687.title: Triple Goddess and Cosmic Hare
1687.description: A surreal painting depicts three green-haired women in profile with closed eyes and halos, their long flowing hair merging into colorful waves. To the right, a large brown hare sits inside a glowing red orb, surrounded by swimming fish, bubbles, and a swirling brown form against a dreamy pastel background.

1688.title: Rabbit in Cosmic Bubble
1688.description: Four women with long flowing green hair stand in profile on the left side, wearing patterned robes. A large red bubble on the right contains a brown rabbit on a curved path, surrounded by smaller animals, flowers, and floating bubbles against a pastel background.

1689.title: Surreal Hello Portrait
1689.description: A surreal painting features multiple overlapping profiles of a green-skinned woman with flowing green hair that merges into colorful wavy patterns. A large transparent bubble containing fish, aquatic plants and pebbles sits at the center, while a realistic brown rabbit perches on a swirling brown spiral to the right, with the word 'Hello' written in the upper background.

1690.title: Surreal Hello Snail Painting
1690.description: A psychedelic surreal painting featuring four green-haired women in profile with flowing hair that merges into colorful wavy forms. A large snail with a spiral shell and a speech bubble saying "Hello" appears alongside a circular underwater diorama containing fish, plants, and pebbles, all set against a dreamy background with floating orbs.

1691.title: Possible Vortex
1691.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring the word 'Possible.' in ornate dripping gold lettering at the center of a swirling colorful vortex. The composition is surrounded by blooming flowers, grapes, twisting ribbons of color, and a dramatic stormy sky with lightning.

1693.title: Vortex of Abundance
1693.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a dramatic swirling vortex of fiery orange, red, and green brushstrokes that spiral inward toward a central still life. A silver platter holding pink flowers, orange marigolds, green grapes, and red grapes rests within the swirling energy against a dramatic, colorful sky.

1694.title: Tangleleg Amos
1694.description: A vibrant swirling vortex of color featuring clusters of flowers, grapes, and translucent rings against dynamic brushstrokes. The lower right corner displays the red dripping text 'Tangleleg Amos'.

1695.title: Vibrant Swirling Vortex
1695.description: A surreal painting featuring a dynamic spiral vortex of fiery orange, red, and teal waves flowing across the canvas. Colorful flower clusters with dahlias, grapes, and leaves emerge from the swirling patterns beneath a stormy sky, while a multicolored geometric orb floats in the upper right above the dripping text 'CRUNK'.

1696.title: Yello Next Thursday
1696.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a swirling vortex of rainbow colors and fiery red-orange flames merging with a dense floral arrangement of pink peonies, orange poppies, grapes and green leaves. A translucent white rectangular overlay in the upper right contains dripping yellow text reading 'Yello//Next Thursday'.

1697.title: Yellow Next Thursday
1697.description: A surreal painted artwork features a dark twisted tree with a large yellow eye and beak resembling a bird, intertwined with colorful flowers, red and green grapes, and vibrant dripping paint. The background shows concentric glowing circles in blue and purple with a yellow sun or moon, while bright paint drips cascade downward from the central composition.

1698.title: Surreal Bird and Still Life
1698.description: A dark, gnarled tree branch shaped like a bird with a large human-like eye for a head perches over a silver bowl overflowing with vibrant flowers and grapes. The background features a stormy purple sky with lightning, a glowing full moon, and colorful abstract swirling patterns with dripping effects.

1699.title: Chicken Shit Surreal Painting
1699.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a twisted tree with a large yellow eye and beak resembling a bird, growing from a metal bowl filled with pink peonies, orange flowers, and clusters of red and green grapes. The scene includes dripping pink and purple rings, a blue sign with the text 'Chicken Shit' in colorful graffiti lettering, set against a dramatic night sky with a full moon and swirling clouds.

1700.title: Totally Tubular
1700.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a gnarled, bird-like tree creature with an orange eye standing on a green hill under a starry night sky with a full moon. In the foreground, a lush bouquet of flowers, grapes, and dripping paint is surrounded by colorful 3D geometric loops and graffiti text reading 'Totally!' and 'Tubular!'.

1701.title: Tangleleg Amoeba Highway
1701.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a swirling, psychedelic highway twisting into colorful infinity symbols above a foggy landscape with silhouetted figures and trees. In the background stands a glowing city skyline beneath a dramatic pink, orange and yellow sunset sky.

1702.title: Surreal Psychedelic Landscape
1702.description: A vibrant, dripping surreal painting featuring a large bird-like tree creature with a prominent yellow eye under a full moon. The composition includes floating landscape panels with swirling patterns, a city skyline, a 'Chicken Shi' sign, and the text 'TOTALLY! WACKY STUFF', all rendered in a melting, colorful style with visible paint drips.

1703.title: Surreal Chicken Shit Dreamscape
1703.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring a large twisted tree with a single yellow eye and beak, set against a full moon. Overlaid are two posters, one displaying a swirling colorful landscape with the text 'TOTALLY!' and 'IMAGINATION UNLIMITED', the other showing 'Chicken Shit' in dripping rainbow letters.

1704.title: Psychedelic Spell Collage
1704.description: A vibrant surreal collage featuring a green dog labeled Spell 3, a multi-eyed creature, a hissing snake labeled Spell 2, a colorful-haired woman with swirling patterns, a full moon, and a twisted tree with a large eye. The composition includes floating images of cityscapes, sunsets, and the text 'Next Thursday' against a dreamy, painted sky background.

1705.title: Neon Serpent Oracle
1705.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman with long pink hair and traditional East Asian attire standing beside a giant cracked red eye containing a dystopian highway cityscape. A large green snake with dripping venom emerges from swirling smoke above while a stylized green dog with its tongue out appears in the lower right, all set against a colorful apocalyptic sky.

1706.title: Surreal Eye Serpent City
1706.description: A massive cracked red eye dominates a dystopian cityscape with a winding highway filled with cars. A green snake coils around the eye while dripping red and green liquid, surrounded by glowing abstract shapes and neon green wolf-like creatures under a stormy orange sky.

1707.title: Cosmic Surreal Vision
1707.description: A surreal painting featuring a large cracked moon with a human-like face, a green alien figure, a black cat leaping over a swirling blue and yellow vortex, and a glowing green skull with pink eyes. The scene is populated with colorful patterned pottery, bare trees, and set against a starry cosmic background transitioning from deep blue to pink.

1708.title: Surreal Industrial Eye
1708.description: A surreal painting featuring a giant stylized eye with a purple iris and industrial smokestacks reflected in its pupil, set against a swirling purple and red vortex sky. In the foreground, two bright red horses stand in a green pasture behind a red fence, with a partial green-tinted face visible in the bottom left corner and black smoke rising from factory structures on the right.

1709.title: Cosmic Lily Ghost
1709.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant glowing purple lily with a green stem rising from a colorful swirling platform on a cosmic lake. A translucent purple ghost with blue eyes floats beside the flower while floating lips, stars, and a small rocky island with trees appear in the vibrant night sky.

1710.title: Smiling Purple Bloom
1710.description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a large purple flower with starry lips and a glowing yellow center growing from a rocky island with pine trees. A smiling purple ghost floats within a colorful swirling portal above two whimsical patterned teacups in the foreground, set against a cosmic sunset sky over calm water.

1711.title: Surreal Melting Landscape
1711.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a cracked road leading through a desert landscape where large green spheres containing miniature waterfalls are melting into blue liquid. In the sky, a long purple and yellow serpentine dragon with yellow eyes coils near a massive red sun above mountains and a cascading waterfall.

1712.title: Melting Penguins Surreal Scene
1712.description: A surreal desert landscape features a large melting blue penguin with yellow eyes standing in a reflective green puddle on a cracked road. Smaller penguins and green spheres dot the foreground while a massive red sun sets behind mountains, a waterfall, and purple multi-eyed serpentine creatures floating in the sky.

1713.title: Psychedelic Turtle Highway
1713.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large glowing green sea turtle with a cosmic eye pattern on its shell, floating above a motion-blurred highway at sunset. The massive cracked turquoise eyeball in the sky drips magenta and teal paint over a retro-futuristic cityscape with palm trees, neon signs, and a transparent overlay of playful penguins.

1714.title: Yello Bingo
1714.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features two horses on a rolling green hillside with a wooden fence. A massive, glowing tree-like formation of green, blue, and rainbow bubbles rises toward a colorful, starry sky with aurora-like swirls.

1715.title: Yello Bingo Surreal Pasture
1715.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a brown horse by a decorative fence and a purple horse running through a green field dotted with yellow flowers. Above, a swirling pink and blue sky opens into a glowing green portal where three stylized purple penguins float among translucent bubbles, with two more penguins and the text "YELLO BINGO" visible below.

1716.title: Malice Cosmic Cat
1716.description: A black tabby cat with glowing pink eyes sits prominently in the center of a swirling cosmic galaxy featuring vibrant blues, yellows, and purples. The central scene is framed by thick, colorful swirling brushstrokes in green, red, and orange, with the word 'Malice' displayed in large purple letters at the top right and a small black cat silhouette at the bottom right.

1717.title: Malice Cosmic Portrait
1717.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green celestial orb with a detailed human eye and eyebrow on the left, radiating purple spikes and golden sparkles. A circular portal reveals a fluffy green creature with a pink mustache and tongue sticking out, while a curly-haired youth gazes upward from the bottom right against a swirling cosmic background with pink flowers and stars. The word 'Malice' appears in dripping white letters at the bottom.

1718.title: Tabby the Blue Monkey
1718.description: A surreal desert scene featuring a large blue monkey-like creature with glowing pink eyes and a stitched mouth, a snake coiled around its neck. Multiple small black cats are scattered across the reddish desert ground in front of a large sandstone butte, under a swirling purple and white vortex in the sky.

1719.title: Yello Bingo Collage
1719.description: A layered collage of multiple illustrated artworks featuring a grinning blue monkey with pink eyes, a colorful scaled snake, black cat silhouettes in various poses, horses in a pastoral landscape, and a swirling purple vortex labeled 'Tabby'.

1720.title: Tavern Circa 2026
1720.description: A surreal desert landscape features a giant blue monkey-like creature with glowing pink eyes holding a key, its long serpentine tail ending in a snake head. In the foreground, several black cats of various poses stand on the reddish ground while a massive swirling purple and gold vortex dominates the sky above red rock buttes.

1721.title: Time to Think
1721.description: A surreal night scene on a cracked city street features a large glowing green smiley-face spider with intricate glowing patterns and multiple eyes. A massive realistic green human eye emerges from the pavement while a swirling cosmic portal with smiley faces and stars dominates the psychedelic sky.

1722.title: The All-Seeing Eye
1722.description: A surreal painting of a massive ornate eye dominating the ceiling of a vintage theater or lecture hall. The iris contains a cosmic green orb, a flaming torch, and a glowing blue flame emerging from ornate golden scrollwork, while an audience sits below facing a large sign reading 'THE NEXT THING'.

1723.title: Tavern Circa 2026
1723.description: A surreal collage of overlapping fantasy and cosmic artworks arranged on a dark, fiery red and black background. Visible elements include a large central human eye with a colorful cosmic iris, a glowing green spider with a smiley face, multiple smaller eyes, a swirling purple galaxy, a crowded tavern scene, sailing ships, and text elements reading 'Tavern Circa 2026', 'Which is', 'Time to Think', and 'Goblins & Ghouls'.

1724.title: Angels and Demons Tavern
1724.description: A complex surreal collage combines multiple painted scenes: a large central eye with fiery interior, a glowing green smiley-face spider in a dark city, swirling purple vortex, and an ornate hall filled with a crowd of people under green lamps. Text overlays include 'Time to Think' and 'Tavern Circa 2026'.

1725.title: Surreal Eye Vortex
1725.description: A highly detailed surreal collage featuring a large ornate human eye with a flaming inner iris containing a green planet-like orb, two red squirrels perched on its upper eyelid, a glowing green smiley-faced orb with spider-like legs and wings, a massive purple swirling vortex in the sky, and a cracked street scene with another green eye embedded in the ground.

1727.title: Tavern Circa 2026
1727.description: A surreal collage-style artwork featuring a large cosmic swirling vortex in purple and blue, a giant green smiley-face spider with multiple eyes, floating eyeballs, and a detailed Victorian-style room interior with an enormous ornate eye mural on the wall containing a smaller scene. Text overlays include 'Angels and Demons', 'Change Time to Think', and event information for 'Tavern Circa 2026'.

1728.title: Angels and Demons Collage
1728.description: A surreal mixed-media collage combining multiple distinct artworks including a swirling purple vortex over a stone tavern, an orange cartoon cat with antlers, a detailed realistic eye containing a cosmic scene, a spider with a smiley face, and various text overlays like 'Angels and Demons', 'Tavern', and timestamps.

1729.title: Bear and Pink Moon
1729.description: A surreal painted scene shows a giant brown bear with a cosmic, melting right half featuring stars, a planet, and a rocket, its tongue extending toward a pink moon-like sphere with a surprised face floating in a forest puddle. In the background, a glowing sunset meets an aurora-filled night sky over a city skyline with UFOs and helicopters.

1730.title: Psychedelic Skyline Dream
1730.description: A surreal composite scene featuring a large woman's face merged with a cosmic bear, a glowing bioluminescent mushroom floating above, and a surprised pink creature emerging from a pond containing a spinning wheel. The background shows a city skyline with aurora borealis under a pink-purple twilight sky.

1731.title: Surreal Dreamscape
1731.description: A surreal painted landscape depicts a split-face portrait of a blonde woman merging with a colorful psychedelic bear against a night sky with aurora borealis. In the foreground, a pink cartoon creature with large eyes sits beside a circular target-like pond while a glowing blue portal floats in the sky above a city skyline.

1732.title: Cosmic Mushroom Muse
1732.description: A surreal painting of a large mushroom with a woman's face and golden curly hair emerging from its cap. The mushroom cap displays a vibrant galaxy and spiral nebula, while its stem features a colorful stained-glass pattern, set against a swirling blue cosmic background with vines and grass.

1733.title: Fairy Mushroom Enlightenment
1733.description: A surreal nighttime scene shows a woman with curly blonde hair sitting inside an oversized purple mushroom, holding a glowing lightbulb surrounded by swirling blue energy. Numerous colorful fairies with translucent wings fly above and around her against a starry purple sky, with heart-shaped vines and stained-glass-like circular patterns framing the composition.

1734.title: The Angel Sighs
1734.description: A blonde fairy with iridescent wings sits atop a giant purple mushroom, leaning over a glowing blue orb containing a lit lightbulb. Numerous other fairies fly across a starry purple night sky while heart-shaped lanterns hang from vines against a grassy field.

1735.title: The Angel Sight
1735.description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a large purple mushroom with a glowing blue brain-like orb containing a lit lightbulb at its center. A golden-haired angel with colorful wings leans over the orb while numerous other fairies fly across a starry purple night sky above a green grassy field.

1736.title: Fairy Angel Light
1736.description: A surreal fantasy scene centered on a large purple mushroom with a glowing blue core, where a blonde fairy with butterfly wings reaches toward a small angel-like figure. The composition is framed by decorative stained-glass style borders containing a golden snake, ornate crowns, a purple monster, a colorful mandala, and a desert landscape with twin moons.

1737.title: Surreal Dreamscape Collage
1737.description: A vibrant surreal collage features a central fairy with golden wings and a crown touching a glowing blue orb on a large purple mushroom. Surrounding elements include a hissing cobra in smoky swirls, a jeweled crown floating in the sky, a purple spiky monster, a colorful mandala, and a striped desert landscape under a starry night with a swirling galaxy above.

1738.title: The Angel Sight
1738.description: A blonde fairy with iridescent wings leans over a glowing child-like figure holding a lantern, both nestled inside the cap of a giant purple mushroom. The night sky is filled with numerous flying fairies, heart-shaped vines, and colorful stained-glass patterns framing the scene.

1739.title: The Angel Sight
1739.description: A vibrant fantasy painting depicts a large glowing mushroom with two blonde fairies on its cap, one holding a bright lantern. Ethereal fairies with colorful wings fly through a starry purple night sky above an autumnal forest and pond, surrounded by swirling purple smoke and floating lanterns.

1740.title: Vision of Yesteryear
1740.description: A glowing lightbulb with a tiny figure inside sits atop a large purple mushroom while a blonde fairy reaches toward it. The night sky is filled with many colorful fairies flying among swirling light trails and heart-shaped leaves.

1741.title: Vision of Winteryear
1741.description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene framed by stained glass borders, featuring a fairy-like girl with butterfly wings standing atop a giant purple mushroom holding a glowing blue orb labeled 'Vision Of Winteryear'.

1742.title: Dragon and Warrior in Autumn
1742.description: A woman in a blue and orange plaid cloak stands with a sword facing a large golden dragon with purple smoke emanating from its mouth and nostrils. The scene is set in a grassy autumn landscape with orange trees, a blue pond, and floating colorful geometric shapes in the sky.

1743.title: Surreal Family Dreamscape
1743.description: A surreal scene depicts an elderly couple seated on a yellow sofa reading a newspaper while two children play with blocks on a purple rug. To the right, a woman in a striped skirt stands at the edge of a cloud platform gazing at a sunset horizon, as a large black dragon, floating bubbles with roses, colorful serpents, and golden fish swim through the fantastical sky above.

1744.title: Cosmic Eye of Eternity
1744.description: A surreal painting of a giant cracked eye dominating a fantastical landscape. The iris contains a swirling galaxy with planets and the number 33, while a green-skinned woman's face emerges from the right with flowing colorful hair against a pink and purple sky.

1745.title: Psychedelic Nightmare Vortex
1745.description: A surreal night scene over a gothic city features a large green zombie-like head with glowing orange eyes emerging from a swirling, dripping rainbow vortex with tentacles. In the foreground, a bright green dog with a 'DESIRE' collar looks upward while a hooded figure and a flowing purple-haired silhouette stand on a rooftop under a glowing spiral moon.

1770.title: Cosmic Fury
1770.description: A purple-skinned woman with flowing red hair screams in rage with hands outstretched, set against a large glowing turquoise planet with rings and nebula patterns. A chaotic crowd of terrified faces, swords, daggers, and demonic figures swirl around her in a cosmic storm.

986.title: Mosaic Woman with Horse
986.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face and neck composed of black-and-white photorealistic fragments interspersed with colorful geometric mosaic tiles in yellow, green, pink and blue. An orange horse gallops across the composition from right to left, surrounded by flowing black hair, pink flowers, and a stylized green landscape background with swirling patterns.

1771.title: Surreal Autumn Dreamscape
1771.description: A surreal collage-style painting featuring a large woman's face in the foreground adorned with pink roses, orange flowers, and film strip motifs in her hair. An orange horse gallops along a winding path of torn paper or film toward a second floating female face in the background, surrounded by autumn trees, falling leaves, and small winged angel figures.

1421.title: Psychedelic Bubble Women
1421.description: A vibrant, colorful painting featuring multiple overlapping female profiles with closed eyes and elaborate, flowing hair. The women are rendered in bright neon hues of green, pink, purple, and yellow, surrounded by large translucent bubbles and dripping paint effects.

1772.title: Surreal Green Eye Vision
1772.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a large green face in profile, dominated by a detailed eye whose iris contains a blue Earth, trees and roots. Hares leap across the cheek while two circular portraits of women with colorful hair and laurel wreaths float to the right beside a sun and moon face.

773.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Smile
773.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant green and yellow smiley face winking in a swirling cosmic sky filled with colorful rings, orbiting figures, and flaming celestial bodies. Below, a cracked barren landscape holds a large metallic sphere containing two fiery cat-like creatures connected by wires and machinery.

1773.title: Grinning Cosmic Monarch
1773.description: A giant teal sphere with a glowing yellow smile, diamond-encrusted teeth, one large green eye and a winking orange eye wears an ornate golden crown. Below it, a fiery orange cat-like demon and a purple spiky demon hold hands on a cracked, molten surface while fairies and insects orbit against a cosmic purple backdrop.

1774.title: Angel Demon Over Vault
1774.description: A split being with one white feathered angelic wing and one red demonic bat wing stands amid post-apocalyptic ruins. The half-angel half-demon warrior holds a flaming sword before a shattered concrete bunker marked with radiation symbols and the text 'WARNING - VAULT 31'.

744.title: Surreal Eye Monster Scene
744.description: A surreal psychedelic painting features a giant bloodshot eye with a green spiral iris and black silhouette pupil, dripping black liquid from its base. A blue creature with yellow eyes and orange collar stands in shock, surrounded by screaming flame-like flowers with faces, against a cracked green orb and patterned background with multiple faces.

1775.title: The All-Seeing Eye
1775.description: A surreal painting featuring a giant bloodshot eyeball with a screaming black silhouette in its green iris, black veins dripping downward. A blue angelic figure with orange eyes and symbolic tattoos holds a scroll while a shattered circular portal reveals small dark creatures against a chaotic background of grotesque faces and flaming demonic flowers.

1479.title: Ballerina Crown Lift
1479.description: Two ballerinas in ornate green and gold costumes perform an acrobatic lift against a vibrant swirling background. The upper dancer balances horizontally while wearing an oversized golden crown, supported by the lower dancer in a green leotard with matching yellow face paint.

1776.title: Winged Acrobat with Crown
1776.description: A dramatic painting shows a woman in a green leotard lifting another woman in a purple leotard who wears an elaborate dripping crown. The lifted acrobat holds a flaming sword in a horizontal pose with large white feathered wings extending from her back.

1777.title: Angel and Demon at Vault 31
1777.description: A towering white angel with glowing halo and large feathered wings stands beside a dark armored demon with red bat-like wings, both positioned at an open metal gate set into a massive concrete wall. The foreground is littered with broken electronics, papers, and debris while the dramatic sky contains multiple flying demonic creatures.

764.title: Cosmic Tree of Visions
764.description: A surreal painting depicts three stylized women's profiles in green, purple, and pink facing right, adorned with intricate patterns and orb headdresses. Behind them a gnarled tree with hanging dreamcatchers stands before a radiant mountain emitting a burst of light, all under a stormy sky with lightning and floating cosmic orbs.

1778.title: Cosmic Tree of Visions
1778.description: Three green-skinned witches with elaborate golden crowns and headdresses stand in the foreground holding staffs and pointing toward a massive twisted black tree. The tree bears glowing orbs containing symbols and dripping liquid while a yellow lightning-struck mountain and silhouetted figures appear in the background under a turbulent green sky filled with lightning.

1779.title: Angel and Demon Banner
1779.description: An armored angel with golden wings and halo stands beside a horned demon with spiked black wings, jointly holding a large burning banner that reads 'ART OF WAR: ANGELS & DEMONS - ATTACK, DEFEND, RETREAT'.

734.title: Psychedelic Desert Goddesses
734.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring three metallic female figures in profile with flowing, colorful hair and body patterns. They stand beside a winding cracked road leading through an orange desert landscape under a large red sun with swirling colorful patterns filling the sky.

1780.title: Cosmic Frog Apocalypse
1780.description: A surreal desert landscape features three robed female figures with angelic wings, a glowing blue halo, and demonic horns standing on cracked earth. Above them floats a large glowing green frog with a purple third eye, set against a vibrant cosmic sky with a massive red sun and a dark gothic castle.

1781.title: Cosmic Banshee Rage
1781.description: A dramatic close-up portrait of a furious female figure with wild red hair flowing into a swirling cosmic galaxy pattern containing stars and nebulae. Her face shows intense anger with wide white eyes, open screaming mouth, and crack-like markings on her skin, surrounded by floating feathers, bats, and terrified background characters.

1782.title: Crowned Neon Smile
1782.description: A surreal scene featuring a giant glowing neon smiley face with a flaming crown hovering in a starry purple sky above a cracked barren landscape. In the foreground, a fiery orange cat-like demon and a purple winged cat-like creature with a shield emerge from a glowing cracked dome.

1783.title: Surreal Psychedelic Vision
1783.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green face in profile whose eye contains a miniature Earth, ferns, and pink flowers. Two brown hares leap from the eye while a celestial sun and moon hover above, and two horned female figures float inside dripping translucent bubbles on the right.

1784.title: Surreal Film Horse Muse
1784.description: A vibrant surreal collage features a woman's face composed of colorful mosaic tiles with one spiral eye, integrated with film strip borders, winged elements, and pink flowers in her flowing black hair. Below, a fiery orange horse with black patterned saddle gallops along a winding path through an autumnal landscape of orange-leafed trees.

540.title: Cosmic Antlered Wanderer
540.description: A silhouetted antlered figure holding a lantern stands at the center of a glowing, swirling path that leads toward a towering dark spire. Above, a vibrant cosmic vortex swirls with planets, stars, and fiery red-orange nebulae framed by green aurora borealis, while barren trees and foliage flank the psychedelic landscape.

1785.title: Cosmic Spider Cauldron Ritual
1785.description: A vibrant surreal night scene shows four women in colorful patterned dresses gathered around a glowing blue cauldron emitting bubbles and light. A giant mechanical spider with a mandala-like cosmic orb on its back looms over a futuristic city, while a silhouetted antlered figure holding a lantern stands on a glowing path to the right.

937.title: Green Goddess and Death
937.description: A surreal painting shows four identical green-skinned women in profile with closed eyes and elaborate braided hair adorned with leaves and berries, glowing with yellow light against a purple background filled with concentric circles. To their right stand a group of five black skeletal figures with red glowing eyes and red liquid dripping from their forms.

1786.title: Monkey and Moon Goddesses
1786.description: A surreal scene depicts a golden monkey on a barren white tree offering a glowing pink orb to three stacked green-haired women glowing with yellow auras, set against a cracked pink ground with a swirling vortex. A large anthropomorphic moon face with spiral eyes looms in a purple sky, while skeletal figures with red eyes stand to the right and fireflies dot the branches.

1787.title: Moonlit Duality
1787.description: A surreal painting featuring a large anthropomorphic moon with a serene face and one glowing green eye, set against a swirling pink and purple sky filled with concentric glowing circles. On the left, four identical green-skinned female figures with braided hair and glowing spiral patterns stand in profile, while on the right, three black skeletons with glowing red eyes and blood-like drips emerge from a bare, blood-dripping tree branch.

270.title: Eclipse and Shattered Muse
270.description: A surreal painting depicts a black silhouette of a seated figure in a hat observing a cracked classical bust of a woman with golden hair. A large solar eclipse with a red corona dominates the sky while a vibrant green snake coils through blue foliage in the foreground.

1.title: Lunar Face with Crows
1.description: A surreal painting features a large grey moon with a human-like female face and wide eyes at the center. Two bare white trees frame the scene, one holding a black crow on the left and the other a grey bird on the right, while vibrant red and purple cosmic energy bursts from the moon against a starry green and pink background.

3.title: Cosmic Frog and Moon
3.description: A surreal painting features a gray anthropomorphic moon with a feminine face at center, exploding with vibrant purple, pink, and green cosmic energy. A green frog rests on a large cabbage leaf to the right, framed by bare white branches against a swirling green and pink nebula background with floating orbs.

2.title: Frog and Moon Cabbage
2.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a green frog sitting atop a large cabbage at the center. Above it, a grey anthropomorphic moon with multiple eyes and craters emits a rainbow beam, surrounded by colorful paint splashes and starburst effects against a pink and green swirling background.

5.title: Cosmic Dragon Magic
5.description: A vibrant purple dragon with glowing scales and orange eyes breathes a swirling rainbow of magical energy across a starry cosmic background. The dragon is surrounded by floating orbs, comets, and explosive bursts of pink, green, and purple light.

4.title: Celestial Moon and Frog
4.description: A surreal painting featuring a large anthropomorphic moon with closed eyes and cratered texture at the center, emitting vibrant pink, purple and red energy bursts against a green and pink gradient background. Bare tree branches frame the scene with large green cabbages, a realistic green frog perched on one, and several smaller orbiting celestial orbs containing miniature scenes.

6.title: Storm Sorceress
6.description: A green-skinned elf-like woman with pointed ears sits in the center of a chaotic magical storm. She smiles while casting vibrant, dripping spells as lightning cracks across a purple sky and colorful paint-like magic flows from her hands.

7.title: Storm Witch with Crystals
7.description: A green-skinned female figure with long dark hair, pointed ears, and glowing red eyes sits upon a large cluster of purple crystals. She raises one hand toward a bright blue lightning bolt while colorful paint drips down her body and clothing against a dramatic stormy sky.

9.title: Rat in Cosmic Vortex
9.description: A surreal portrait of a blonde woman's head merging with a purple rat at the center of glowing concentric rings. Rain falls from above against a vibrant cosmic watercolor background with floating crystals.

8.title: Chaos Sorceress
8.description: A green-skinned elf-like sorceress with glowing eyes stands centered, arms raised as she channels blue lightning and multicolored dripping paint or magic from her hands. She wears a dark hooded robe covered in vibrant, melting paint drips against a dramatic purple sky filled with swirling clouds, rain, and lightning.

10.title: Mouse in Cosmic Vortex
10.description: A surreal painting shows a blonde woman with flowing golden hair smiling as her head emerges from swirling concentric rings of red, orange and purple. A colorful purple and orange mouse stands on a glowing orb at the vortex center while pink petals fall from above.

11.title: Rat and Woman Vortex
11.description: A surreal portrait of a blonde woman whose hair merges into a purple rat, both emerging from a swirling red and orange vortex. Purple petals and glowing particles fall around them against a dark green background.

12.title: Frog Mage in Cabbage Storm
12.description: A blue-skinned elf-like girl with green hair and a frog on her hat stands amid giant green cabbages during a thunderstorm. She holds crackling blue lightning magic in her hands while a large frog wearing a military helmet and holding a glowing sword sits in a cabbage leaf beside her.

13.title: Psychedelic Serpent Bird
13.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring two intertwined mythical creatures with long green scaled necks, one with a magenta eye and the other with a large orange and blue patterned eye and red beak. The composition is surrounded by swirling magenta energy, purple flowers, geometric shapes, and colorful splatters against a light background with rain-like streaks.

14.title: Psychedelic Hot Air Balloon
14.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large purple hot air balloon covered in dripping graffiti and colorful geometric patterns, floating against a purple and pink background with floating crystal shapes and numerous shiny spheres connected by abstract turquoise forms.

15.title: Surreal Lecture Hall Vision
15.description: Three women in 1940s attire sit in the foreground intently reading a book while a large psychedelic hot air balloon with dripping concentric rings and glowing orbs hovers above the audience. The surreal scene includes UFOs, floating diamonds, and green crystal-like shapes against a hazy auditorium backdrop filled with silhouetted figures.

16.title: Surreal Caterpillar Landscape
16.description: A large segmented caterpillar creature with a round face and big eyes floats in a psychedelic alien sky, dripping colorful goo from above while raining over a barren cracked ground filled with small UFOs, skeletal forms, and gem-like crystals.

18.title: Cosmic Eye Dreamscape
18.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant stylized eye with a black cat-like pupil at the center of a swirling purple and yellow vortex in space. In the foreground, a purple table holds a steaming teacup and a spiral pastry, while an orange armchair with a silhouetted figure sits nearby, surrounded by floating transparent bubbles containing yellow question marks against a starry nebula background.

17.title: Cosmic Octopus Family
17.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large purple octopus-like alien with glowing white eyes holding a luminous green orb while embracing a smaller purple figure. They float within a swirling cosmic vortex surrounded by smaller colorful alien beings, fiery red-orange energy trails, transparent bubbles containing green forms, and white lightning-like energy against a dark starry background.

19.title: Psychedelic Monkey Mandala
19.description: A vibrant turquoise monkey head with glowing pink eyes and stitched mouth is centered in a layered circular mandala of concentric rings in orange, purple, pink and yellow. The composition is set against a cracked greenish background with colorful stylized flowers, leaves, black paint drips and splatters.

20.title: Psychedelic Monkey Portrait
20.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a turquoise monkey with glowing pink eyes and a stitched mouth, centered against a cracked green background. Concentric rainbow circles, dripping black paint, colorful flowers, and fiery elements surround the figure in an overhead projector art style.
20.medium: digital painting with overhead projector texture

21.title: Psychedelic Monkey Oracle
21.description: A vibrant turquoise monkey head with glowing pink eyes and a stitched grin emerges from a cracked, greenish surface. An elaborate headdress of concentric rainbow circles, leaves, and dripping black ink floats above it, surrounded by glowing pink and purple lotus-like flowers.

22.title: Cyan Monkey Oracle
22.description: A stylized turquoise monkey head with glowing pink eyes and stitched mouth is centered in the composition. It is surrounded by concentric colorful rings, vibrant flowers, and leaves against a cracked, textured green background with black drips and splatters.

23.title: Cosmic Eye Oracle
23.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face adorned with a vibrant floral crown of orange, teal, and purple flowers. A large stylized eyeball with a white bird-like beak extends from her right eye socket, set against a cosmic background of swirling nebulae and geometric symbols.

24.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Eye Portrait
24.description: A surreal painting of a woman's face with closed eyes, adorned with red flowers and intricate black patterns. A large stylized all-seeing eye with a vibrant iris dominates the right side, surrounded by geometric shapes, concentric circles, and floating eye orbs against a swirling cosmic nebula background.

25.title: Ethereal Dragon Infinity
25.description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene featuring a large, ornate dragon with tree-like antlers and glowing yellow eyes, its body coiled into an infinity loop. A red-cloaked figure stands on its back as the dragon soars through a colorful night sky filled with hot air balloons, a castle on clouds, and two large moons.

26.title: Eternal Dragon and Wizard
26.description: A majestic purple dragon with an orange eye forms an infinity loop, its body entwined with a large gnarled tree under a starry night sky. A red-cloaked wizard sits atop the dragon while a glowing castle floats among clouds, with jellyfish-like lanterns and celestial bodies floating above.

27.title: Cosmic Serpent and Wizard
27.description: A majestic bird-headed serpent with glowing eyes and antlers coils through a fantastical dreamscape, its body covered in iridescent scales. A red-robed wizard stands on its back holding a glowing orb, surrounded by floating castles, colorful hot air balloons, and a starry sky with multiple moons.

28.title: Purple Ooze Creature Pond
28.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large smiling purple ooze creature with star-shaped eyes and a palm tree on its head, standing in a pond surrounded by lily pads, cattails, and smaller similar creatures floating around it. Purple smoke rises from the water as the background features swirling colorful patterns in the sky and lush green reeds.

29.title: Cosmic Veil Portrait
29.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face split between a floral-decorated left side with tears and a vibrant cosmic nebula right side containing a large eye. Glowing green orbs with flowers and insects float around her against a swirling orange, pink, and purple vortex background.

30.title: Cosmic Eye of Sorrow
30.description: A surreal close-up of a giant purple human eye with a cosmic nebula iris and a small planet at its center. The left side of the eye blends into the face of a woman with closed eyes, floral headdress, and tears, set against a vibrant swirling space nebula with floating green orbs.

31.title: Cosmic Eye Portrait
31.description: A surreal painting of a giant cracked eyeball with a woman's face, adorned with a floral headscarf and black poppies. The eye floats in a vibrant cosmic nebula background with glowing green orbs containing miniature scenes.

32.title: Cosmic Eye Portrait
32.description: A surreal portrait of a young woman with a tear-streaked face wearing a floral headscarf, her head replaced by a giant cosmic eye containing a smaller face within its iris. The background is a swirling vortex of stars, meteors, and colorful nebulae, with glowing green orbs connected by a translucent tube floating around her.

33.title: Weeping Cosmic Eye
33.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with cracked porcelain-like skin, wearing an ornate floral headdress. Her face is dominated by a single enormous green and blue eye from which smaller green bubbles containing miniature sad eyes emerge and float away.

34.title: Sorcerer, the Lamp
34.description: A surreal night scene featuring two massive, gnarled trees with wooden platforms and ladders built into their trunks, set against a starry sky with crescent moons, comets, and colorful nebulae. Oversized wilting flowers with dripping textures and glowing neon swirls in purple, orange, and cyan fill the foreground and entwine the structures.

35.title: Surreal Floral Towers
35.description: A surreal night landscape features towering metal frameworks overgrown with large wilting flowers and twisting vines under a starry sky. Swirling orange and purple energy streams weave between the structures while smaller bioluminescent flowers drip teal liquid in the foreground.

37.title: Eldritch Eye Vortex
37.description: A surreal painting of a large ornate golden eye with a vertical slit pupil at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. Mechanical tentacles tipped with smaller red eyes extend from the central eye, dripping blue liquid, while the background spirals with vibrant rainbow colors and floating symbols.

38.title: Mechanical Eye Spider
38.description: A surreal mechanical spider-like creature with a large central yellow eye floats at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. Its brass and metallic body features multiple glowing eyes, segmented pipe-like legs, and colorful dripping paint effects against a vibrant, psychedelic background.

36.title: Surreal Moonlit Spires
36.description: A surreal night scene featuring skeletal industrial towers intertwined with vibrant, dripping spiral rings in orange, teal, and purple. Fantastical flowering plants with moon and star motifs grow among the structures against a dark starry sky filled with crescent moons and clouds.

39.title: Eldritch Eye Horror
39.description: A surreal mechanical spider-like creature with a large central yellow eye and jagged teeth floats at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. The creature has multiple glowing mechanical tentacles dripping with colorful liquid against a dramatic red, purple and blue background.

41.title: Woman with Snake and Dog
41.description: A surreal painted portrait of a woman with a large black segmented snake coiled in her outstretched hand and a bright green dog-like creature with a human-like eye emerging from her right shoulder.

40.title: Stasis Portrait with Dog and Worm
40.description: A surreal portrait of a blue-headed woman with a neutral expression, her torso covered in vibrant pink and green patterns. She holds a long segmented worm in her hand while a green spotted dog labeled "STASIS" rests on her shoulder against a swirling blue background.

42.title: Man with Green Dog and Millipede
42.description: A surreal painted portrait of a bald man with wide eyes, shown in profile looking right. A bright green dog-like creature with pink spots rests on his left shoulder while he holds a large black and white striped millipede in his open right hand.

43.title: Woman with Millipede and Dog
43.description: A stylized portrait shows a woman in profile with a large pink eye, holding a black and white striped millipede in her outstretched hand. A green dog-like creature with a collar rests its head on her shoulder against a swirling cosmic blue background.

44.title: Millipede and Green Dog
44.description: A stylized portrait of a person in a blue head covering holding a large black millipede in their outstretched hand while a lime green dog rests its head on their shoulder. The person's arm features vibrant swirling patterns against a textured blue background.

45.title: Man with Centipede and Dog
45.description: A stylized portrait of a bald person with pink skin covered in spiral patterns, one large pink eye, and blue hair, holding a large black and white centipede in their outstretched hand while a bright green dog with a pink collar rests on their shoulder.

46.title: Coiled Serpent Offering
46.description: A green humanoid figure with a large head and single pink eye holds a coiled black serpent in its outstretched hand. A matching green dog-like creature with a pink eye leans affectionately against the figure's shoulder.

47.title: Green Fox Industrial Decay
47.description: A large stylized green fox with one visible white eye stands amid a polluted industrial landscape of factories, cranes, and smokestacks. Dark smoke billows into a swirling red and pink toxic sky while the fox's body merges with metal scaffolding and structures.

48.title: Green Dog in Polluted Ruins
48.description: A large lime-green dog-like creature with a single large purple eye and pink tears stands in the foreground. Behind it is a dystopian industrial landscape of ruined factories, smokestacks, and construction cranes belching thick black smoke under a toxic pink and red sky.

49.title: Crown of Thorns Dachshund
49.description: A surreal green dachshund stands in the foreground wearing a crown of thorns, its body splattered with pink liquid. Behind it looms a dystopian industrial landscape of ruined factories, skeletal trees, and smokestacks billowing thick black smoke under a swirling pink and orange sky.

50.title: Green Dog Industrial Wasteland
50.description: A large lime-green dog with a single large eye and a crown of thorns stands in the foreground, its body merging with a dystopian industrial cityscape featuring factories, cranes, and gnarled dead trees under a blood-red sky filled with black smoke.

51.title: Green Dog Industrial Decay
51.description: A green dog with large pink eyes and a black collar labeled 'Lomftal' stands in profile. Its body is merged with a dark industrial cityscape featuring oil derricks, factories, and leafless trees, from which thick black smoke billows into a pink and orange sky.

52.title: Green Dog in Polluted Ruins
52.description: A large stylized green dog with a pink-ringed eye stands in the foreground, its body merging with barren, leafless trees. Behind it is a dystopian industrial landscape filled with factories, smokestacks, and graffiti-covered ruins billowing thick pink and black smoke under a toxic sky.

53.title: Industrial Hound Apocalypse
53.description: A massive lime-green dog-like creature with a single large eye and dripping tears merges with a dark industrial complex of factories, smokestacks, and scaffolding. Black smoke billows into a turbulent red and pink apocalyptic sky filled with ominous clouds and toxic rain.

54.title: Green Wolf at Toxic Falls
54.description: A vibrant green wolf with pink eyes and a thorny collar stands on a rusted industrial platform overlooking a massive waterfall. The surreal landscape features polluted pink water, wooden mining structures, dark mountains, and a dramatic sky with swirling toxic clouds and glowing colors.

55.title: Cybernetic Lime Dog
55.description: A glowing lime-green dog with cybernetic implants and black circuitry patterns stands on a wooden platform overlooking a massive waterfall. The dramatic landscape features industrial ruins, dark mountains, a stormy green and purple sky with pink lightning, and swirling pink energy tendrils.

56.title: Lime Dog in Toxic Falls
56.description: A vibrant lime-green dog with pink glowing eyes and a spiked collar stands in the foreground, emitting swirling pink energy tendrils. Behind it is a surreal industrial landscape with waterfalls, wooden structures, smokestacks, and mountains under a dramatic pink and yellow sky.

57.title: Lime Dog at Mystic Falls
57.description: A lime-green dog stands on a mossy cliff wearing a dark hooded cloak decorated with glowing orange symbols. Behind it, an elaborate wooden industrial structure channels a glowing waterfall amid a dramatic, colorful sky with swirling pink energy patterns.

59.title: Green Dog at Mystic Falls
59.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a glowing green dog standing on wooden scaffolding beside a cascading waterfall. The dramatic sky blends pink, purple, and green hues above dark mountains and pine forests, with swirling pink energy patterns surrounding the dog.

58.title: Green Dog at Toxic Falls
58.description: A glowing green dog with pink eyes stands on a rocky ledge wearing a dark patterned vest. Behind it, a massive waterfall cascades from a wooden treehouse structure built into a mountainside under a swirling pink and green toxic sky.

60.title: Cthulhu Industrial Horror
60.description: A massive green monstrous creature with a single large red eye and toothy grin emerges from a dystopian industrial complex. The scene is filled with factories, smokestacks, and dripping pink slime against a toxic pink and black cloudy sky.

61.title: Psychedelic One-Eyed Monster
61.description: A massive, vibrant green cyclops creature with a red eye and dripping pink patterns dominates the scene, its tentacles reaching out while a smaller wolf-like head emerges from its side. The background features a barren tree on scaffolding, ruined buildings covered in pink slime, and a dark, smoky sky with black and pink clouds plus neon green drips.

62.title: Surreal Desert Wanderer
62.description: A surreal painting depicts a black hooded figure with a single large red eye standing on a cracked desert path. In the swirling cosmic sky above, a giant red sun, cracked egg planet, and various celestial bodies float while a warning sign in the foreground reads "NO" with a crossed-out sandwich.

63.title: No Exit in Surreal Desert
63.description: A lone black-robed figure with a single large eye stands on a winding path in an orange and purple desert, facing a sign that reads 'NO'. In the sky, a massive swirling red vortex dominates the left while a cracked glowing egg-like orb and several smaller colored spheres float on the right.

65.title: Donut Robot Cosmic Scene
65.description: A retro-futuristic robot with glowing red eyes stands on a tiled pier, shining a beam of light upward at a massive cosmic donut floating in the sky. The donut drips dark glaze into a reflective body of water below, set against a vibrant green and purple starry sky with distant futuristic structures.

64.title: Desert Wanderer in Cosmos
64.description: A solitary figure in a dark blue hooded cloak and white mask stands on a winding road through an orange desert, gazing upward. The surreal sky features a fiery red sun, cracked white egg, orbiting planets, and swirling cosmic patterns, with a yellow 'Passage' sign beside the road.

66.title: Robot and Cosmic Portal
66.description: A small retro robot stands on a stone platform at the edge of a reflective alien sea, pointing upward at a massive dripping circular portal floating in a vibrant green and purple starry sky.

68.title: Angry Chick in Pond
68.description: A large yellow spherical chick with furrowed brows and large reflective eyes showing a city skyline at night stands in dark water surrounded by lily pads. A golden dragonfly rests on its head while it clenches its orange fists in a misty, purple-hued swamp landscape.

69.title: Angry Chick on Lily Pads
69.description: A large yellow cartoon chick with furrowed brows and enormous blue eyes reflecting a glowing red cityscape sits on lily pads in dark water. A giant mayfly with iridescent wings hovers above while a miniature city skyline rises from the misty purple water in the background.

70.title: Eclipse Over the Dome
70.description: A lone figure in a wide-brimmed hat and ornate blue cloak sits on a rocky outcrop holding a staff, overlooking a fantastical landscape. In the dramatic sky a large red and black solar eclipse dominates above a large green-domed ornate building surrounded by floating celestial bodies and glowing flowers.

71.title: Wanderer and Eclipse City
71.description: A lone figure in a wide-brimmed hat sits on a rocky outcrop overlooking a sprawling, illuminated fantasy city with ornate domes and bridges. The dramatic sky features a total solar eclipse with a glowing corona, multiple moons, and swirling dark clouds above a landscape of towering yellow flowers.

72.title: Witch by Crimson Moon
72.description: A silhouetted witch in a flowing black robe and pointed hat stands on a flower-covered shore with arms raised toward a massive red moon. The night sky swirls with vibrant aurora borealis in green, yellow, and purple, while a small red-sailed boat floats on the reflective water below.

74.title: Witch by Blood Moon
74.description: A silhouetted witch with raised arms and pointed hat stands on a hill covered in glowing red flowers, overlooking a calm sea with a lone sailboat. The dramatic night sky features a large red blood moon surrounded by swirling cosmic rings, vibrant aurora borealis, and scattered stars.

73.title: Witch Under Blood Moon
73.description: A witch in a flowing dark robe and pointed hat stands on a hill of red poppies, raising her arms with glowing spiral energy towards a large red blood moon. In the background, a white sailboat floats on dark water beneath a vibrant green and yellow aurora borealis swirling with stars and cosmic rings.

75.title: Cosmic Cat Guardians
75.description: A black silhouette of a cat stands on a starry shoreline gazing at a vibrant night sky. Two giant, stylized cat faces with multiple glowing eyes emerge from swirling cosmic portals amid green aurora borealis and sailboats on reflective water.

77.title: Surreal Painted Portrait
77.description: A woman with dramatic makeup and a large white feathered hat is depicted in a surreal painted style. Vibrant colorful liquids and abstract organic shapes in green, purple, and pink drip and float around her against a neutral background.

76.title: Cosmic Mindscape
76.description: A silhouetted figure stands on a shoreline with colorful, vibrant streams of light and cosmic energy flowing from their head into a starry night sky. The scene features a black hole with a glowing red rim, a sailboat on reflective water, aurora borealis, planets, and decorative floral patterns framing the foreground.

78.title: Feathered Dream Portrait
78.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with elaborate makeup, wearing a large white feathered hat and long pink gloves. Her face is partially obscured by the hat as she poses with one hand near her cheek, surrounded by colorful abstract swirls, dripping paint effects, and floating circular shapes.

79.title: Surreal Painterly Portrait
79.description: A stylized female figure with dramatic makeup and a large white feathered hat and collar poses against a beige background. Vibrant, colorful paint splatters, dripping effects, and abstract swirling tentacle-like forms in pastel purple, pink, and green emanate from her shoulders and hat.
79.medium: digital painting with mixed media effects

80.title: Elegant Hat Portrait
80.description: A stylized portrait of a woman wearing a large white feathered hat and cream jacket, with dramatic eye makeup and red lips. Her hand is raised near her face against a beige background with vibrant, colorful abstract paint splashes and swirling shapes in greens, purples, and pinks.

81.title: Man with Bird and Bubbles
81.description: An elderly man in a green hat and jacket stands in profile, looking right, with a small brown bird perched on his shoulder. The surreal scene includes colorful translucent bubbles, dripping blue liquid, abstract green structures, a yellow curved band, and a crowd of colorful figures in the background under a pink sky.

82.title: The Bird Whisperer
82.description: An elderly man with a green hat and jacket stands in the foreground, a small brown bird perched on his shoulder connected by a blue ribbon. Behind him, a crowd of colorful figures stands before dripping green crystal-like structures as transparent bubbles containing tiny scenes float throughout the surreal composition.

83.title: Man with Bird and Bubbles
83.description: An elderly man wearing a hat and glasses stands in the foreground looking downward, with a small yellow bird perched on his shoulder. The surreal scene includes large blue bubbles, green vertical structures, a flowing yellow ribbon, and a colorful crowd of people in the background against a pink sky.

84.title: Bamboo Flute Dreamer
84.description: An elderly man with glasses and a fedora plays a cluster of green bamboo flutes while a small brown bird perches on his shoulder. He stands in the foreground against a vibrant, surreal background of oversized iridescent bubbles and a colorful crowd of people with raised arms.

85.title: Solar Eclipse Figure
85.description: A blue-skinned figure with a dual-faced head sits surrounded by stylized foliage. The head displays a smiling sun and moon merged together, framed by a radiant solar eclipse with orange flames against a dark starry sky.

86.title: Eclipse Duality
86.description: A woman sits amid dark blue flowers with her face split between a smiling white mask on the left and a serene blue profile on the right. A fiery solar eclipse with orange corona and sparkling golden particles forms a halo behind her head against a dramatic purple sky.

67.title: Donut Black Hole Robot
67.description: A surreal cosmic scene features a giant donut-shaped black hole with dripping chocolate icing floating in a green starry sky. A geometric robot with glowing red eyes stands on a circuit-patterned platform in reflective water, surrounded by floating orange rings and white spheres under bright yellow light beams.

87.title: Eclipse Goddess
87.description: A mystical blue-skinned woman sits amid dark foliage, cradling a large crescent moon that merges with a solar eclipse in the sky. Her hair flows in ornate curls while she smiles serenely under a fiery red and orange corona against a starry night.

89.title: Lunar Eclipse Goddess
89.description: A blue-skinned woman with white celestial markings and crescent moon earrings sits serenely amid stylized red and white foliage. A dramatic solar eclipse with a fiery corona glows behind her head against a starry purple sky.

88.title: Eclipse Moon Goddess
88.description: A cosmic female figure with dual faces sits surrounded by stylized flora against a dark purple night sky. Her body is deep blue speckled with stars while a glowing solar eclipse forms a radiant halo behind her head.

91.title: Lunar Eclipse Portrait
91.description: A blue-skinned figure with a crescent moon face and golden glowing eyes sits serenely amid dark tropical foliage. A radiant red and orange solar halo surrounds their head against a starry purple night sky filled with floating golden particles.

90.title: Eclipse Spirit in Jungle
90.description: A young woman with blue skin and glowing golden eyes sits serenely amid dark tropical foliage, looking over her shoulder. A dramatic solar eclipse with a fiery orange corona forms a halo behind her head while golden particles and fireflies float throughout the mystical night scene.

93.title: Eclipse Goddess in Jungle
93.description: A silhouetted female figure with glowing golden eyes sits among stylized tropical foliage under a large smiling celestial being that is half moon and half sun, surrounded by a fiery orange solar eclipse corona against a starry purple night sky.

92.title: Eclipse Goddess in Jungle
92.description: A blue-skinned woman with a glowing smile sits amid lush tropical foliage, her face divided by a solar eclipse halo featuring moon phases. Golden sparks and light trails radiate from the celestial ring against a dark twilight sky.

94.title: Cosmic Cat Guardians
94.description: Two giant stylized cats with third eyes face each other above an ornate domed temple city, their laser-like gazes meeting at a brilliant central sunburst. The purple cat on the left and the white patterned cat on the right are set against a dramatic apocalyptic sky filled with exploding fire, twin moons, and a cracked green planet.

97.title: Psychedelic Skull Sorcerer
97.description: A cracked green skull with one glowing pink eye and exposed brain matter dominates the composition, its skeletal hand reaching forward. Vibrant pink lightning emanates from the skull's head, surrounded by floating transparent spheres containing miniature creatures and abstract forms against a swirling cosmic background.

96.title: Cosmic Tree of Doves
96.description: A surreal painting depicts a stylized tree with swirling blue and green foliage growing from a stone staircase. Two ornate doves, one dark with intricate patterns and one white, perch on its branches beneath a starry purple sky with comets and constellation lines.

95.title: Cosmic Cheshire Cats
95.description: Two giant grinning Cheshire cats, one purple with multiple eyes and one white with three eyes, float above a fantastical glowing city with ornate domes and palm trees. A dramatic cosmic sky swirls with a fiery sun, colorful planets, shooting stars, and beams of light.

98.title: Lunar Desert Spheres
98.description: A surreal desert landscape features rolling sand dunes under a large glowing turquoise moon. Translucent green spheres of various sizes rest among rocky outcrops and stylized alien flora with orange and green leaves.

100.title: Psychedelic Clock Dog
100.description: A green dog with a clock for a face emerges from a swirling purple tunnel, its tongue extended as it reaches toward a fishbowl containing another dog-like figure. The vibrant composition features hypnotic swirls, fish patterns, and flower motifs against a lime green background.

99.title: Alien Landscape with Orbs
99.description: A surreal alien landscape features a large transparent green orb with a leaf-like lid at the center of a winding wooden path. Smaller green spheres of varying transparency are scattered along the path, surrounded by exotic plants with red and orange leaves under a large glowing turquoise celestial body in a pink sky.

101.title: Surreal Clock Dog
101.description: A vibrant green dog runs through a psychedelic scene with a large blue clock for a head, its hands pointing to approximately 12:05. The dog leaps from a giant swirling purple flower on the left, trailing colorful motion lines against a green background filled with spirals and abstract patterns.

102.title: Psychedelic Clock Dog
102.description: A vibrant green chihuahua with pink polka-dot ears and a studded collar leaps through a swirling spiral clock face. The hypnotic background features radiating concentric circles in bright greens, purples, pinks and yellows with floating purple cat icons and the text TIMES UP.

103.title: Psychedelic Clock Flower
103.description: A surreal painting features a large purple and pink flower with a green stem on the left, its center transforming into a swirling, multicolored cat-clock hybrid. The clock face displays numbers 1 through 12 with black hands, a cat's face with spiral eyes and pointed ears, set against a vibrant green background with concentric psychedelic circles and floating purple petals.

104.title: Pulse Green Dog
104.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a lime green dog with bright pink eyes and braided hair, set against a dark apocalyptic landscape with a swirling vortex, dead trees, ruined towers, and black cats. Large purple flowers and floating petals frame the scene while the word 'PULSE' appears in pink across the dog's forehead.

105.title: Psychedelic Industrial Dog
105.description: A vibrant lime green dog with a swirling hypnotic pattern in its mouth stands in the foreground, its tail exploding into purple floral shapes and floating bones. Behind it looms a massive purple mechanical flower structure intertwined with dark industrial factories billowing toxic yellow and pink smoke into a stormy sky.

106.title: Green Zombie Dog and Donut
106.description: A surreal apocalyptic painting features a bright green zombie Labrador with glowing pink eyes, protruding brain, and a spiked skull collar, positioned centrally with its tongue out. Above it floats a massive dripping cosmic donut resembling a portal, set against a dark cloudy sky with two gnarled dead trees, each bearing a small black cat on a branch.

107.title: Stasis Dog and Robot
107.description: A vibrant green dog with pink dotted ears and a 'STASIS' collar stands beside a grey dome-headed robot with red eyes, both in the foreground against a dystopian industrial backdrop.

108.title: Surreal Dream Portal
108.description: A stylized portrait of a topless woman with elaborate swirling orange and blue hair, purple eyes, and golden cracks across her skin. She stands beside a large oval portal showing a desert landscape with purple mountains, a setting sun, and a small silhouetted figure, surrounded by floating transparent bubbles containing tiny objects against a vibrant cosmic background.

110.title: Alien Muse at Sunset
110.description: A muscular green alien with a toothy grin stands in the foreground of a winding dirt road through an autumn forest. Behind the alien's head emerges the translucent face of a beautiful woman with glowing orange eyes and flowing purple tentacle-like hair that swirls dramatically against a vibrant sunset sky.

109.title: Alien Portal Pathway
109.description: A green alien with large black eyes and a muscular build stands on a fleshy, vein-like red path that winds toward a glowing pink-rimmed circular portal revealing a starry cosmos. The surreal landscape is framed by colorful autumnal trees under a vibrant sunset sky.

111.title: Alien and Purple Muse
111.description: A green alien with large black eyes stands behind a nude female figure with purple swirling hair and orange eyes, both walking along a winding dirt road through an autumn forest.

112.title: Autumn Alien Encounter
112.description: A muscular green alien with large black eyes and sharp teeth stands on a leaf-strewn country road. A spectral female figure with flowing purple hair and glowing orange eyes emerges from behind its head against a vibrant autumn sunset.

115.title: Vibrant Ceramic Vessels
115.description: A stylized still life painting featuring an arrangement of colorful ceramic pots, jugs, and bowls against a turquoise background. The composition includes swirling concentric circle patterns, stylized leaves, and magenta paint splashes surrounding the pottery.

114.title: Midcentury Terrarium Landscape
114.description: A surreal midcentury modern scene depicts a woman in an orange and teal geometric suit and a man in a striped sweater standing on the roof of a modernist house. They are flanked by two large transparent spheres containing miniature mountain landscapes, surrounded by stylized pottery with plants.

113.title: Eye of the Mountain
113.description: A massive blood-red eye with white root-like veins embedded in a jagged mountain peak overlooks a winding stone path and a glowing waterfall. The surreal landscape features autumn-colored trees under a dramatic fiery sunset sky with hanging stalactites.

116.title: Cosmic Tree Sprite
116.description: A surreal portrait of a female figure with tree-branch arms and hair, featuring one large glowing cosmic eye. She reaches toward two floating glowing orbs against a vibrant orange and space-themed background with colorful paint splatters.

119.title: Mardi Gras Alien Portrait
119.description: A vibrant green alien with yellow eyes and purple facial markings smiles at the viewer. The character is surrounded by colorful floating Mardi Gras masks, stylized flowers, and swirling rainbow orbital rings against a futuristic cityscape background.

118.title: Mysterious Green Teardrop Figure
118.description: A vibrant surreal illustration features a glossy green teardrop-shaped creature with large yellow eyes, pink lips, and golden facial markings. It is surrounded by colorful swirling patterns, three ornate masquerade masks, glowing flowers, stars, and a stylized cityscape under a starry night sky.

120.title: Surreal Vortex Seascape
120.description: Three men in black coats and top hats stand on a grassy shore beside a small red and white boat, observing a giant glowing teal crystal floating in the sky above a sea with concentric swirling ripples. Sailboats navigate the colorful vortex waters while a distant village and mountains sit under a dramatic, multicolored swirling sky.

117.title: Masquerade Dream Portrait
117.description: A vibrant stylized portrait of a woman with intricate blue and orange braided hair adorned with stars and flowers. She wears a blue top and an orange mask, while two floating ethereal masks—one blue, one turquoise with spiral patterns—hover beside her against a warm orange background with flowing colorful ribbons.

121.title: Surreal Cosmic Shore
121.description: Three men in top hats and formal coats stand on a grassy shore beside a beached rowboat, observing a winding river that flows into a calm sea with sailboats. In the psychedelic sky, a large glowing teardrop-shaped celestial body with crater-like textures hovers within concentric rainbow rings above a distant town and mountains.

123.title: Surreal Cosmic Eye
123.description: A surreal painting depicts a large human eye in the upper right with a green iris containing a woman's face, overlooking a theatrical auditorium filled with an audience of hooded figures. A cloaked performer stands on stage beneath a massive black hole with glowing orange accretion disk in a fiery red and purple cosmic sky, while a large dripping black paw print dominates the foreground.

122.title: Surreal Lakeside Vision
122.description: Three men in 19th-century formal attire and top hats stand on a grassy shore observing a massive floating blue water droplet surrounded by orbiting colorful spheres and swirling rainbow ribbons. Sailboats navigate a calm lake with a distant village and mountains beneath a dramatic red-orange sunset sky.

124.title: Cosmic Eye Metropolis
124.description: A massive surreal green eye dominates the sky above a vibrant futuristic city at night. The iris contains a detailed face, while spaceships, flying cars, and a glowing orbital highway with crowds of people fill the bustling cyberpunk scene.

127.title: Cosmic Lighthouse Oracle
127.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman in a pink robe with golden crack patterns standing in an ancient amphitheater filled with hooded figures holding lanterns. In the cosmic sky above, a massive black hole with fiery orange rings looms behind a large cracked green planet, while a tall lighthouse on the right casts a bright beam toward the planet.

125.title: Cosmic Eye Theater
125.description: A surreal painting depicts a massive green planet with a detailed human eye embedded in its surface, the iris containing a woman's face. An audience sits in a grand celestial amphitheater facing the planet while a lighthouse on the planet's surface shines toward a glowing black hole in a vibrant cosmic sky filled with spaceships.

126.title: Cosmic Eye Theater
126.description: A surreal scene depicts a massive ornate theater filled with an audience of shadowy figures watching a giant central eye with a green iris containing a woman's face. In the cosmic background, a black hole emits an orange beam toward a lighthouse, with a green planet, purple nebula, spaceships, and a fantasy castle visible in space.

128.title: Cosmic Dragon Lighthouse
128.description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a large winged dragon on a stage performing for a vast audience in an amphitheater under a black hole with an orange accretion disk.
