598.description: A surreal scene featuring a young girl with melting orange and blue wax-like skin and large glowing eyes, her hand raised as she releases smoke. A massive twisted raven with a large central eye forms a dreamcatcher-like web holding colorful orbs, set against a dark fantasy landscape with a distant castle under a starry sky with two moons.

601.title: Surreal Wolf Eye Vortex
601.description: A circular cracked composition features a split wolf head with one yellow eye on a green side and a black silhouette profile on the blue side. A swirling red vortex sits at the center where the faces meet, set against a magenta background filled with black floral patterns, skulls, and dripping colorful paint.

602.title: Fractured Psyche Bloom
602.description: A surreal portrait of a young person's face with cracked golden halo, one glowing yellow eye, and colorful paint dripping from the features. Vibrant red and purple flowers with green glowing accents emerge from the eye socket, set against a dark smoky background with skeletal figures and swirling patterns.

603.title: Psychedelic Melting Dog
603.description: A stylized portrait of a dog rendered in cracked, mosaic-like patterns with vibrant green and blue tones on its head. Brightly colored paint in orange, blue, and green drips from the dog's face and neck, while large magenta flowers bloom across its body against a smoky purple background with faint bone shapes.

604.title: Psychedelic Cracked Dog Portrait
604.description: A surreal portrait of a dog's head and neck in profile, featuring a fractured green and blue face with orange eyes, dripping colorful paint, and vibrant magenta flowers growing from its orange and red body. The background shows a swirling vortex with additional paint drips, skulls, and floral elements in a psychedelic style.

605.title: Psychedelic Dog Portrait
605.description: A vibrant, surreal painting of a dog's head and shoulders in profile facing left. The dog is composed of fragmented patches of green, blue, orange, and purple with embedded flowers, while colorful paint drips run down its form against a swirling, smoky background with rose motifs.

606.title: Cracked Child Portrait
606.description: A surreal portrait of a child's face with cracked porcelain-like skin, visible red veins, and one glowing orange eye. The circular frame is fractured with colorful paint dripping down, surrounded by dark purple flowers, skulls, and swirling smoke against a black background.

607.title: Crimson Mind Vortex
607.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face with golden eyes, centered in a swirling vortex. Red vein-like branches and dripping colorful liquids emerge from her head against a stormy background of blue, grey, and fiery orange swirls.

608.title: Fractured Mind Vortex
608.description: A surreal painted portrait of a blue-skinned child with orange eyes and cracked porcelain-like skin, emerging from a circular dripping frame. Red and orange vein-like branches extend from the head into a swirling vortex containing skeletal remains and abstract forms.

609.title: Eternal Spiral
609.description: A surreal portrait of a pale child's face with glowing orange eyes, cracked like porcelain. The right side of the head merges into a swirling dark vortex framed by gold cracks, while red vein-like branches drip blue and orange liquid against a background of shadowy skeletons and swirling forms.

610.title: Psychedelic Split Eye
610.description: A surreal painting of a large stylized eye with a cracked sclera and orange-red dripping edges. Within the iris, a green melting wolf-like creature on the left merges with a blue dripping human-like face on the right, set against a purple background with flowers and white smoke.

611.title: Surreal Melting Portrait
611.description: A circular cracked portal contains a surreal composite face split between a lime green dog on the left and a young human with yellow eyes on the right. Vibrant paint drips in orange, blue, and green from the figures against a magenta background filled with stylized flowers and swirling lines.

612.title: Neon Skull Witch
612.description: A green skeletal female figure with a melting skull face and blue tears stands in profile holding a small orange skull. She has colorful dripping hair and is surrounded by purple flowers under a large red blood moon with black drips against a dark starry sky.

614.title: Psychedelic Melting Hound
614.description: A surreal green dog stands in the center of a blood-red ground covered in concentric circles, bones, and insects. The creature has intricate vein-like patterns on its skin, a blue and orange dripping head with glowing diamond eyes, set against a dark swirling sky filled with melting clouds, leaves, and floating debris.

613.title: Child and Neon Wolf
613.description: A surreal painting features a child's head with cracked skin and a glowing yellow eye, enclosed in a golden circular frame with dripping colorful liquid. A vibrant green wolf with exposed teeth and psychedelic patterns emerges from the right, set against a dark swirling background with branches and flowers.

615.title: Cosmic Bleeding Heron
615.description: A surreal bird-like creature with a long neck, four glowing orange eyes, and curved horns stands on cracked red earth. Blue liquid drips from its face and body, forming a puddle, while skulls, orbs, and swirling cosmic patterns fill the dramatic sky.

616.title: Cosmic Horned Raven
616.description: A surreal dark bird with a long curved orange horn and multiple glowing eyes stands on a cracked red alien landscape. The swirling psychedelic sky contains skeletal forms, eyeballs, and dripping colorful orbs while the ground features glowing spheres and viscous orange-purple pools.

617.title: Surreal Horned Bird Entity
617.description: A bizarre bird-like creature with long purple legs, a skeletal goat-like head with curved horns, and glowing orange eyes stands on a cracked red surface. Blue and orange liquid drips from its face and horns while a swirling vortex of skulls, bones, and orange patterns dominates the background.

618.title: Unicorn Cephalopod Beast
618.description: A surreal dark fantasy creature with a bulbous head covered in multiple glowing eyes stands on a blood-red ground littered with bones. It features a long spiraled horn, dripping blue and orange fluids, a skeletal body with spiny protrusions, and holds several patterned spheres while a swirling cosmic vortex of orange, black, and purple fills the dramatic sky.

619.title: Fiery Mythical Creature
619.description: A blue and orange chimeric creature with glowing orange eyes, curved horns, and feathered wings stands in a dramatic pose. Red and blue liquid drips from its head and body while flames and ghostly skull motifs swirl in the smoky background.

620.title: Fiery Skeletal Phoenix
620.description: A surreal hybrid creature stands in profile with a long curved horned head, dripping colorful paint from its eyes and beak. Its body combines golden-brown fur, vibrant blue and orange feathers, exposed skeletal wings and ribcage engulfed in flames, while a skull floats in the swirling smoky background.

622.title: Fiery Fox Spirit
622.description: A vibrant surreal artwork depicts a woman with purple skin and an elaborate swirling headdress of orange, teal, and purple floral patterns, her face partially obscured by a large lotus flower. She merges seamlessly with a fiery orange fox whose body features intricate skeletal and henna-like floral designs, set against a muted green background with faint skull motifs.

623.title: Surreal Eye and Green Dog
623.description: A surreal painting features a vibrant green skeletal dog on the left facing a large cracked egg-like structure containing a bloody red spiral eye that drips red liquid. On the right is a person with short hair decorated with green skulls and spirals, their face and neck streaked with blue and orange dripping paint against a dark swirling background.

624.title: Psychedelic Dog and Human Fusion
624.description: A surreal painting depicts a green dog-like creature with a large, detailed human eye in its socket, from which colorful paint drips. The right side shows a human face partially merged with the dog, surrounded by smoke, bones, skulls, and swirling patterns against a dark cloudy background.

625.title: Surreal Green Dog and Orb
625.description: A giant green dog covered in skull patterns and dripping red liquid stands facing a transparent sphere containing a woman's face split between orange and blue tears. A small backpacking figure stands between them on a grassy hill under a dark swirling sky with red drips from above.

626.title: Green Dog and Crystal Orb
626.description: A large green dog with red eyes and blood-like drips from its mouth dominates the left side, its body patterned with black deer silhouettes. On the right, a man with a red backpack stands on a grassy cliff edge gazing up at a transparent bubble containing a smaller green dog and a cloaked figure, set against a dark purple sky filled with swirling red patterns and floating deer icons.

627.title: The Green Dog and Orb
627.description: A large green dog covered in smaller running dogs stands in profile facing a glowing crystal ball containing swirling black dog-like figures and a red spiral. An old man with a backpack stands on a mossy cliff, looking up in awe against a purple background filled with repeating orange dog motifs and red swirling patterns.

629.title: Melting Pink Tower
629.description: A surreal scene features a large pink cubic tower covered in white and black dog-like silhouettes, melting like wax with dripping orange and pink streams. To the right, a young woman with long flowing red hair rests her head on her hands, her skin also marked with tiny dog figures, set against a dark purple sky filled with floating dog shapes, bubbles, and swirling patterns.

628.title: Cosmic Dream Weaver
628.description: A young woman with flowing fiery red hair and pale patterned skin gazes down at a small explorer standing on a lush green hill. She holds a large transparent sphere containing a swirling galaxy with stars and nebulae, set against a dark purple background filled with floating animal silhouettes and swirling orange patterns.

630.title: Crimson Witch and Candy Altar
630.description: A pale woman with long flowing red hair and skull tattoos sits in the foreground holding a small orange fox. Behind her rises a large dripping pink cake-like structure covered in melting candles, skulls, and bones, set against a dark purple background filled with repeating orange deer and bird silhouettes.

631.title: Cosmic Fox Vortex
631.description: A surreal painting depicts a swirling cosmic vortex of yellow, orange, red, and green flames against a dark purple sky. Numerous stylized foxes in skeletal, fiery, and glowing forms orbit the vortex while a pink dripping pedestal on the right supports several green plant-like stalks topped with transparent bubbles containing small fox figures.

632.title: Stasis Overhead Projection
632.description: A surreal bust of a bald, gray-skinned figure with closed eyes emerges from cracked dark rock. Pink chess pieces and melting structures sit atop its head as orange concentric ripples spread below against a backdrop of white skeletal animals on a purple field.

633.title: Golden Retriever and Android
633.description: A surreal painting features a yellow golden retriever puppy holding a bouquet of glowing red and orange leaves in its mouth, held by a grey humanoid android with a feminine face. Ethereal red and purple foxes and deer swirl in a smoky vortex around them against a dark purple background.

635.title: Green Monster and Puppy
635.description: A surreal scene featuring a large, bright green spherical monster with big eyes, a toothy grin, and orange slime dripping from its head. It holds an orange leash attached to a golden retriever puppy carrying a bouquet of red tulips mixed with small skulls, set against a swirling blue-gray background with skeletal motifs and floating jack-o'-lanterns.

634.title: Ethereal Woman with Golden Puppy
634.description: A surreal portrait of a bald woman with pale purple skin, red eyes, and black lips, her head and body covered in orange and red animal silhouettes. She cradles a realistic golden retriever puppy holding red leaves, set against a swirling purple vortex background filled with more animal figures and fiery orange energy trails.

636.title: Golden Puppy and Serpent Spiral
636.description: A realistic golden retriever puppy sits amid swirling, vibrant foliage and flowers. A large red and black serpent coils in a dynamic spiral on the right, contrasting the soft puppy and ethereal smoke below.

637.title: Surreal Eye and Green Dog
637.description: A surreal painting featuring a bright green skeletal dog with visible ribcage and barbed wire collar, positioned on the left and facing a massive stylized eye in the center. To the right is a person's face with blue and orange dripping paint patterns, set against a dark swirling background with red accents and blood-like drips from the central eye.

638.title: Cyclops Hound Portrait
638.description: Surreal circular portrait split between an elderly man with a brown hat, white beard and large red veined eye, and a green anthropomorphic hound with pointed ears. The cracked white sphere is surrounded by swirling orange and red fiery vortexes against a dark smoky background.

621.title: Fiery Fox Lotus Spirit
621.description: A surreal painting of a blue-skinned woman's face merged with a fiery orange fox, centered within a large blooming purple lotus flower. Red and orange liquid drips from the petals and the figure's eyes against a smoky, swirling background with faint animal silhouettes.

640.title: Elder and Spectral Hound
640.description: A surreal portrait of an elderly man with a skeletal face, white beard, glasses, and fedora hat emerging from stylized blue waves. A glowing green spectral dog with spiral patterns and exposed brain-like details overlaps his head, while his skeletal hand reaches from the water.

639.title: Elder and Green Hound
639.description: A surreal double portrait shows an elderly man with white beard and fedora hat merging into the head and neck of a stylized green dog. The composition features swirling patterns, dripping paint effects, and a layered water scene with fish below.

641.title: Psychedelic Skull Chimera
641.description: A surreal profile portrait of a bald figure with a pink and yellow skull-like face, exposed teeth, and one large red eye. A bright green skeletal creature with a canine skull head and black dog tattoos on its neck is wrapped around the figure, while a large pink and green bird-like creature with multiple eyes and flame-like patterns hovers above against a swirling green background filled with colorful geometric shapes and organic patterns.

642.title: Surreal Owl and Xoloitzcuintli
642.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a bald woman with a colorful sugar skull mask on her right eye, standing beside a bright green skeletal Xoloitzcuintli dog. A large stylized red owl with concentric circular eyes merges with her head against a swirling green background with floating geometric shapes.

643.title: Psychedelic Green Parrot
643.description: A vibrant surreal illustration of a lime green parrot with intricate black patterns and a large red beak covered in symbols. The bird emerges from swirling red and grey smoke against a dark starry background filled with colorful floating orbs containing smaller creatures and abstract designs.

644.title: Cosmic Skeleton Bird
644.description: A large skeletal bird with glowing orange eyes and a red beak flies with outstretched wings above a crystalline blue rock formation with waterfalls. The surreal night scene features colorful planets orbiting the bird against a starry background with swirling galaxies and a reflective pool below.

645.title: Crystal Waterfall Realm
645.description: A massive glowing blue crystal formation sits atop a rocky outcrop with multiple waterfalls cascading into a vibrant pool below. The surreal fantasy landscape features floating colorful spheres, swirling cosmic clouds, a distant waterfall on a green hillside, and a starry night sky.

646.title: Surreal Mystic Waterfall
646.description: A vibrant surreal landscape featuring a glowing green and yellow fleur-de-lis emblem radiating star-like light in the sky. Below, a crystalline waterfall cascades from icy cliffs into a swirling colorful pool surrounded by floating transparent orbs containing miniature scenes, set against swirling vortexes and a misty purple foreground.

647.title: Surreal Dripping Orbs
647.description: A surreal painting featuring three transparent spheres on a black marble shelf against a starry cosmic background. The left sphere contains a vibrant landscape with a waterfall and pine trees, the center shows swirling red liquid with a small skull, and the right holds a white skeletal hand amid red spirals, all beneath dripping molten red and orange substance from above.

649.title: Psychedelic Mantis Waterfall
649.description: A surreal fantasy landscape features a large waterfall cascading into a dark pool, with glowing red lava flows on dark cliffs. In the foreground, multiple translucent bubbles contain green praying mantises with large purple eyes, set against swirling patterns and a purple abstract structure.

648.title: Dreaming Eyes and Waterfalls
648.description: A close-up portrait of a young girl with large luminous green eyes and purple skin rests her chin on her hand. Smoke drifts from her eyes toward a surreal background landscape featuring a cascading waterfall, swirling water patterns, and three transparent bubbles containing miniature reflections of the scene.

651.title: Eye of the Waterfall
651.description: A massive surreal green eye dominates the composition with a swirling vortex pupil and a multicolored waterfall cascading from its lower lid into a turquoise pool below. Lush psychedelic vegetation, mist, and abstract organic patterns in vibrant greens, purples, and blues frame the eye against a colorful sky.

650.title: Surreal Eye Waterfall
650.description: A highly detailed surreal painting of a giant human eye whose iris is a swirling green vortex with a red and black center. Waterfalls cascade from the upper eyelid and lashes, with icicles hanging from the brow, while the surrounding space blends into lush green foliage on the left and vibrant purple psychedelic patterns on the right.

654.title: Emerald Dragon Pagoda
654.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a luminous green serpentine dragon formed from braided, scaled tendrils exploding with colorful splashes and bubbles. In the background, a traditional East Asian pagoda stands on a misty lakeside with mountains, small boats, and orange koi fish swimming in reflective water.

652.title: Psychedelic Waterfall Vision
652.description: A surreal landscape features a vibrant waterfall cascading from a dark rocky cliff into a glowing pool below. Skeletal hands emerge from swirling green foliage on both sides, with colorful orbs, abstract patterns, and floating skulls blending into the fantastical scene.

653.title: Surreal Pagoda Vortex
653.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a traditional multi-tiered Chinese pagoda on a misty lake with small boats. The left side dissolves into swirling green slime, tentacles, and colorful circular organisms blending into cosmic turquoise and purple vortexes against a mountainous backdrop.

655.title: Surreal Canine Oracle
655.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a green skeletal dog with exposed bones and dripping blue liquid from its mouth, positioned beside a melancholic human figure with colorful dripping tears. A large stylized eye with a red iris and cracked halo of nails floats above them against a dark swirling background.

656.title: Neon Canine and Fractured Eye
656.description: A vibrant lime-green skeletal dog with mechanical patterns and red eyes stands in profile on the left, dripping blue, orange, and green liquid from its face. To the right, a stylized human head with blue and orange dripping patterns merges with a massive cracked red eye containing a fiery inner symbol, all set against a dark swirling cloudy background with glowing orange accents.

657.title: Cracked Eye of Stasis
657.description: A large cracked egg-like orb dominates the surreal composition, its left side revealing a massive detailed human eye with orange iris while the right side shows half of a blue-skinned face with golden eye. Below and to the right sits a smaller transparent sphere containing a vibrant landscape of colorful stones, water, and flowing lava patterns, all resting on a bed of smooth dark pebbles against a swirling cosmic background.

659.title: Weeping Cosmic Eye
659.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face with blue and orange tears streaming down, dominated by a massive cracked celestial eye above her forehead that drips molten red and gold. Ethereal smoke, colorful swirling patterns, skulls, and ghostly figures surround the central figure against a dark background.

658.title: Eye of the Phoenix
658.description: A surreal scene featuring a large cracked eyeball with a glowing red iris and fiery pupil, from which red liquid drips. A woman with blue and orange face paint appears on the right beside a large phoenix with fiery wings that curves around the eye against a dark, stormy purple sky.

660.title: Surreal Melting Eye Portrait
660.description: A surreal painting features a massive cracked orange-red eye dominating the composition, with a swirling colorful iris containing a skeletal figure. Below it, a blue-toned woman's face melts with dripping paint, set against a dark cloudy background with floating musical notes and ornate patterns.

661.title: Surreal Eye Dreamscape
661.description: A surreal painting features a woman's face with blue and orange patterns merging into a large cracked eyeball in the sky. To the right, a smiling purple melting creature with a palm tree on its head floats against a dark, stormy background with swirling vortexes and red lightning.

663.title: Cornfire Dragon
663.description: A vibrant purple creature with large eyes and a wide grin sits among corn stalks, breathing a massive swirling vortex of orange and yellow fire. The fiery spiral contains visible corn cobs and is surrounded by tropical palm trees and swirling green mist.

662.title: Psychedelic Octopus Eye Vortex
662.description: A surreal painting featuring a smiling purple octopus-like creature with large black eyes and green palm fronds on its head, floating above a swirling fiery vortex of red, orange, and yellow. To the right is a large cracked red sphere resembling an eye with a vertical slit pupil, surrounded by flames and small skull motifs.

664.title: Corn Demon Vortex
664.description: A surreal painting features a grinning purple corn demon with a skull-topped palm tree growing from its head. The figure stands amid a swirling rainbow vortex of colorful paint streaks and white corn cobs against a dark, smoky background with dripping paint effects.

667.title: Einstein Turtle and Purple Pal
667.description: A vibrant underwater scene featuring a sea turtle with Albert Einstein's face and wild white hair riding on the back of a smiling purple sea creature with a palm tree on its head. The pair swims through a surreal ocean vortex surrounded by colorful coral, fish, and a large whale below.

666.title: Psychedelic Turtle and Jellyfish
666.description: A vibrant purple jellyfish-like creature with a palm tree on its head and a wide grin stands beside a heavily decorated sea turtle in glowing water. Both characters are covered in intricate colorful patterns, skulls, and coral under a full moon casting a golden beam over misty mountains.

665.title: Rainbow Turtle and Plum
665.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a glowing sea turtle with a colorful patterned shell swimming through clouds and paint splatters, alongside a floating purple plum-like creature with large eyes, a smiling face, and green drips. The composition is encircled by a vivid rainbow arc against a dark background with abstract black and red splashes.

668.title: Turtle and Octopus Dream
668.description: A vibrant purple octopus with large eyes and a small palm tree on its head sits upright in a wooden bed, covered by a white blanket patterned with orange and purple sea creatures. An ornate orange sea turtle with swirling patterns swims in blue water beside the bed inside a dark stone cave, with a beam of light shining down from above and swirling colorful patterns on the cave ceiling.

669.title: Psychedelic Mermaid Turtle
669.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large sea turtle swimming underwater with a woman's face merged into its shell, featuring flowing purple hair adorned with fish and a small smiling creature on its head. The scene includes a palm tree growing from the top, colorful coral reefs, swirling vortex patterns, and sun rays penetrating from the ocean surface above.

670.title: Eye of the Cosmos
670.description: A large, ornate cosmic eye dominates the upper portion of the composition, its green iris detailed with intricate patterns and surrounded by swirling psychedelic motifs, skulls, and symbols. Below it, silhouetted figures with glowing yellow hands raised upward face the eye while a detailed sea turtle swims through colorful swirling currents on the right.

671.title: Surreal Turtle Eye
671.description: A large stylized human eye dominates the composition, its iris a swirling green vortex containing a pink jellyfish. A detailed sea turtle swims across the foreground, surrounded by numerous transparent bubbles that contain miniature underwater scenes including coral, jellyfish, and silhouettes.

672.title: Eye of the Sea Turtle
672.description: A large, intricate human eye with a vibrant green iris and black pupil dominates the composition. A colorful sea turtle adorned with coral patterns swims beside it, surrounded by numerous translucent bubbles containing smaller watchful eyes against a swirling blue and teal background.

673.title: Cosmic Fleur-de-Lis Turtle
673.description: A sea turtle with a glowing fleur-de-lis shell swims through a dark cosmic ocean, leaving colorful light trails. A large luminous green and yellow fleur-de-lis symbol glows in the background, surrounded by floating transparent bubbles containing smaller fleur-de-lis motifs.

675.title: Psychedelic Melting Portrait
675.description: A surreal painting featuring a person's face split between vibrant blue and orange hues with dripping paint effects, positioned beside a vibrant green dog covered in intricate patterns and a melting purple slime creature with large teeth and green eyes. The background consists of swirling red, orange, and black vortex patterns with small silhouetted figures.

674.title: Surreal Green Dog and Eye
674.description: A surreal painting depicts a vibrant green skeletal dog with visible bones and organs, its mouth open as it nuzzles the face of a blue-skinned person with curly hair. Above them floats a massive bloodshot eye with a fiery inner scene, all set against a dark swirling background with dripping orange paint effects.

677.title: Cyberpunk Skull Overlord
677.description: A surreal cyberpunk scene featuring a decomposed skeletal figure in a pinstripe suit holding a smoking gun and a cigarette, standing before a giant blue and orange melting female face that merges with a futuristic cityscape and a massive red sun in a swirling orange sky.

676.title: Psychedelic Cat-Wolf Hybrid
676.description: A surreal split-face portrait showing a blue-skinned woman with cat ears on the left and a vibrant green wolf-like creature on the right. The composition features heavy dripping paint effects in orange, blue, green and purple against a dark swirling background with symbolic orange markings.

678.title: Beetle Necromancer with Tree
678.description: A beetle-headed humanoid figure in a dark coat holds a bloody gun and a dripping heart while carrying a large green shell on its back. In the background, a circular ornate frame encloses a gnarled tree with green leaves and roots, set against a swirling purple and green smoky sky with skull motifs.

679.title: Beetle and the Reaper
679.description: A surreal painting featuring a woman with long flowing red hair and heterochromia, her face partially skeletal. She holds a large iridescent green beetle with visible dripping blood while a skeletal figure in a dark coat stands behind her holding a pistol.

680.title: Beetle and Zombie Detective
680.description: A surreal painting depicts a skeletal zombie figure wearing a fedora and trench coat, holding a bloody revolver in one hand while reaching toward a giant iridescent green beetle. The background consists of a swirling vortex of green and teal with floating smaller beetles and red streaks.

681.title: Zombie Over Chinese Lake
681.description: A gory skeletal zombie in a tattered coat holds a smoking revolver with blood dripping from its hands, standing in the right foreground. Behind it stretches a traditional Chinese landscape of misty mountains, pagodas on the water, and small boats on swirling currents, all intersected by bold diagonal slashes of teal, green, and red paint.

682.title: Floating Crown Over Lake
682.description: A large ornate golden crown with lotus flowers and red gems floats in the purple sky, dripping black liquid. Below, a serene green lake with small boats reflects a distant pagoda amid misty mountains, while colorful swirling ribbons and skeletal figures streak across the surreal landscape.

683.title: Stormy Pagoda Lake
683.description: A traditional Chinese pagoda stands on a misty island in a lake, surrounded by small boats with fishermen. Swirling teal and orange storm clouds with skeletal dragon motifs dominate the dramatic sky above misty green mountains.

684.title: Storm Over Pagoda Lake
684.description: A dramatic East Asian landscape depicts a multi-tiered red pagoda on the shore of a misty lake during a violent thunderstorm. Lightning cracks across a swirling, turbulent sky filled with dark clouds, fiery orange accents, and stylized wind patterns while small boats float on the rippling water below.

685.title: Surreal Desert Eye
685.description: A surreal desert landscape features a lone hooded figure in a dark cloak walking up a sand dune, leaving footprints. In the foreground a bright red mouse sits on a branch with green leaves, while a massive stylized eye with a spiral pupil and dripping orange tears dominates the sky next to a glowing moon containing faint human-like figures.

686.title: Green Maidens and Red Death
686.description: Four identical green-haired maidens with braided hair and spiral tattoos stand in profile facing right, eyes closed with serene expressions. They confront a group of five black-hooded skeletal figures with blood-red dripping faces and hands, one holding a dripping red staff, set against a vibrant background of hypnotic yellow and green spirals.

688.title: Ethereal Green Goddesses
688.description: A surreal painting featuring four stylized female figures with pale skin and flowing green hair adorned with yellow spirals, positioned on the left side. A large dark hand reaches from the right toward the central figure while four black hooded skeletal figures with red dripping liquid stand opposite.

687.title: Skeletal Procession
687.description: A surreal painting shows four identical women with purple skin, long green hair, and golden headdresses in profile, standing in a row. Behind them, four black skeletons with dripping red liquid emerge from their heads against a vibrant background of overlapping yellow, orange, and purple spirals.

689.title: Fate's Grasp
689.description: A surreal painting depicts four identical green-haired women in profile facing left, their long braided hair flowing into a giant black hand that reaches from the right. The hand manipulates several red-eyed skeletons connected by red threads, set against a dark cosmic background with glowing orbs and intricate patterns.

690.title: Green-haired Women and Black Hand
690.description: Four women with long green hair in progressive stages of intricate braiding and flowing locks are shown in profile facing right against a teal and purple background. A large black hand with yellow outlines reaches toward the foremost woman's face from the right side of the frame.

691.title: Cosmic Ocean Turtle
691.description: A vibrant surreal mural depicts an underwater scene with a large green sea turtle swimming near a spacesuit-clad astronaut standing on a grassy ledge, reaching toward floating black orbs containing miniature cosmic scenes. Below, two small figures walk a path through a green landscape while the background transitions from a sunlit coral reef with fish to a starry night sky.

692.title: Cosmic Turtle Odyssey
692.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large ornate sea turtle swimming through a split seascape that transitions into outer space, with an astronaut standing beside glowing orbs and coral reefs below.

694.title: Desert Wanderer and Red Mouse
694.description: A surreal desert scene features a tall, dark-skinned figure in a patterned robe walking away from a giant stylized eye in the sky that contains a smaller robed figure within its pupil. In the foreground, a bright red mouse sits on a vibrant, patterned green branch while a large ornate circular celestial body glows in the orange and pink sky above sand dunes.

693.title: Surreal Insect Beast
693.description: A large fantastical beetle-like creature with a glossy green body and curled antennae walks down an empty city street at night. Its segmented shell contains multiple stylized female faces in vibrant colors while a giant red spiked orb with yellow eyes and horns sits on its back.

695.title: Surreal Desert Vision
695.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman in a green patterned dress walking across orange desert dunes, her long shadow stretching behind her. She approaches a large red mouse perched on a leafy green branch while a giant stylized eye with a green eyelid watches from the sky, its iris containing a smaller scene of a figure under a glowing yellow orb with swirling patterns.

698.title: Desert Wanderer and Mouse
698.description: A woman in a green patterned robe walks barefoot across orange sand dunes under a starry night sky, leaving green swirling trails. In the foreground, a red mouse with white chest perches on a leafy green branch while a giant stylized eye with pink and green details watches from the purple sky beside a glowing yellow celestial body.

697.title: Desert Sorceress and Mouse
697.description: A surreal desert landscape features a robed figure with a purple patterned cloak walking along orange sand dunes, leaving footprints. In the foreground, a vibrant red mouse with intricate patterns perches on a green leafy branch, while a giant stylized face with large pink eyes dominates the purple sky above a glowing circular orb.

696.title: Surreal Desert Eye
696.description: A vibrant surreal painting merging a giant stylized human eye in the foreground with a desert landscape. A woman in a blue and gold hijab walks across orange dunes under a large glowing moon while a red rat perches on a leafy branch.

699.title: Surreal Desert Eye
699.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant stylized human eye emerging from orange sand dunes, its iris containing a tiny red mouse and a green moon. In the background a woman in a patterned green robe walks across the dunes carrying a lantern beneath a large ornate green moon in a purple twilight sky, while a large red mouse perches on a leafy branch in the foreground.

700.title: Surreal Desert Eye
700.description: A massive stylized human eye with a glowing pink iris and spiral patterns emerges from torn plaid fabric in the foreground of a vibrant desert landscape. A robed figure walks toward distant orange dunes beneath a large glowing purple moon in a fantastical sky filled with floating spiral symbols.

701.title: Surreal Desert Eye Scene
701.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an orange desert landscape with sand dunes under a dark blue sky. A large stylized green and purple eye with a pink iris emerges from the sand, containing a small red mouse inside, while another larger red mouse sits on a leafy green branch to the right, and a robed figure stands atop the eye observing a massive patterned yellow orb in the background.

702.title: Surreal Dreamscape with Mouse
702.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a robed figure with green hair walking across orange sand dunes while a large red mouse sits on a leafy branch. In the foreground, a stylized purple eye contains a smaller mouse inside its pink iris, with a patterned moon or orb floating in the starry sky.

705.title: Nuclear Fusion Surreal Portrait
705.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a green dog labeled 'STATIST' covered in bananas on the left, facing a blue human face with dripping colorful patterns on the right. Between them is a large red cracked eye with a nuclear fusion symbol for a pupil, surrounded by radiation warnings, atomic symbols, and spiral motifs.

703.title: Desert Wanderer and Red Mouse
703.description: A surreal desert landscape features a woman in a flowing purple robe and headscarf walking across orange sand dunes. In the sky, a giant stylized eye with a pink iris overlooks the scene while a large red mouse perches on a spiraling green plant branch.

704.title: Stasis Green Dog
704.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a lime green dog with intricate black patterns and a black collar labeled 'STASIS' on the left. To the right is a stylized human head with a blue face, colorful dripping paint effects, and a large red third eye above it set within a cracked circular frame.

706.title: Surreal Eye Fusion Portrait
706.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a green dog-like creature with intricate patterns on its body, its large eye replaced by a dripping red human eye. Adjacent is a person's face with green hair, yellow eyes, and colorful dripping paint effects, set against a dark cosmic background with circular motifs.

707.title: No Entry Psychedelic Portrait
707.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with blue and orange face paint, intricate geometric headwrap, and golden eyes, holding a weathered 'No Entry' sign. Beside her is a green patterned dog with dripping paint effects, set against a desert landscape with a large red sun and silhouetted figures.

708.title: Radioactive Vision
708.description: A surreal painting featuring a green dog with yellow dripping patterns on the left, facing a blue-skinned person with orange facial markings and dripping paint on the right. Between them is a large cracked radiation symbol containing a detailed red eye with radiating patterns.

709.title: Surreal Eye and Canine Portrait
709.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a lime green dog with intricate patterns and closed eyes on the left, positioned beside a large cracked red eye with a golden iris at the center. To the right is a blue-skinned human face with orange dripping patterns, yellow eyes, and hair composed of multiple green faces against a dark cosmic background with yellow circles.

710.title: Surreal Eye and Canine Portrait
710.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a lime green dog-like creature with large pointed ears facing a woman's face with golden eyes. A large central red eye with a fiery vertical pupil drips red and yellow liquid, surrounded by colorful flowers against a dark background.

711.title: Stasis Spell
711.description: A surreal painting featuring a blue-skinned woman's face with orange dripping paint and intricate line work, positioned beside a vibrant green dog with golden eyes. In the background, a large cracked red circular emblem contains a swirling hypnotic eye, surrounded by dripping paint, silhouetted figures, and glowing orbs.

712.title: Surreal Psychedelic Portrait
712.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a woman's face with multicolored tears, a large watchful eye above her forehead containing a smaller face, and a green patterned dog with red eyes to the right. The composition is set against a cracked circular background with intricate psychedelic patterns and vibrant dripping colors.

713.title: Psychedelic Eye Portrait
713.description: A surreal painting featuring a green patterned dog on the left facing a large cracked red and gold eye in the center that drips paint. On the right is a woman's face with blue skin covered in vibrant orange, yellow, and blue swirling patterns, set against a dark background with multiple circular framed portraits.

714.title: Psychedelic Green Dog Eye
714.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a large lime-green dog with black line patterns and a braided rope leash, positioned beside a massive red eye containing a smaller green dog silhouette within its pupil. The composition is filled with black and white hypnotic wavy lines, colorful concentric circles with silhouette portraits, and organic braided elements against a vibrant pink border.

715.title: Melancholy Shore Spirit
715.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a woman's face and shoulders emerging from stylized ocean waves, her skin painted in swirling blue and gold patterns with golden tears streaming down. The scene merges a turbulent sea with yellow flowers and flax on the left, a winding purple path through an autumnal forest on the right, and a blue sky above.

716.title: Portal to Enchanted Night
716.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a large stylized portrait of a woman with blue and yellow dripping patterns and golden eyes on the left. On the right, a smaller figure in a patterned coat stands before a glowing circular portal revealing a crescent moon, starry sky, and a distant castle amid swirling designs.

717.title: Psychedelic Dream Portal
717.description: A surreal painting depicts a bald figure in a patterned robe standing on a winding path in an alien forest. In the purple night sky, a glowing green crystal city floats within a circular portal framed by a crescent moon, while melting colorful forms drip from the top of the scene.

718.title: Stasis Dog and Figure
718.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a green dog with intricate black patterns and a spiked collar on the left, facing a blue human figure with yellow eyes on the right. Two large red eyes with dripping paint effects are positioned between and behind them against a dark background with yellow and purple abstract shapes.

719.title: Stasis Eye Dog Portrait
719.description: A surreal psychedelic portrait features a person's face and shoulders covered in intricate blue and orange face paint, positioned centrally against a dark background. To the right, a large green dog-like creature with a massive red eye and dripping red liquid from its face looms over the figure, surrounded by floating circular symbols and dripping paint effects.

720.title: Surreal Eye Portrait
720.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a split human face with golden eyes, one replaced by a large central red eye with a golden iris. A green dog-like creature with intricate patterns and a beaded collar nuzzles the face from the right, surrounded by dripping colorful paint, swirling motifs, and floating orbs against a dark background.

721.title: Surreal Eye and Canine Portrait
721.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large cracked eyeball with a red iris dripping blood on the left, a woman's face with multicolored paint dripping from her eyes and mouth in the center, and a green patterned dog with a red eye and blood-like drips on the right. The composition is set against a dark background with intricate circular patterns and red vein-like lines connecting the elements.

723.title: Surreal Eye and Dog Portrait
723.description: A surreal painting featuring a large cracked red eye with a yellow iris at the top center, dripping red liquid. To the left is a green dog-like creature with a detailed collar, facing a blue human face on the right whose head is filled with intricate circular patterns and small figures.

722.title: Stasis Surreal Portrait
722.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green dog with intricate patterns looking toward a large central red eye with a slit pupil, set within an ornate circular frame. To the right, a blue human head with detailed line work and dripping paint effects merges with the scene, surrounded by cosmic circles, small dog silhouettes, and colorful dripping elements against a dark background.

725.title: Psychedelic Eye and Dog Portrait
725.description: A surreal painting featuring a green dog with intricate patterns on the left and a blue-skinned woman's face with orange accents on the right. Above them looms a large cracked red eye with a star-like pupil, all set against a dark cosmic background with dripping paint effects and glowing yellow auras.

726.title: Psychedelic Street Portrait
726.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with a patterned headscarf and colorful paint dripping down her face, accompanied by a green dog covered in intricate circular patterns. They stand in a narrow European alleyway with colorful buildings, flowers, and floating vinyl records against a backdrop of psychedelic concentric circles.

727.title: Green Dog and Melting Eye
727.description: A surreal painting featuring a green patterned dog with closed eyes, its head overlapping a large cracked red circular motif containing a detailed bloodshot eye that drips yellow liquid. To the right is a blue and orange human figure with a melting face, glowing eyes, and a headdress filled with small green animal figures against a dark swirling background.

724.title: Stasis Eye Portrait
724.description: A surreal painting featuring a green dog with a yellow collar on the left and a blue human figure on the right, both adorned with dripping black human silhouettes. A large cracked red eye with an orange iris and yellow pupil dominates the center, with colorful drips flowing downward against a dark background with yellow circular patterns.

728.title: Surreal Desert Goddess
728.description: A metallic-skinned woman in profile with flowing, ornate hair composed of multiple colorful female faces and psychedelic patterns. She stands in a cracked desert landscape with a winding road leading toward distant mountains under a large red sun.

729.title: Psychedelic Desert Muse
729.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman in profile with her hair flowing as colorful, swirling psychedelic patterns that contain multiple embedded female faces. The scene features a winding desert road leading toward distant orange mountains under a large red sun in a fiery sky.

730.title: Cucumber Dream Swirl
730.description: A metallic green female bust in profile with closed eyes, her hair exploding into a vibrant swirling vortex of red, yellow, blue and pink paint. Realistic green cucumbers and slices surround her against a patterned background with multiple stylized female faces.

731.title: Psychedelic Desert Vision
731.description: A metallic-skinned woman with colorful spiral hair gazes right in profile, her form merging with a surreal desert landscape featuring a winding road, distant mountains, and a large red sun dominating the fiery sky.

733.title: Psychedelic Desert Trinity
733.description: Three green-skinned women with intricate spiral facial patterns and flowing multicolored hair merge into a winding road that leads toward a large red sun setting over purple mountains. The surreal landscape features fiery orange swirls on the left and a decorative swirling border with green leaves at the top.

732.title: Braided Unity
732.description: A vibrant, colorful painting depicts seven women of color in profile, their faces transitioning through a rainbow spectrum from warm red-orange to cool blue. They are interconnected by a large, metallic silver braid that loops across the composition against a dynamic background of swirling patterns, dripping paint, and circular motifs.

736.title: Surreal Cosmic Engineer
736.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant woman's face with purple skin and flowing multicolored hair made of swirling patterns, fish, and mechanical gears. In the foreground, two astronauts in purple spacesuits stand on a yellow-striped platform, one holding a glowing gear while mechanical fish and abstract shapes float in a teal cosmic background.

735.title: Psychedelic Smile Infinity
735.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring three stylized women with colorful spiral hair and patterned faces gazing toward a glowing green smiley face orb floating above reflective water. The fiery orange and red swirling sky contains an infinity symbol, floating smiley faces, lips, and dripping paint elements.

737.title: Steampunk Muse with Fish
737.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large stylized woman's face with intricate mechanical gear headdress flowing into colorful abstract patterns. In the foreground, two explorers in outdoor gear observe the scene while steampunk fish swim through the teal and magenta space.

738.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Vision
738.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring two figures in outdoor gear holding circular devices, standing beside a large patterned fish. A giant stylized woman's face with glowing green eyes and tentacle-like hair dominates the composition next to a cracked red planetary eye containing a smaller scene.

739.title: Steampunk Ocean Oracle
739.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant stylized woman's head with intricate mechanical headdress floating above dark blue waves. In the foreground, two figures in detailed diving suits stand in the water, one pointing upward while the other holds a glowing circular device, as a mechanical fish swims nearby.

740.title: Surreal Masked Woman
740.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with multicolored skin and bright blue eyes, her left eye replaced by a large cracked bloodshot eyeball with red drips. To her right floats a menacing colorful demon mask with horns, fangs, and a fierce expression, all surrounded by glowing green and purple swirling patterns against a black background.

741.title: Oni and Blue Creature
741.description: A surreal scene featuring a large, ornate red and gold Japanese oni mask with horns floating above a purple patterned floor. A small, round blue creature covered in green splotches stands beside it with an open-mouthed expression, set against a black background with swirling patterns and colorful silhouettes.

742.title: Hatching Chick and Blue Monster
742.description: A yellow chick with large blue eyes hatches from a colorful patterned egg on a circular rug, while a surprised blue spotted creature with a green bow tie stands beside it. In the background a giant bloodshot eye with a green iris looms over a psychedelic wall mural featuring stylized faces and swirling patterns.

743.title: Surreal Eyeball Nightmare
743.description: A blue cartoon creature with braided hair stands shocked on a patterned rug, facing a giant red cracked eyeball in a starry portal and a golden dripping skeleton reaching toward it. A small caterpillar-like creature looks up from a bubbly purple and orange mass in the foreground.

745.title: Psychedelic Visionary Eye
745.description: A surreal psychedelic composition featuring a large stylized human eye with a fiery iris and cracked texture. A green silhouetted profile faces the eye, connected by glowing tendrils and colorful flame-like floral forms emerging from soil against a cracked celestial background.

746.title: Eye of the Surreal Path
746.description: A green-skinned figure with flowing yellow hair walks along a winding path holding a red umbrella, approaching a massive cracked eyeball in the sky that contains a smaller silhouette of the same figure. The misty forest scene features two large flaming red flowers with swirling stems on either side of the path.

747.title: Surreal Night Path
747.description: A woman in a purple patterned coat holds a red umbrella while walking along a misty path toward ancient ivy-covered stone arches under a starry sky. In the foreground, a large circular panel displays vibrant stylized flowers with gold outlines, with a glowing mountain village visible through the arches in the distance.

748.title: Surreal Green Dog Dreamscape
748.description: A vibrant surreal scene features a giant green dog profile formed from swirling patterns and embedded trees, overlooking a winding golden path where a person in a colorful coat holds a red umbrella. In the background, a floating city of glowing yellow and pink buildings hovers above stone arches and misty forests under a starry purple sky.

750.title: Otter's Enchanted Realm
750.description: A detailed fantasy painting shows an otter standing on its hind legs gazing upward at two ethereal female faces formed from swirling green leaves and vines within a large glowing blue and purple circular portal. To the left, ancient stone arches overgrown with foliage lead toward a colorful hillside village topped by a castle under a starry night sky.

749.title: Otter and Dog in Fantasy Archway
749.description: A brown otter with large sparkling eyes peers over a brick archway adorned with flowers, facing a vibrant green dog covered in intricate patterns. In the background, a glowing yellow castle sits atop a hill under a starry night sky, with silhouetted figures walking along the arches.

751.title: Otter and Pink Slime Portal
751.description: An otter wearing a flower crown stands on a colorful swirling stone platform, reaching toward a large glowing pink slime-like blob containing small creatures. In the background, a fantastical floating city with pink mountains sits atop an elaborate series of vine-covered bridges and arches under a starry night sky.

753.title: Otter and Golden Egg
753.description: A vibrant blue and green otter balances a large golden egg on a flat surface while colorful swirling patterns emanate from its body. In the background, two silhouetted human profiles appear within the flowing psychedelic shapes against a brown backdrop.

752.title: Psychedelic Otter Vision
752.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an otter with a bright pink face and golden earring gazing upward at a glowing, bubbling pink fountain of spheres. Smaller otters appear in bubbles, on swirling patterns, and around the scene against a cosmic blue and green background.

754.title: Spiral Stasis
754.description: A large, smooth golden egg rests on a flat surface, casting a swirling blue shadow. Vibrant, stylized female profiles with intricate spiral patterns in their hair emerge from colorful, flowing ribbons that arc around the egg against a solid brown background.

755.title: Surreal Eye and Dog Portrait
755.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a green patterned dog on the left facing a large cracked red eye in the center with dripping paint. On the right is a woman's face with melting features and colorful hair containing multiple faces against a dark background with glowing orbs.

756.title: Stasis Eye Portrait
756.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork featuring a vibrant green dog wearing a yellow collar labeled STASIS on the left, a large cracked red eye with a golden iris in the center, and a blue-skinned human with swirling yellow patterns and dripping paint on the right.

758.title: Psychedelic Snake Tree
758.description: A large blue snake with intricate patterns smokes a cigarette while coiled in a swirling vortex of vibrant colors. A gnarled tree with hanging silhouette portraits grows from the snake's body against a starry cosmic background.

757.title: Surreal Green Dog Vision
757.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green dog with intricate patterns looking upward at a massive cracked red eye with blood-like drips. Swirling green ethereal forms with eyes and faces emerge from the dog, set against a turquoise background with smaller dogs and human profiles on the right.

759.title: Cosmic Serpent Vortex
759.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large blue snake with red eyes and a cigarette in its mouth, coiled around a gnarled tree of life. The serpent exhales purple smoke that forms a swirling rainbow vortex tunnel filled with floating orbs containing faces and symbols, set against a starry night sky.

761.title: Cosmic Memory Tree
761.description: An elderly mustached man with green glasses holds a gnarled black tree whose branches bear circular portraits of various people floating against a starry night sky. A large hypnotic spiral patterned in concentric rings of purple, green, and yellow swirls dramatically from the left side of the composition.

760.title: Spiral Serpent Vision
760.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large blue snake with red eyes coiled in a hypnotic spiral, smoking a cigarette. The composition is framed by a dark stylized tree with glowing orbs containing faces and surrounded by multiple stylized Black women with ornate hairstyles arranged in a circular pattern.

762.title: Dreamweaver with Dog
762.description: An elderly man with gray hair, a mustache and glasses sits in a tree holding a glowing orb while a bright green dog with a collar stands beside him. A large spiderweb filled with dreamcatchers and floating orbs stretches across the branches of the stylized tree against a vibrant cosmic background.

763.title: Psychedelic Canine Vision
763.description: A vibrant green dog with yellow patterns looks upward as a radiant burst of light emanates from its head, releasing a stream of colorful smoke and four stylized female faces into a cosmic background. To the right, a twisted tree with glowing orbs and circular portraits grows from the scene, connected by a net-like structure under a starry sky.

765.title: Psychedelic City Eruption
765.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four women in profile with green, purple, and pink skin standing by a river that reflects the scene. In the background, a stylized erupting volcano shoots a rainbow beam into a radiant sun surrounded by concentric circles, while lightning strikes a futuristic city skyline under swirling green and purple skies.

766.title: Cosmic Star Weaver
766.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a purple-skinned woman with long flowing purple hair reaching upward to touch a glowing green star. Behind her, a cracked red planet, lightning-filled stormy sky, futuristic city skyline with a large orange spiral sun, and numerous floating orbs and comets fill the scene over reflective water.

768.title: Melting Octopus Cityscape
768.description: A large blue octopus with sad eyes and dripping texture dominates the foreground, its tentacles framing a circular portal showing a mountain landscape at sunset. In the background, a futuristic city with skyscrapers and construction cranes sits across a body of water under a vibrant, colorful sky with a large setting sun.

767.title: Cosmic Mindscape
767.description: A surreal painting depicts a silhouetted human figure with an exposed brain reaching toward a glowing green orb containing a star. Behind the figure is a large circular window revealing a vibrant landscape with colorful mountains, a city skyline, a bridge over reflective water, and a starry cosmic sky.

769.title: Serpent's Eternal Cycle
769.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large dark blue snake with golden patterns coiled in the foreground against a cracked red backdrop. Two circular scenes are visible: an upper one depicting a sunrise over purple mountains with green figures, and a lower one showing a glowing city skyline with bridges, cranes, and water reflections under an orange moon.

770.title: Serpentine Cosmic Cityscape
770.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large ornate domed building with a spire at the center of a futuristic city, framed within a circular border filled with swirling colorful patterns. A massive blue and green snake with yellow eyes coils on the right side, set against a dramatic sunset over mountains on the left and a starry night sky above.

771.title: Psychedelic Desert Cityscape
771.description: A vibrant surreal landscape featuring three stylized women's profiles in the foreground with elaborate headdresses and colorful patterns. In the background, a fantastical domed city with a tall spire sits before a large red sun, surrounded by swirling skies, winding golden paths, and orange mountains.

772.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Eye
772.description: A surreal painting featuring two cartoon cats, one yellow and one blue, standing amid flames on the left side. On the right, a large mechanical eye with a red iris and metallic tentacles emerges from fire and smoke, while a glowing green smiley sun with orbiting colorful rings and floating smiley faces dominates the upper center against a dark, cosmic background.

774.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Emojis
774.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a large winking smiley face orb with colorful rings and dripping slime, surrounded by stylized female figures on the left and two neon cat emojis on a fiery canvas to the right. Below, a mechanical fiery orb with tentacle-like appendages emerges from flames and dark roots.

775.title: Cosmic Eye and Spectral Cats
775.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant bloodshot eyeball with a fiery red iris emerging from cracked earth with dark tendrils, emitting swirling green and purple galaxy patterns. In the foreground, an orange patterned cat with mismatched red and green eyes sits beside a larger white and green cat with glowing green eyes, both staring forward against a cosmic background of nebulae and floating colorful faces.

776.title: Psychedelic Cat Kraken
776.description: A surreal psychedelic painting depicts two colorful cats partially submerged in stylized blue waves. To their right, a massive biomechanical eye with a toothy maw and writhing tentacles emerges from a fiery underworld beneath the sea, while the burning sky swirls with flames, eyes, and crescent moons.

777.title: Psychedelic Eye Goddess
777.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a stylized woman's profile with elaborate, swirling multicolored hair and green eyes, positioned beside a large cracked eyeball with a fiery red-orange spiral iris. Tentacle-like roots extend from the eye across a dark, glowing landscape, while a smaller inset square shows two cartoonish neon cats, one yellow and one purple, intertwined against a bright pink and orange background.

779.title: Robot, Woman and Artist
779.description: A vibrant digital painting featuring three figures against a red background: a green retro robot with glowing yellow eyes and blue braided pigtails on the left, a stylized woman with elaborate blue and orange swirled updo hair, yellow eyes and blue lips in the center, and an older man with a mustache, beret and glasses holding a cigarette on the right.

780.title: Ouroboros Dream
780.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts a woman with elaborate blue swirling hair and blue lips alongside an older man wearing a beret and round glasses. An orange dragon forms an infinity loop around them while a red-cloaked figure holds a glowing orb, all set against a colorful spiral background.

781.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Sorceress
781.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a large green and purple mushroom with a long orange dragon-like serpent coiled around its stem and a stylized woman's face. In the background, a robed wizard stands atop the mushroom holding a glowing orb under a starry purple sky with aurora lights.

778.title: Psychedelic Cat Painting
778.description: An older man with a black beret and glasses holds up a vibrant rectangular painting featuring two stylized cats, one green and one pink, surrounded by flames. To the right, a large stylized woman's face with multicolored swirling psychedelic hair gazes toward the artwork against a chaotic, colorful background with bubbles and patterns.

784.title: Neon Tears in Psychedelic Room
784.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with black horns and multicolored dripping tears standing in a vibrant orange room covered in psychedelic murals. A glowing circular portal with rainbow rings floats behind her against a starry purple sky, with her reflection visible on the glossy pink floor.

782.title: Infinity Dragon Muse
782.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant orange dragon forming an infinity loop with its scaled body. Atop the dragon stands a red-cloaked wizard holding a glowing staff while the dragon's head merges with a large stylized woman's face featuring flowing blue curly hair, set against a futuristic city skyline at sunset with hot air balloons and cars speeding on a highway below.

785.title: Psychedelic Woman and Cat
785.description: A vibrant street-art style portrait of a woman's face with intricate black line work, colorful dripping paint effects, and glowing yellow eyes. She is accompanied by a stylized green cat covered in swirling patterns, set against a white background with floating multicolored orbs and abstract splatters.

787.title: Psychedelic Green Dog
787.description: A vibrant green dog covered in intricate black spiral patterns stands in profile facing right. A purple slime creature with large green eyes, a toothy grin, and dripping ooze is wrapped around its neck while a swirling galaxy portal with stars and constellations appears to the right.

788.title: Mystic Dog and Cloaked Figure
788.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a glowing green dog covered in intricate yellow patterns gazing at a large cosmic portal filled with stars, nebulae, and floating spirits. To the left, a hooded figure in a starry cloak holds a dripping candle with a green halo behind them, set against a dark mountain range under a colorful night sky.

786.title: Stasis Spell
786.description: Psychedelic cosmic illustration featuring a large green dog-like creature with intricate patterns and a glowing yellow eye inside a starry bubble. Surrounding it are smaller bubbles with twin female profiles, paw prints, flowers, and repeated dog motifs against a purple gradient background.

789.title: Cosmic Green Dog
789.description: A vibrant green dog with a yellow constellation collar stands in profile gazing right, its body filled with a swirling galaxy of stars, nebulae and constellations. The psychedelic background features floating dog faces, circular portraits of a woman with an afro, dripping paint effects and celestial patterns.

791.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Portrait
791.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with vibrant blue skin on the left side and a black silhouette with horns on the right. Her face features intricate glowing patterns, while a large pink circular portal on her cheek reveals a starry night with three silhouetted figures; the reflective floor and graffiti-covered walls create a trippy, immersive environment.

790.title: Surreal Eye and Dog Portrait
790.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green dog with ornate patterns and a beaded collar on the left, facing a large central red eye with intricate designs and dripping blood-like red paint. To the right is a multicolored human face with melting features and multiple smaller faces within the hair, all set against a dark cosmic background with yellow cracks and the repeating text 'EYE' around the central eye.

792.title: Surreal Eye and Horses
792.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman's face with short dark hair and colorful markings, merging with a large cracked stone eye that drips red liquid from above. Two identical luminous green horses with yellow manes gallop on either side against a cosmic background of swirling patterns and celestial motifs.

793.title: Surreal Eye of Judgment
793.description: A surreal painting features a blue-skinned woman's face with orange eyes and colorful spiral patterns, with dripping paint effects. To the right, a large blood-red eye with concentric circles drips red liquid above four hooded skeletal figures with glowing red eyes standing in a row.

794.title: Skeletal Watchers of the Eye
794.description: A group of black skeletons draped in flowing red liquid stands at the edge of a reflective body of water, one skeleton reaching toward a giant cracked stone eye with a yellow iris and skull pupil that drips red. The surreal night landscape features a red sun or moon, colorful swirling skies, and ornate red circular symbols with multiple eyes that also drip red, all perfectly mirrored in the water below.

795.title: Psychedelic Skull Overlake
795.description: A massive green skull with purple swirling sunglasses dominates a surreal lakeside landscape, its top cracked open to reveal a glowing yellow skull emerging with green eyes. In the foreground, four black skeletal figures with red glowing eyes and patterns stand in red swirling liquid, reflecting in the water beneath a fiery red-orange sky with a large ornate red circular mandala.

796.title: Green Dog and Psychedelic Woman
796.description: A vibrant surreal artwork depicts a lime-green dog with an oversized red third eye on its forehead facing a green-skinned woman in profile. Her elaborate blue hair is composed of swirling curls containing multiple faces, symbols, and patterns against a radiating orange and red background.

797.title: Cyclops Oracle
797.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face with vibrant orange skin and blue swirling hair, dominated by a large central red eye with a vertical pupil. Smaller stylized faces emerge from the hair on the left against a radiating orange background with red cracks and spiral patterns.

798.title: Surreal Green Dog Portrait
798.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a lime green dog wearing a gold beaded necklace, its head turned in profile. A large red wax seal with a dripping human eye is affixed to the dog's face while a blue and orange human face with intricate patterns appears beside it against a dark background filled with floating faces and symbols.

799.title: Neon Demon Portal
799.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork featuring a large stylized female face with blue skin, yellow eyes, pink horns and melting pixelated patterns. A black silhouetted devil figure with glowing eyes stands in the foreground holding a small orb, with a fiery yellow portal containing human silhouettes behind it. The walls and reflective floor are covered in vibrant graffiti and symbols under a swirling cosmic sky.

783.title: Canine Oracle Vision
783.description: A surreal painting depicts a green canine with dripping patterns facing a large stylized eye containing a black dog silhouette flanked by two red human figures. To the right, a blue-skinned woman's face with orange drips and intricate golden head patterns stares forward against a dark cosmic background filled with glowing circles.

800.title: Cosmic Woman with Glowing Orb
800.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman in a black off-shoulder dress with a colorful melting face and long flowing hair streaked in blue, green, and purple. She holds a glowing red orb while standing beside a vibrant lime-green dog covered in intricate patterns, set against a psychedelic alien landscape with spire-like rock formations under a starry purple sky.

801.title: Surreal Melting Eye
801.description: A large stylized human eye dominates the composition, its iris a swirling pattern of green and yellow with a black pupil containing a star-like glint. The eye is partially overlapped by a red-toned half-face with a detailed red iris, surrounded by dripping paint effects, blue abstract loops, and smaller inset faces within circular motifs.

803.title: Psychedelic Spiral Eye
803.description: A surreal close-up portrait of a person's face in profile with a large central eye featuring a swirling green and black spiral pupil. Multiple translucent bubbles float across the composition, some containing miniature faces with swirling psychedelic hair, set against a vibrant patterned background with dynamic red streaks.

802.title: Psychedelic Eye Portal
802.description: A large surreal painting dominated by a massive green and yellow spiral iris eye with a black pupil. A smaller cracked red eye with dripping paint sits below it while a green female profile figure emerges from the upper eyelid surrounded by swirling blue and green patterns.

804.title: Wolf and Triple Goddess
804.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring a large green wolf with yellow eyes on the right, its head overlapping three stylized female profiles facing left. Intricate blue and green swirling patterns, circles, dripping effects, and symbolic motifs fill the composition against a multicolored background.

805.title: Cosmic Eye Theater
805.description: A surreal painting depicts a massive stylized all-seeing eye dominating the night sky above an ornate circular amphitheater. An audience of women with elaborate headdresses sits in the stands, gazing upward as the eye weeps green liquid and radiates golden light from its floral iris.

806.title: Celestial Witch Over City
806.description: A witch in ornate black and green robes stands on a balcony overlooking a body of water, holding a glowing staff. Behind her, a large audience watches as a red moon and golden sun dominate a vibrant, concentric celestial sky above a modern city skyline with construction cranes.

807.title: Surreal Eye Metropolis
807.description: A large surreal painted eye dominates the composition, its green iris filled with swirling patterns and a miniature cityscape. Silhouetted figures walk along a bridge-like structure formed by the lower eyelid while ruined buildings emerge from the upper eyelid against a fiery red and yellow sky.

808.title: Psychedelic Eye Portrait
808.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a woman's face in profile, dominated by a large, detailed green eye with a swirling pattern in the iris. The composition features intricate circular motifs, dripping paint effects, and stylized female faces emerging from swirling psychedelic patterns in yellow, blue, and green.

809.title: Cosmic All-Seeing Eye
809.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a massive green and gold eye with a cosmic iris floating in a celestial theater. Below, rows of women in ornate historical attire and headpieces gaze upward toward the eye and a radiant sun with a face set against a starry purple sky.

811.title: Cosmic Donut Portal
811.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring three green-skinned female figures with halos on the left side, gazing toward a large swirling cosmic donut portal on the right. The donut has purple icing, golden celestial patterns, and a bright star at its center, with a mountain peak and glowing orb rising above a swirling green and blue vortex in the middle.

810.title: Lotus Eye Dreamscape
810.description: A surreal painting of a giant human eye whose iris contains a vibrant green pond with blooming pink lotus flowers, lily pads, and flowing aquatic plants. The upper eyelid and eyebrow area are decorated with intricate psychedelic patterns, colorful orbs, and small human faces emerging from the water below.

812.title: Sphinx Cat and Serpent Kiss
812.description: A stylized sphynx cat with a large hypnotic green and yellow spiral eye kisses the face of a woman in profile. The vibrant magenta background is decorated with colorful paw prints on the left and a coiling blue and green serpent pattern on the right.

815.title: Psychedelic Fleur-de-Lis Eye
815.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large stylized green eye with swirling patterns and fleur-de-lis motifs inside the iris. The composition includes dripping paint effects, blue ornamental swirls, and a large yellow-green fleur-de-lis against a purple background with text elements.

814.title: Psychedelic Visionary Eye
814.description: A large central green eye with intricate peacock-like patterns in the iris, a fiery orange and black flame-like pupil, and a blue sclera. Surrounding the eye are multiple floating orbs containing silhouetted figures and tree motifs against swirling, vibrant psychedelic patterns in warm and cool tones.

813.title: Surreal Eye Metropolis
813.description: A large close-up portrait of a woman's face with her right eye transformed into a swirling green and yellow vortex containing a miniature cityscape, stars, and floating figures. The background features a fiery red and orange sky above damaged high-rise buildings, while her hair is filled with intricate yellow spiral patterns.

816.title: Fleur-de-Lis Vision
816.description: A surreal forest scene features a large stylized green eye with a yellow fleur-de-lis iris at the center. To the left, four silhouetted women in profile with colorful hair stand near a large purple banner displaying a golden fleur-de-lis, all framed by dark trees and swirling green mist.

817.title: Fleur-de-Lis Vision
817.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork centered on an ornate golden fleur-de-lis radiating bright light. Swirling colorful patterns and stylized female figures with green skin and golden halos orbit the central symbol against a deep purple background.

818.title: Fleur-de-Lis Vision
818.description: A surreal painting featuring a large stylized green and gold fleur-de-lis with embedded faces on a purple orb, set against a misty forest of dark trees. A massive ornate green eye with a swirling galaxy pupil dominates the upper right, while three women with elaborate golden headdresses appear in profile below, all rendered in a vibrant psychedelic style.

819.title: Psychedelic Forest Eye
819.description: A surreal profile portrait of a purple-skinned figure whose large eye contains a swirling green forest with trees, vines, and glowing orbs. Smaller translucent faces and cosmic purple nebulae appear in the background alongside intricate glowing patterns.

820.title: Spiral Fish Time Vortex
820.description: Two explorers in futuristic blue and green suits with goggles and backpacks stand on the left, observing a swirling blue vortex. Within the vortex are mechanical fish with gears and patterns swimming in a circular formation, surrounded by glowing yellow dotted rings and small floral motifs.

822.title: Moon and Flowing Faces
822.description: A large anthropomorphic moon with a serene face and yellow-green eyes occupies the upper left against a solid pink background. Colorful swirling ribbons of blue, teal, and magenta flow from the moon's right side, containing multiple stylized women's faces in green, yellow, and purple tones with intricate spiral and circular patterns.

823.title: Psychedelic Fish Dreamscape
823.description: A vibrant, multicolored fish with intricate patterns swims through a surreal underwater and sky scene. A floating green island with a small house sits in the upper left while a massive rainbow spiral with text curves around the composition.

825.title: Psychedelic Cat Reflection
