1048.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts multiple stylized female profiles with green, orange, and blonde hair, each enclosed in transparent bubbles connected by glowing dotted lines. The figures float against a psychedelic cosmic background of swirling colorful nebulae, stars, and orbiting rings.

1049.title: Psychedelic Blue Moon Face
1049.description: A large, glossy blue spherical face with glowing yellow eyes and a wide orange smile dominates the composition. It is surrounded by smaller orbiting blue spheres containing miniature faces, set against a vibrant swirling background of concentric rainbow patterns and hanging decorative elements.

1051.title: Cosmic Triple Goddess
1051.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting features three stylized female profiles with purple, pink, and green skin inside a large teal circular portal resembling a planet with rings. The colorful background displays swirling orange and purple patterns, stars, and floating blue orbs against a pink and yellow gradient.

1052.title: Coastal Bloom Reverie
1052.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts dark-skinned women with colorful hair and headwraps emerging from a stylized ocean wave crashing against a rocky shore. The foreground overflows with large pink peonies, yellow flowers, and green foliage under a radiant sun with pink and yellow sky.

1053.title: Astronaut in Psychedelic Garden
1053.description: A white-suited astronaut with a transparent helmet revealing a woman's face stands atop a glowing orange cracked orb, surrounded by enormous pink peonies, yellow flowers, and swirling cosmic patterns. To the right, a crystal sphere contains a miniature duplicate scene of the astronaut on a pebble beach with distant cliffs.

1054.title: Cosmic Blue Creature Revelation
1054.description: A large blue furry creature with wide eyes and a beaded necklace stands on a patterned rug, surrounded by a burst of colorful orbs containing miniature scenes. A woman in a yellow patterned dress stands before it with hands clasped, gazing up in wonder against a vibrant psychedelic backdrop of swirling galaxies and layered rainbow patterns.

1055.title: Surreal Cosmic Garden Orb
1055.description: A vibrant surreal painting features two large pink peonies flanking a transparent crystal sphere that reveals a pebble beach leading to a rainbow cliff under a glowing sun. The upper portion shows stylized figures with elaborate headdresses floating among red swirling skies, grey clouds, and lush foliage with berries and flowers.

1056.title: Floral Hand and Muse
1056.description: A surreal painting featuring a large realistic hand emerging from the bottom left, adorned with pink peonies and yellow flowers. To the right, a woman's profile with elaborate curly hair filled with floral patterns stands beside a translucent duplicate figure with hands clasped in prayer.

1057.title: Surreal Floral Silhouettes
1057.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring two large human profile silhouettes facing each other, filled with intricate green and gold Celtic-inspired patterns. The composition is surrounded by oversized pink peonies, orange daisies, yellow flowers, clusters of red and green grapes, all set against a dramatic red and purple sky with golden celestial orbs and swirling decorative lines.

1058.title: Flora Goddess Portrait
1058.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a lime-green woman in profile with an elaborate headdress of oversized flowers, grapes, and leaves. Her shoulders and chest are adorned with a garland of pink peonies, daisies, orange lilies, and clusters of red and green grapes against a dramatic swirling sky.

1059.title: Sootsprite in Peony Garden
1059.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring three overlapping stylized female faces in profile with intricate yellow and purple patterns, surrounded by large pink peonies and smaller yellow flowers against a dark background. A large black grinning creature with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth, reminiscent of a Studio Ghibli soot sprite, appears in the upper right amid floating circular symbols.

1061.title: Cosmic Silhouette Vision
1061.description: A black silhouette of a woman wearing a patterned headwrap stands in profile, gazing toward a vibrant multicolored explosion of light and particles. She is surrounded by concentric celestial circles, swirling cosmic patterns, and rainbow-colored wave forms against a deep blue starry background.

1060.title: Masked Muse with Grapes
1060.description: A surreal painting depicts a bald Black woman wearing an ornate pink and gold mask, touching it with one hand while an orange flower adorns her head. She stands behind a white marble ledge overflowing with large pink peonies, orange marigolds, green and red grape clusters, and scattered petals against a vibrant green background with abstract circular patterns and a dramatic red cloudy sky.

1062.title: Astronaut and Cosmic Swirl
1062.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts an astronaut in a white spacesuit with a golden visor sitting atop a glowing green and yellow circular mound. The astronaut reaches toward a large green spiral orb floating in a starry purple sky while a colorful, patterned cosmic wave flows around them and a second figure appears in the lower left.

1064.title: Burning Hearted Figure
1064.description: A surreal red humanoid figure with a large single reptilian eye for a head stands amid swirling psychedelic patterns and flames. The figure holds a large dripping pink heart containing two green female faces facing each other, set against a dark apocalyptic cityscape background.

1065.title: Cosmic Frog Enlightenment
1065.description: A vibrant green frog with intricate spiral patterns and large purple eyes sits on a vine, holding a glowing yellow orb. The surreal composition contrasts a light side filled with classical female faces, yellow flowers and green foliage against a dark cosmic background of swirling purple nebulae and stars.

1063.title: Cosmic Reflection
1063.description: A silhouetted woman with an afro of intricate mandala patterns stands in a pond filled with lily pads and two reflective spheres. Swirling rainbow waves and a radiant burst of colorful orbs emanate from a bright central sun against a starry green and purple cosmic sky.

1066.title: Cosmic Green Procession
1066.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts two glowing green horses galloping left to right across a swirling, colorful wave-like foreground. Behind them, four green-skinned women with elaborate headwraps and jewelry walk in profile, each balancing a large blue sphere on their head, set against a psychedelic sky filled with exploding starburst patterns and floating orbs.

1067.title: Frog Heart and Shadow
1067.description: A vibrant green frog with large hypnotic spiral eyes sits atop a large dripping pink heart. To the right, a black horned devil silhouette with glowing pink eyes stands before a group of purple-skinned women with golden headbands against a starry cosmic background.

1068.title: Stasis 16.9 Heart Portrait
1068.description: A vibrant painting featuring three green-skinned faces with purple curly hair sharing one head inside a large dripping pink heart. Diagonal blue and teal brushstrokes cross the composition against a deep red background with small golden figures and spiral patterns.

1069.title: Psychedelic Frog Sorceress
1069.description: A vibrant green frog with purple and yellow markings, braided hair, and ornate goggles floats in a cosmic void. To its right, a black silhouette of a horned female figure with glowing eyes holds a small orb, while a large red tentacled eyeball creature with an iris shaped like a keyhole appears in the foreground.

1070.title: Frog Heart Sorceress
1070.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green frog with large psychedelic eyes holding a small pink heart, nestled inside a larger dripping purple heart. To the right, a robed sorceress with elaborate face markings reaches toward the heart against a cosmic background featuring a glowing sun, stars, and colorful paint splatters.

1072.title: Mysterious Trio with Golden Coins
1072.description: An older man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and glasses stands beside a young blonde woman with a serious expression, a black bird perched on his shoulder. To their right, a shadowy horned devil figure with glowing pink eyes emerges from a purple cosmic background as golden coins and swirling patterns float throughout the scene.

1071.title: Dual-Faced Psyche
1071.description: A surreal profile portrait shows a blonde woman with flowing golden hair on the right side and a black demonic silhouette on the left. The demon features a large central red and yellow eye, sharp teeth, and writhing tentacles adorned with floating eye coins against a swirling purple and red vortex background.

1073.title: Mushroom Sorcerer Silhouette
1073.description: A surreal silhouette of a horned figure whose head is a large red spotted mushroom cap with dripping elements and small yellow mushroom faces. The figure's body contains glowing green psychedelic patterns, smaller mushroom figures at the base, set against a starry purple forest background with swirling trees and a full moon.

1074.title: Psychedelic Shaman Portrait
1074.description: A surreal portrait of an elderly man with a fedora hat and glowing blue eyes, positioned beside a large black devil silhouette with horns and a tail. Vibrant blue flowers with yellow centers and a green bird surround the figure against a purple cosmic background with colorful splatters.

1077.title: Elder in Cosmic Bubbles
1077.description: A surreal portrait of an elderly man with glasses and a dark green fedora, his right hand raised in a stopping gesture. He is surrounded by a dense field of translucent blue bubbles containing stylized faces, figures, and patterns, with a small yellow bird perched near his shoulder.

1076.title: Fleur-de-Lis Silhouette
1076.description: A black silhouette of a horned figure with a glowing pink eye stands against a vibrant purple and pink cosmic background. The figure features a large ornate golden fleur-de-lis on its chest, surrounded by glowing blue and cyan starburst floral patterns and faint green outlined faces.

1075.title: Dual-Faced Cosmic Bear
1075.description: A surreal split-face portrait of a bear, with the left side brown and featuring a man's profile, and the right side white wearing round glasses and a mustache. A small yellow bird perches on the bear's right shoulder while it wears a large ornate hat decorated with celestial symbols.

1078.title: Demonic Silhouette
1078.description: A black silhouette of a female demon with horns, glowing pink eye, and a spaded tail stands in profile against a vibrant abstract background. The backdrop features a colorful paint-splatter composition with overlapping circles, dripping effects, and a collage of stylized female faces in retro pop-art colors.

1080.title: Mystic Trio Portrait
1080.description: A surreal painting featuring three figures against a cosmic background: a bald woman with yellow spiral markings and yellow eyes, a red-haired woman with similar facial patterns in the foreground, and a black horned devil silhouette with glowing pink eyes and a curved tail behind them.

1079.title: Silhouette of Cosmic Muse
1079.description: A black silhouette of a female figure with cat-ear headpiece and glowing pink eyes stands on the left, facing right. From her form erupts a vibrant explosion of colorful paint splashes, swirling lines, and a procession of five stylized female faces in green and yellow hues against a starry purple cosmos.

1081.title: Surreal Industrial Nightmare
1081.description: A bald purple-skinned woman with glowing green eyes and red patterned clothing stares intently from the foreground. Behind her, a polluted turquoise landscape filled with tiny human figures connects via glowing lines to a massive dark factory complex belching black smoke, flanked by demonic horned silhouettes under an orange apocalyptic sky.

1082.title: Ouroboros Sorceress
1082.description: A bald, purple-skinned woman with green eyes stands beside a black horned silhouette figure with glowing pink eyes. An orange and yellow serpentine dragon with spiral patterns forms an infinity loop around both figures, while a small red-cloaked wizard stands on the dragon's body holding a staff.

1083.title: Psychedelic Bear Portal
1083.description: A large split-face teddy bear head floats above a glowing circular portal on a reflective pink floor. The left side is dark brown with stars and a winking eye, while the right side is pale with a glowing blue eye, set against orange walls decorated with green spiral trees and paw prints.

1084.title: Celestial Women in Harmony
1084.description: Three women in profile with yellow, green, and purple skin stand side by side facing right, adorned with intricate head coverings and patterns. They are surrounded by a vibrant cosmic scene featuring a large turquoise and yellow mandala sun, floating zodiac constellation circles, and flowing orange and purple ribbons against a starry night sky.

1085.title: Cosmic Harmony
1085.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four women of different skin tones and elaborate hairstyles in profile, facing a radiant circular cosmic mandala that emits green and blue light. Swirling colorful energy patterns, bubbles, and starry space fill the background in a psychedelic composition.

1086.title: Man with Bird and Bubbles
1086.description: A detailed portrait of an elderly man wearing a wide-brimmed hat decorated with small yellow figures, round glasses, and a tweed jacket. A vibrant green and yellow bird with intricate patterns perches on his shoulder while he extends his right hand forward, surrounded by numerous translucent bubbles containing various symbolic figures against a dark blue background.

1087.title: Surreal Geometric Portrait
1087.description: A triptych-style surreal painting features a bald, purple-skinned woman in profile on the left with green eyes. The central panel shows the same figure with a face divided into pink, yellow, and magenta sections, wearing a patterned yellow collar and holding a small red sphere, while the right panel depicts a geometric landscape with small human figures on colorful pathways.

1088.title: Psychedelic Serpent Hand
1088.description: A detailed black and white human hand with palm facing forward is positioned in the foreground against a vibrant, surreal background. A multicolored psychedelic snake coils around the wrist and fingers, its body covered in intricate patterns while its head extends toward the upper right, surrounded by floating colorful orbs containing stylized faces and abstract designs.

1090.title: Psychedelic Serpent Detective
1090.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant multicolored snake with iridescent green, purple, and orange scales winding through a dark space filled with floating translucent bubbles. Inside the bubbles are stylized portraits of people, while a trenchcoat-wearing detective holding a gun and briefcase stands near a human skull at the snake's base.

1089.title: Praying Mantis Oracle
1089.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green praying mantis with oversized glossy compound eyes holding a detailed human hand in its spined foreleg. The background is a swirling psychedelic composition of yellow question marks, abstract faces, and organic patterns in multiple hues.

1091.title: Dragon Infinity Sorceress
1091.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a woman in a flowing red cloak riding an orange serpentine dragon that forms an infinity symbol. The woman holds a glowing blue orb while the dragon breathes multiple exploding starburst energy patterns against a background of hot air balloons and rolling purple hills.

1092.title: Psychedelic Serpent Aurora
1092.description: A vibrant, multicolored serpent with iridescent scales coils through a surreal mountain landscape, its body glowing with rainbow hues while shooting orange beams from its eyes. Above, an aurora borealis swirls with green and purple energy, containing floating circular portraits of stylized female faces with intricate headdresses.

1093.title: Trinity Heart
1093.description: A vibrant painting features three stylized female faces in profile and three-quarter view sharing one head, enclosed within a large dripping pink heart. The composition is set against a dynamic background of sweeping blue, teal, and deep red brushstrokes with decorative spiral patterns and paint drips.

1094.title: Cosmic Dreamer
1094.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts an astronaut in an orange spacesuit sitting on a purple floral cliff, reaching toward a large green ringed planet. Swirling colorful smoke filled with flowers and four stylized women's faces in profile emerges from the left against a starry purple space background.

1096.title: Dragon and Astronaut
1096.description: A detailed fantasy illustration shows a large purple and gold dragon with ornate patterns facing an astronaut in a white spacesuit. The astronaut sits on a swirling yellow cloud, extending a hand toward the dragon against a cosmic background featuring a large green and yellow planet with orbiting figures.

1095.title: Cosmic Silhouette Trio
1095.description: Three stylized female profiles in purple, lime green, and dark green stand against a vibrant cosmic background with swirling orange patterns and starry constellations. Cracks resembling lightning or fractured glass overlay the entire composition, intersecting colorful wavy bands and celestial elements.

1097.title: Cosmic Serpent Enigma
1097.description: A surreal painting depicts a bald woman wearing an ornate pink and yellow mask, her body entwined by a large iridescent green snake with dripping yellow patterns. In the foreground, an astronaut sits on a glowing spiral platform while a green ringed planet featuring a face looms in the background amid swirling smoke and symbols.

1098.title: Dragon Eye Surreal Portrait
1098.description: A vibrant psychedelic close-up of a woman's face dominated by a large magenta eye containing a black dragon and swirling patterns. A detailed green and gold Eastern dragon with purple eyes floats beside it against a cosmic starry background with colorful swirls.

1099.title: Dragon and Cloud Spirit
1099.description: A dark blue dragon with golden horns and yellow eyes coils through purple clouds while facing a cute pink and blue cloud creature with a braided topknot and a smiling face. They appear against a vibrant green circular background with blue spikes and a magenta border filled with yellow decorative swirls.

1100.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Muse
1100.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a giant pink woman's face in profile dominates the composition, her large eye containing a swirling galaxy. Below her, four green female figures emerge amid intricate swirling patterns, keyhole symbols, and a colorful cosmic background filled with stars.

1102.title: Psychedelic Split Eye Portrait
1102.description: A surreal close-up of a human eye with the iris dramatically split by a white lightning bolt. The left iris is vibrant green with flowing patterns, while the right is bright pink with swirling motifs, all within a stylized face profile surrounded by colorful abstract shapes.

1101.title: Psychedelic Eye and Heart
1101.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large stylized green eye with a multicolored iris containing small female faces, positioned beside a dripping heart shape filled with colorful female profiles. The composition is set against a dynamic background of swirling patterns, drips, and concentric circles in warm and cool hues.

1103.title: Psychedelic Heart Flow
1103.description: A vibrant abstract painting featuring a central dripping purple heart surrounded by flowing, swirling lines in bright colors. Stylized female faces with intricate circular patterns emerge from the colorful organic shapes against a white background.

1104.title: Cosmic Satellite Vision
1104.description: A vibrant surreal illustration features a large green satellite dish with swirling patterns projecting ethereal green energy streams and a silhouette of a woman holding a brain-like orb. In the foreground, a woman in a patterned jumpsuit stands on a winding dragon-like path, reaching toward the cosmic signals amid stars, constellations, and floating spaceships.

1106.title: Musical White Cat Portrait
1106.description: A white long-haired cat with yellow eyes sits calmly in the foreground while a vibrant, stylized female profile with closed eyes emerges from swirling psychedelic patterns in the background. Flowing musical notation, treble clefs, and colorful notes dance throughout the composition amid purple, pink, and green spirals.

1105.title: Mosaic Bear Vision
1105.description: A vibrant mosaic-style bear head dominates the left side of the canvas, its face composed of multicolored tiles in green, purple, pink, and yellow with large circular eyes. Swirling, colorful ribbons of paint flow from its head toward the right, containing stylized human figures and faces amid splashes of orange, blue, and green.

1107.title: Cosmic Dragon Sorceress
1107.description: A green-skinned woman with flowing black hair stands in profile wearing a vibrant yellow and purple patterned robe. She is accompanied by a large, coiled, iridescent green and blue dragon with golden eyes, set against a starry cosmic background filled with colorful glowing orbs and swirling patterns.

1108.title: Alien Girl with Satellite
1108.description: A green-skinned alien girl with pigtails and antennae holds a pineapple grenade while standing beside a large satellite dish. The vibrant psychedelic background features swirling patterns, dripping paint effects, and floating icons in a cartoon style.

1109.title: Cosmic Bubble Sorceress
1109.description: A surreal painting depicts a silhouetted figure in a flowing purple robe with an elaborate headdress of colorful circular forms standing atop a winding, glowing green serpent-like creature. The cosmic night sky background is filled with vibrant translucent bubbles containing smaller figures, stars, and constellations.

1110.title: Sea Turtle Swirls
1110.description: A vibrant green sea turtle swims diagonally across a white background, its shell and flippers detailed with realistic patterns. The turtle is surrounded by dynamic, psychedelic swirls of purple, pink, blue, and green containing stylized female figures with long flowing hair.

1111.title: Cosmic Cat Dreamscape
1111.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts two women in profile with purple and green skin gazing at a vast white cat with glowing yellow eyes. The cat emerges from a swirling cosmic nebula filled with stars and orbs, overlooking a pastoral landscape of rolling hills, farmhouses, and a bright sun.

1112.title: Ancestral Spirits of the Plains
1112.description: Three blue-skinned women with ornate golden headdresses and colorful garments appear amidst swirling, vibrant purple and blue smoke trails. They float above a rural landscape featuring farmhouses, green fields, a dirt path, and towering red rock buttes under a glowing golden sunset.

1114.title: Alien Girl with Grenade
1114.description: A green-skinned alien girl with black pigtails and yellow bows stands beside a large satellite dish, holding a purple grenade in her hand. A giant human hand with long nails reaches toward the grenade from the left against a pink background.

1115.title: Angry Chick in Cosmic Ring
1115.description: A furious yellow chick wearing red boxing gloves and a tiny crown stands defiantly in a grassy field. It is framed by a glowing teal circular portal with swirling purple and green rings against a pastoral landscape with houses, trees, and a dramatic pink and yellow sunrise.

1116.title: Surprised Sun with Ethereal Faces
1116.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork features a central green cartoon sun with wide eyes and an open mouth, surrounded by swirling purple and pink smoke-like patterns. Four stylized female profiles in magenta, teal, and purple emerge from the flowing, ornate tendrils that radiate outward.

1113.title: Mystical Boat in Surreal Landscape
1113.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a blue sailboat carrying robed figures with radiant halos sailing through swirling waters. The scene includes stylized female figures with elaborate swirling hair in the foreground, rolling green hills with houses, and a large golden sun containing multiple faces in the sky.

1117.title: Cosmic Grenade Girl
1117.description: A green-skinned cartoon girl with pigtails and military attire holds a pineapple grenade while standing before a massive swirling galaxy featuring a black hole shaped like a face with a large mustache.

1118.title: Green Alien Girl with Mustache
1118.description: A green-skinned alien girl with a large black mustache and antennae stands in the foreground holding a pineapple with a crescent moon on top. Behind her is a vibrant cosmic scene featuring three large black circular portals with glowing rainbow rings against a starry purple and pink background.

1119.title: Psychedelic Alien Overlook
1119.description: A large green alien with big eyes and tentacles floats in a swirling blue sky above a yellow hill. Below, colorful stylized figures and plant-like forms with human faces stand amid a misty, dotted landscape.

1120.title: Psychedelic Green Orb Scene
1120.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork features a glowing green orb with a surprised face floating in a cloudy sky. Ornate stylized female faces with intricate swirling hair frame the left and right sides, accompanied by a large orange cat and a small green cat with matching curly patterns.

1121.title: Psychedelic Serpent Eye
1121.description: A surreal close-up of a human eye with a green snake resting on the eyebrow, surrounded by intricate swirling patterns and circular motifs in vibrant hues.

1122.title: Psychedelic Boy and Spiral Cats
1122.description: A surreal portrait of a young boy with curly dark hair and a green head covering, gazing forward with a neutral expression. Two vibrant stylized cats, one purple and one red-orange, leap across the scene amid swirling psychedelic patterns and colorful abstract shapes.

1123.title: Cactus Hair Portrait
1123.description: A vibrant profile portrait of a woman with green braided hair intertwined with blooming cacti and colorful flowers. The surreal scene features rolling green hills with floral patterns under a layered blue and purple sky.

1124.title: Skeleton with Fan and Flowers
1124.description: A detailed skeleton holds a large decorated blue folding fan while surrounded by vibrant flowers emerging from its ribcage. Psychedelic swirls, Buddha figures, and colorful silhouettes float in a smoky background.

1125.title: Psychedelic Wolf Vision
1125.description: A vibrant green wolf with intricate black patterns faces right, its eye glowing yellow. Swirling psychedelic smoke emanates from its mouth containing three stylized human faces with afros amid colorful spirals and patterns.

1126.title: Melting Cosmic Women
1126.description: Four women in colorful traditional headscarves stand in profile in a vibrant rural landscape at sunset, with a bright sun over distant hills and houses. Above them, a dark starry sky with swirling cosmic patterns melts downward in dripping red, pink, and yellow paint.

1128.title: Psychedelic Melting Flower
1128.description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large purple flower with a swirling green and yellow center, dripping with vibrant red, orange, and pink liquid. A blue melting creature with large yellow eyes and a sad expression sits beside it, surrounded by floating icons and a starry space background.

1127.title: Psychedelic Mountain Drip
1127.description: A surreal psychedelic landscape features green female profiles with intricate spiral patterns emerging from a vibrant green field dotted with small houses. Red liquid drips from the top border over a starry sky, while a glowing sun hovers above misty mountains glowing in magenta and orange hues.

1129.title: Dreamscape Portrait
1129.description: A stylized profile of a woman with closed eyes, her hair and body transforming into swirling colorful flowers and circular patterns across a rolling green landscape. A vibrant sunset with orange sun and purple mountains forms the background in this psychedelic artwork.

1130.title: Hooded Lantern Mystic
1130.description: A green-skinned hooded figure in a dark blue cloak covered in intricate glowing circles stands in profile, holding a lit candle. The vibrant background features a radiant sunset over mountains with concentric circles and colorful abstract patterns filling the sky.

1131.title: Angry Chick in Surreal Landscape
1131.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large angry yellow chick with clenched fists inside a red circular frame, set against a pastoral landscape with rolling hills, a sun, houses, and mist. Colorful decorative borders with paisley patterns, polka dots, and human profiles intertwine throughout the composition.
1131.medium: Digital painting or acrylic on canvas

1132.title: Psychedelic Horned Figures
1132.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four stylized female figures with horns and elaborate colorful headdresses standing in a green rolling landscape. They face a dark blue lake with concentric ripples beneath a cosmic night sky filled with dripping red, orange, and pink patterns and distant purple mountains.

1133.title: Celestial Lily Dreamer
1133.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large stylized profile of a green-skinned woman with elaborate floral headdress and intricate patterns. In the background, a smaller robed figure reaches toward floating colorful orbs and flowers beneath a starry night sky with constellations.

1135.title: Desert Women at Sunset
1135.description: A vibrant painting shows four women with green and purple skin standing in profile among blooming cacti and flowers. They wear colorful patterned clothing and headwraps while gazing toward a dramatic sunset over purple mountains.

1134.title: Psychedelic Melting Cosmos
1134.description: A surreal psychedelic landscape depicts four colorful humanoid figures with melting faces in the foreground, standing before a serene blue lake reflecting a dripping pink cosmic sky. The night sky swirls with vibrant nebulae and stars while viscous magenta liquid pours down from above, creating ripples and patterns across the green mountains and water.

1136.title: Stained Glass Cosmic Wheel
1136.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large circular stained glass wheel floating in a colorful sky above mountains, with a bright sun at its center casting rays over the landscape. In the foreground, a stylized green-skinned woman with elaborate multicolored hair emerges from swirling pastel clouds.

1137.title: Bowl of Psychedelic Souls
1137.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a large white bowl overflowing with colorful spheres containing miniature faces and figures. Ethereal green and yellow smoke-like forms rise from the bowl carrying small human-like souls toward a colorful sunset over distant mountains.

1138.title: Floral Dream Women
1138.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting shows four stylized female profiles with flower-like heads emerging from flowing, colorful hair that merges with swirling landscape patterns. The figures transition from a large green and blue profile on the left to smaller ones on the right, all adorned with bright orange and yellow blooms against a dynamic sky background.

1140.title: Cosmic Desert Sisters
1140.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three women with green and purple skin standing among large green cacti and bright orange and yellow flowers. The background features a swirling colorful galaxy and starry cosmic sky with flowing abstract patterns.

1139.title: Cosmic Spiral Women
1139.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three women's profiles in yellow, green, and purple, adorned with leaves and swirling patterns against a deep blue starry background. Bold black-and-white concentric spirals float around them amid splashes of yellow and green paint with dripping effects.

1141.title: Alien in Trash Vortex
1141.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green-skinned woman with flowing orange and red spiral hair wearing a patterned headscarf, standing in profile on a cactus-covered hill. To her right, a green alien with glowing orange eyes emerges from a metallic trash can, surrounded by a swirling vortex of corn, cacti, and colorful abstract shapes under a dramatic cloudy sky.

1142.title: Cosmic Dragon Sorceress
1142.description: A vibrant fantasy woman with flowing green curly hair stands in profile holding a glowing orb, her body transforming into a long, serpentine green dragon that coils across the scene. In the swirling purple night sky above, two colorful galaxies collide in a brilliant burst of light surrounded by stars and flowers.

1143.title: Cosmic Dreamer Portrait
1143.description: A surreal painting of a woman in profile with pink and yellow hair, her face and neck covered in glowing golden cracks. She gazes toward a vibrant cosmic scene featuring a radiant sun-like orb, galaxies, stars, and a circular platform with silhouetted figures above a reflective surface.

1144.title: Cosmic Serpent and Watcher
1144.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a giant green scaled serpent with glowing patterns stretching across a starry cosmos, its head near a silhouetted woman in an ornate dress who reaches toward a massive stylized eye dominating the upper composition. The eye contains a swirling galaxy tunnel with three silhouetted figures before a red doorway, surrounded by colorful spiral galaxies, nebulae, and flowing cosmic energy tendrils.

1145.title: Psychedelic Eye Lotus
1145.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a massive pink and yellow lotus flower at center with a detailed human eye inside its bloom. The eye's pupil contains a red orb with five silhouetted figures standing together, surrounded by swirling cosmic patterns, floating faces, and colorful clouds.

1146.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Eye
1146.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large stylized eye at the center with a red and blue spiral iris. From the pupil, a beam of rainbow-colored light streams outward carrying human faces and mushroom-like forms into a swirling cosmic landscape filled with galaxies and ornate spirals.

1147.title: Psychedelic Egg and Lotus
1147.description: A surreal painting features a large cracked white egg at the bottom with yellow yolk dripping, containing a green-faced figure inside a patterned orange sphere. Above it blooms a giant pink lotus flower holding three green profile faces with purple and yellow patterned hair, all set against a radiating pink and yellow background with floating blue and purple circular orbs.

1148.title: Cosmic Lily Pond
1148.description: A black silhouette of a woman with flowing tentacle-like hair stands in a glowing pond, holding a luminous green orb. The night sky swirls with vibrant galaxy spirals, stars, and floating silhouetted figures in a psychedelic cosmic scene.

1149.title: Cosmic Muse Trinity
1149.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring three stylized female profiles in green, yellow, and blue, their flowing hair composed of swirling galaxy patterns, stars, and nebulae against a bright lime green background.

1150.title: Surreal Turtle Odyssey
1150.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large ornate sea turtle with green patterned shell and flowing dark hair swimming through a colorful underwater dreamscape. The scene includes multiple human faces emerging from cacti, flowers, and circular bubbles against a rainbow-hued background with coral and abstract patterns.

1152.title: Psychedelic Eye Flower City
1152.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a massive pink and magenta flower with a detailed human eye at its center, overlooking a neon industrial city emitting black smoke. The psychedelic background includes floating faces, a yellow sun with goggles, swirling colorful patterns and starry elements.

1151.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Eye
1151.description: A surreal close-up portrait of a green-skinned woman's face in profile, dominated by an oversized blue eye with a fiery orange spiral pupil. Red blood-like splatters streak across the eye and face while colorful tentacle-like forms, smaller faces, and cosmic patterns swirl outward against a dark starry background.

1153.title: Bleeding Psychedelic Eye
1153.description: A highly detailed surreal close-up of a human eye with a vibrant blue iris, fiery red and yellow rings around a black pupil, and red blood splatters across the sclera and eyelashes. The surrounding skin and space dissolve into a swirling cosmic composition of neon tendrils, glowing figures, stars, and fluid psychedelic patterns.

1154.title: Psychedelic Alien Overlord
1154.description: A giant green alien head with large starry purple and yellow eyes dominates a surreal landscape. Dripping pink liquid from a cosmic starry sky above, while stylized human figures, hearts, and geometric patterns appear on a colorful ground below.

1155.title: Bowl of Souls
1155.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large decorated bowl filled with colorful spheres containing human faces and silhouettes. An arcing stream of stylized figures flows from the bowl toward the upper left against a dreamy landscape of purple mountains and a glowing sunset.

1156.title: Sea Turtle Oasis
1156.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green sea turtle swimming through sunlit waters above a yellow seabed. The turtle's shell is a transparent vessel containing multiple human figures, surrounded by colorful cacti, coral, fish, and descending light rays.

1157.title: Psychedelic Octopus Goddess
1157.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three stylized female profiles with elaborate psychedelic hair and headpieces merging into a large pink octopus with big black eyes. The octopus rests on a rocky outcrop while its tentacles intertwine with the figures against a dreamy teal and purple background filled with abstract swirling patterns and circular motifs.

1159.title: Stained Glass Goddess Circle
1159.description: A vibrant stained-glass style circular window dominates the scene, featuring a central radiant sun with a face, surrounded by seven female figures with colorful foliage hairstyles set in geometric panels. Below the window, four women in patterned green and yellow gowns stand on a misty hilltop holding hands, facing a colorful sunrise over distant mountains.

1158.title: Demonic Rain Over Psychedelic Lake
1158.description: A surreal psychedelic landscape depicts rolling green hills and a reflective blue lake under a dark starry sky filled with pink lightning and dripping red liquid. Four stylized female figures with colorful skin and spiral patterns stand in the foreground, while demonic red faces with glowing eyes emerge from the oozing clouds above.

1160.title: Surreal Melting Lighthouse Scene
1160.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts four stylized women in colorful attire standing in stylized water on the left, observing a central blue and purple lighthouse atop a green hill. The scene is framed by a large circular motif with dripping melting clocks, keys, apples, and playing cards against a starry night sky with colorful drips.

1161.title: Bleeding Cosmic Eye
1161.description: A surreal painted portrait of a stylized green-skinned face in profile with one large central eye featuring a vibrant blue iris, fiery red spiral pupil, and blood-like red liquid dripping downward. Purple tentacle-like forms extend from the eye, entwined with screaming yellow female faces against a dark cosmic background.

1162.title: Dripping Cosmic Congregation
1162.description: A surreal scene shows a crowd of women with spiral patterns on their bodies standing before large green monoliths under a starry night sky. Red and pink viscous liquid drips from the top of the frame over the scene.

1163.title: Psychedelic Silhouette Profiles
1163.description: A vibrant abstract composition featuring overlapping silhouettes of human profiles facing right in a gradient of purple, magenta, yellow, cyan, and green. The figures are filled and surrounded by intricate patterns of concentric circles, spirals, dots, and organic bubble-like forms in lime green, purple, and turquoise against a white background.

1164.title: Cosmic Drip Realm
1164.description: A surreal psychedelic painting depicts two stylized female profiles emerging from a molten landscape. Their green and blue skin is adorned with intricate glowing circular patterns while vibrant red, pink, and orange liquid drips from a starry cosmic sky above a dark rocky terrain.

1165.title: All-Seeing Psychedelic Eye
1165.description: A surreal, highly detailed painting of a massive central bloodshot eyeball with a blue iris containing two green skull-like figures. The eye is surrounded by concentric psychedelic rings, multiple stylized female faces in green and yellow with extra eyes, a black devil-like figure, and dripping red blood against a cosmic background.

1167.title: Psychedelic Bleeding Eye
1167.description: A hyper-detailed close-up of a human eye with a vibrant blue iris featuring intricate fractal patterns and tiny embedded faces. Blood drips heavily from the lower eyelid while a purple cartoonish creature with large green eyes and a turquoise mushroom cap rests on the upper eyelid.

1166.title: Psychedelic Mermaid and Fish
1166.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring two stylized mermaids with flowing hair surrounded by colorful coral and sea plants. A large, ornately patterned fish with spiral designs swims above them against a green and purple watercolor background.

1168.title: Psychedelic Bear Vision
1168.description: A large brown bear with a hypnotic spiral eye and gentle smile is surrounded by vibrant, swirling psychedelic patterns, green braided vines, yellow smiley faces, and stylized women's faces with yellow hair emerging from purple and pink floral forms.

1170.title: Galactic Green Cat
1170.description: A vibrant watercolor painting features a large, fluffy green cat with star-patterned eyes leaping joyfully through a cosmic scene. Surrounding it are smaller green cats, three stylized African women with intricate headwraps and jewelry, and a swirling purple and green nebula filled with bubbles and constellations.

1169.title: Psychedelic Bear Vision
1169.description: A large brown bear's head and shoulders dominate the composition, its face and ears adorned with intricate spiral and circular patterns in purple, green, and pink. A winding, serpentine form in green and purple flows from the bear, containing circular vignettes with small human figures, while the background features abstract splashes of green, purple, and yellow with tiny stylized human figures climbing a path.

1171.title: Red-Haired Dual Portrait
1171.description: A surreal split-face portrait of a woman with vibrant red hair and blue eyes. The left side features a sepia-toned line drawing with concentric circles against an orange background, while the right side shows a fully rendered realistic face with colorful psychedelic swirls, flowers, and bubbles on a blue background.

1172.title: Corn and Women Mural
1172.description: A vibrant surreal artwork featuring a large central corn stalk rendered in white and grey, surrounded by stylized women's faces in profile with elaborate headdresses and jewelry in shades of purple and gold. The composition is filled with flowing organic shapes, spirals, and floral elements in a psychedelic palette of greens, purples, and yellows.

1173.title: Psychedelic Eye Vision
1173.description: A surreal green eye dominates the composition with multiple faces flowing from its lower eyelid in profile. The iris contains smaller silhouetted figures while the surrounding space features swirling patterns, floating demon-like masks, and a vibrant cosmic nebula.

1174.title: Cosmic Dreamer Portrait
1174.description: A stylized portrait of a teal-skinned woman with closed eyes and a serene smile, her hand gently touching her chin. Her elaborate hair flows into a vibrant, swirling cosmic tapestry filled with peacock feathers, stars, crescent moons, and surreal figures against a solid terracotta background.

1175.title: Psychedelic Planetary Goddesses
1175.description: A vibrant surreal composition featuring multiple stylized female profiles with elaborate headdresses and intricate patterns, set against overlapping green and yellow planets or orbs on a deep purple background.

1176.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Stallion
1176.description: A vibrant multicolored horse with flowing blue mane stands on a patterned green hill, gazing toward a massive stylized green eye and a glowing turquoise mandala orb against a swirling cosmic sky filled with stars and nebulae.

1178.title: Redhead and Gremlin Companion
1178.description: A woman with long flowing red hair and intricate green patterned clothing holds a small green orb while a large green furry creature with purple wings perches beside her. The whimsical scene features floating bubbles and glowing circular patterns against a soft blue and green background.

1177.title: Cosmic Green Cat
1177.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large, fluffy green cat with yellow eyes and small horns floating in a whimsical cosmic scene. The cat's tail transforms into flowing, colorful waves that merge with three stylized women's profiles adorned with intricate patterns, surrounded by planets, stars, and nebulae.

1179.title: Surreal Eye and Paw Portrait
1179.description: A surreal painting featuring a large stylized eye at the center of a black paw-like shape with white circuit-like lines. A somber young boy with large golden eyes stares forward, surrounded by colorful swirling patterns, while translucent green faces appear on the right side against a vibrant red and yellow background.

1180.title: Mystical Purple Woman and Cat
1180.description: A surreal portrait of a bald purple-skinned woman with intricate glowing patterns on her head and body, long flowing red hair, and green eyes. She holds a white cat adorned with matching colorful psychedelic patterns against a cosmic starry background filled with swirls and symbols.

1182.title: Psychedelic Eye Butterfly
1182.description: A vibrant surreal creature with a large central green eye and crescent moon pupil, orange petal-like wings adorned with smaller bee-like insects, and a purple smiley face orb floating above it. The figure hovers against a swirling cosmic background of colorful concentric rings and glowing orbs.

1184.title: Braided Muse in Motion
1184.description: A serene red-haired woman with a long braided ponytail gazes left in profile, her hand resting on her chest. Dynamic colorful streaks and abstract circular patterns filled with tiny figures radiate from behind her against a light blue background.

1183.title: Stasis Cyber Cat
1183.description: A green robot with glowing yellow eyes and circuit patterns stands on the left, its hand extended toward a fluffy multicolored cat floating in mid-air. The cat leaps toward a large vibrant pink and orange flower containing a small green skull at its center, set against a cosmic swirling space background.

1181.title: Alien Muse with Paw Prints
1181.description: A vibrant digital painting features a smiling woman with long, flowing red and orange hair adorned with green alien antennae. She is positioned beside a glowing green alien head, with a large red square containing black dripping paw prints in the lower right against a swirling psychedelic background.

1185.title: Braided Redhead Portrait
1185.description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with vibrant red hair in intricate braids, wearing a green patterned garment. Multiple overlapping semi-transparent faces of the same woman with varying hair colors appear behind her against a light blue background, intersected by bold diagonal brush strokes in warm tones.

1186.title: Boy with Mystic Horses
1186.description: A surreal portrait of a young boy with a somber expression, his head adorned with green spiral patterns and a glowing golden halo. He stands beside two vibrant horses covered in intricate colorful swirls, set against a fantastical landscape with floating figures, crescent moons, and a multicolored sky.

1187.title: Psychedelic Monster Portrait
1187.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green one-eyed monster with a wide smile on the left, facing three stylized human profiles with colorful patterns and face paint on the right. The composition is set against swirling rainbow vortex patterns and dripping paint effects on a bright green background, with the text 'ANDEROTSUMY' visible at the bottom.

1188.title: Mushroom Eyed Child
1188.description: A surreal portrait of a blue-skinned child with dark teary eyes holding a large blue mushroom with two prominent realistic human eyes on its cap. Behind the child is the translucent face of a woman with glowing yellow eyes and green hair filled with smaller faces and geometric symbols.

1189.title: Crystal Sage by the Lake
1189.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an elderly man with glasses and a wide-brimmed hat, accompanied by a green bird, emerging from a large purple crystal. The crystal features a smiling purple emoji face with orange wings and green legs, standing in a rippling blue lake with lily pads, set against a starry night sky and stylized green mountains.

1190.title: Pumpkin Vortex Boat
1190.description: A woman in a purple headscarf rows a decorated wooden boat across a lake using a glowing yellow oar that creates a spiral of green light. To her right, a giant melting jack-o'-lantern oozes red and purple liquid while a large green one-eyed ghost creature emerges from a swirling psychedelic vortex in the purple sky.

1191.title: Psychedelic Smiley Fan Dancer
1191.description: A vibrant purple smiley face character with rosy cheeks dances while holding an enormous orange folding fan decorated with cat faces, flowers, and spirals. The surreal scene is set against a purple background filled with floating cat-headed creatures, green silhouettes, and colorful geometric patterns.

1192.title: Boy with Psychedelic Umbrella
1192.description: A young boy with a serious expression holds a large, intricately patterned umbrella filled with swirling blue, green, and yellow motifs. Behind him stands a silhouetted woman on a rocky outcrop under a glowing red moon, with a vibrant DNA helix and abstract swirling patterns flowing through the psychedelic night sky.

1193.title: Boy with Umbrella under Red Moon
1193.description: A surreal painting depicts a somber young boy holding a large ornate umbrella while standing on a dark mountain peak. Swirling blue, green, and yellow patterns flow across the starry night sky, with a large dripping red celestial body and white outlined figures in the background.

1194.title: Man on Cosmic Turtle
1194.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an elderly man with glasses and a hat riding a large green sea turtle. A yellow bird perches on his shoulder as they float through a purple cosmic space filled with swirling patterns, colorful orbs, and a large translucent green vortex.

1196.title: Mushroom Queen and Oracle
1196.description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large blue mushroom with wide cartoon eyes and a smiling face on the left, its orange and purple swirling tendrils extending across a starry night sky. On the right, a regal green-skinned queen with long purple hair wears a golden crown and ornate dark robes while seated on a patterned throne.

1195.title: Stasis Overhead Projection
1195.description: A vibrant surreal mural painted on glass walls and floor features an elderly man in a decorated hat with a green parrot on his shoulder, a large glowing purple peony with dripping paint, and multiple stylized women with elaborate hairstyles and earrings. The scene includes tropical foliage, text reading "STASIS", and colorful reflections on the glossy floor.

1197.title: Psychedelic Shadow Monster
1197.description: A large dark blue and black creature with a wide jagged-toothed grin and a single large yellow eye dominates the composition. Its body is adorned with smaller grinning faces, abstract circular patterns, and a flowing turquoise serpent-like form, set against a vibrant lime green background with colorful paint splatters.

1198.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Sorceress
1198.description: A surreal portrait of a green-skinned female figure with one side of her face cracked and colorful, wearing a large blue mushroom cap hat with prominent white eyes. Her white hair flows behind her as she raises a hand, set against dynamic streaks of blue and green with floating orbs and a small red ladybug.

1199.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Spiral
1199.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large blue and purple swirling galaxy at center, encircled by overlapping orange and pink rings adorned with small demonic faces. On the left, a row of five stylized female profile heads in magenta, pink, yellow, teal and blue display intricate psychedelic patterns within their hair against a bright green dripping background.

1200.title: Pandemic Solum Portrait
1200.description: A vibrant pop-art style portrait of an older man wearing a patterned hat and glasses, accompanied by a large green dog on the left and a bright red bird on his shoulder. The background features colorful autumn maple leaves, circular patterns, paint drips, and small stylized human figures integrated into the composition.

1201.title: Psychedelic Elder Portrait
1201.description: An elderly man with glasses and a decorated hat holds a large purple peony while a vibrant hummingbird hovers near his shoulder. The futuristic room features glowing neon patterns, swirling psychedelic motifs, and figures in green uniforms dancing in the background.

1202.title: Neon Alien Bubble Vision
1202.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring three stylized women in profile with yellow, green, and pink skin, adorned with intricate patterns and large earrings. A glowing green alien with large sparkling eyes and sharp teeth emerges from a large transparent bubble, surrounded by smaller floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, all set in a vibrant retro-futuristic room with palm frond patterns.

1205.title: Serpent's Cosmic Portal
1205.description: A large purple snake with yellow eyes and open mouth coils across the frame, adorned with pink, orange, and yellow maple leaves. To the right, a circular ornate portal reveals a starry night sky, swirling green patterns, and a meditating figure at the center of a glowing pond-like scene.

1203.title: Elder in Vibrant Garden
1203.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of an elderly Black man with a gray beard, wearing a brown beret and glasses, surrounded by swirling green vines and bright orange flowers. In the background, three stylized purple female figures with headwraps float amid green and blue abstract patterns and dripping paint effects.

1204.title: Cosmic Egg Hatching
1204.description: A surreal night scene features a silhouetted woman in a patterned dress holding an umbrella while standing on a dark hill. Multiple large cracked eggs with glowing cosmic orbs are scattered around her, set against a vibrant backdrop of swirling psychedelic patterns, a giant purple flower-like mandala, and a red celestial body in a starry sky.

1206.title: Serpent's Sacred Circle
1206.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large purple snake adorned with autumn leaves coiled around four dark-skinned women wearing colorful headwraps. The women sit around a circular cosmic pool featuring lotus flowers and concentric rings, set against a swirling purple and green background with dripping paint effects.

1208.title: Umbrella Under Red Moon
1208.description: A surreal painting depicts a young figure with curly dark hair and large eyes wearing a flowing blue cloak while holding a large ornate umbrella decorated with swirling psychedelic patterns. They stand on a rocky mountain peak with purple mountains in the background under a glowing red celestial body in a dark teal sky.

1207.title: Cosmic Women Portrait
1207.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts three stylized women's profiles facing each other against a swirling cosmic vortex background. Their hair and headdresses feature intricate patterns with dripping paint effects in neon colors over horizontal landscape stripes.

1209.title: Psychedelic Portrait with Dog
1209.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of an older man with glasses and a patterned hat, accompanied by a bright green dog sticking out its tongue. The background features a giant glowing mushroom, silhouetted figures, and a retro 1960s psychedelic pattern with swirls and circles.

1210.title: Robotic Professor Portrait
1210.description: A cybernetic elderly man with glowing orange eyes, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and suit, stands in profile as a green mechanical bird perches on his shoulder. The background is a vibrant psychedelic pattern of swirling circles, flowers, and repeating stylized faces in green, purple, and yellow.

1211.title: Man with Green Dog and Cat
1211.description: A vibrant pop art portrait of a middle-aged man wearing a purple fedora, positioned centrally with a large bright green dog winking and sticking out its tongue to his left, and a hairless sphynx cat with intricate patterns to his right. A small green bird perches on the man's shoulder while the background features a pink field with yellow circular motifs, paw prints, and smaller circular portraits.

1213.title: Psychedelic Female Silhouettes
1213.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring multiple stylized female profiles with flowing, swirling hair patterns in magenta, lime green, and deep red. The composition includes dripping paint effects at the top and intricate spiral designs throughout the interlocking faces.

1212.title: Blue Elf Lightning Weaver
1212.description: A blue-skinned elf with long flowing purple hair and pointed ears holds a glowing lightning bolt that radiates electric energy in all directions. Her ornate patterned robe features spiral designs while multiple overlapping profile faces appear behind her against a vibrant geometric background.

1214.title: Cosmic Cat and Nebula Vase
1214.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a white cat with green eyes and a leafy collar reaching toward a glowing blue vase erupting with swirling galaxy patterns and cosmic energy. The scene is surrounded by colorful potted plants with stylized faces and leaves, set against a swirling cosmic background filled with stars, spirals, and ethereal female figures.

1215.title: Dripping Psychedelic Faces
1215.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows four stylized female profiles in a row, their colorful faces and elaborate headdresses melting downward into pools of liquid. Gold leaf at the top drips crimson and magenta paint over swirling blue, teal, and yellow background patterns.

1217.title: Psychedelic Red Moon Pagoda
1217.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring four colorful profiled faces with spiral patterns merging into a dark mountain range topped by a glowing multi-tiered Japanese pagoda. A massive blood-red moon dominates the night sky above, with vibrant dripping paint effects and swirling motifs throughout the composition.

1216.title: Celestial Fountain Reverie
1216.description: A vibrant watercolor painting depicts a turquoise circular fountain with rippling water and splashing droplets at the center. Three stylized female profile faces float above in circular frames, surrounded by intricate patterns of blue and purple circles against a colorful abstract background with gold drips.

1218.title: Voyage on Spiral Seas
1218.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a green boat with a spiral-patterned sail carrying several stylized human figures through turbulent, swirling waves. The sky is filled with concentric circular cloud patterns in purple and green tones, while small figures appear on the waves and in the distant background.

1219.title: Sirens Sailing Stormy Seas
1219.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three colorful siren figures with elaborate spiral-patterned hair sailing in a small boat on turbulent, swirling green and yellow waves. A thick rope arcs across the sky above while a fourth dark siren figure appears on a distant wave formation to the right.

1220.title: Blue Elf and Lightning Girl
1220.description: A blue-skinned elf with long flowing hair and pointed ears gently holds the hands of a young girl with freckles and hair styled in two buns. Blue magical lightning crackles between their fingers while they gaze at each other against a vibrant cosmic background.

1221.title: Split Face Lightning
1221.description: A surreal painting of two conjoined blue and orange female elf-like faces merging at the center, with a bright blue lightning bolt running vertically between them. Golden-orange paint drips from their eyes and faces as they stand in a stylized grassy field with distant mountains under a colorful sky.

1222.title: Psychedelic Portrait in Field
1222.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with blue and orange skin, her hair intricately styled with colorful circular patterns and floral motifs. Vibrant paint splashes in yellow, blue, and purple burst around her against a golden field and mountain landscape at sunset.

1224.title: Surreal Blue Bird Portrait
1224.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a woman's face with blue skin and spiral hair merging with a tree branch where a colorful blue and orange bird perches. The background displays dynamic paint splashes in blue, yellow, and orange with white flowers, ginkgo leaves, and abstract patterns.

1223.title: Cosmic Reaper and Astronaut
1223.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a hooded Grim Reaper with a glowing purple-eyed skull and skeletal hand beside a young woman with blue and orange face paint and dripping colors. In the foreground, a relaxed astronaut in a NASA spacesuit smokes a pipe while floating in a swirling vortex of vinyl records, question marks, and cosmic patterns.

1225.title: Psychedelic Cat Reflection
1225.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows two colorful cats, one large green-eyed and one smaller purple, standing together in an abstract fiery background of swirling patterns. In the foreground, a bright blue and orange bird perches on a ginkgo branch overlooking a reflective pond containing the ghostly white outlines of two human-like figures.

1226.title: Mushroom Muse Reflection
1226.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face with colorful dripping patterns, purple and yellow hair adorned with white flowers and ginkgo leaves. Two cartoonish smiling mushrooms stand in rippling reflective water below, while a colorful bird perches on a branch beside her against a dreamy mushroom forest backdrop.

1227.title: Dragon and Mushroom Friends
1227.description: A large, cosmic blue dragon with glowing yellow patterns coils through a starry purple nebula sky, overlooking two cheerful anthropomorphic mushrooms standing in a pond with lily pads. The taller blue mushroom with a red spotted cap waves happily while the smaller yellow mushroom stands beside it.

1228.title: Psychedelic Bunny Girl Portrait
1228.description: A close-up surreal portrait of a young girl with large melting bunny ears, multicolored dripping hair, and one prominent golden eye with blue tears streaming down her face. The background is filled with floating cartoonish orbs, spirals, and abstract dripping forms in a vibrant chaotic composition.

1229.title: Ginkgo Eclipse Portrait
1229.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with blue and green skin, her face melting into colorful drips as a blue and orange bird perches on her head. She wears a crown of ginkgo leaves and white flowers against a mountainous landscape under a dark dripping eclipse in a colorful sky.

1230.title: Mushroom Dreamscape
1230.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a woman's eye and eyebrow in the foreground, with intricate colorful patterns around it. In the background, a large green mushroom with a face stands amid lily pads covered in smaller mushrooms, while a vibrant blue and orange bird perches on a branch above.

1232.title: Vibrant Still Life with Bird
1232.description: A colorful folk art painting featuring a large pink bowl filled with yellow grains and orange slices, surrounded by blue and orange pitchers, a green cup, and a stylized blue-green-orange bird perched on a ginkgo branch. The background is dark maroon with swirling patterns, fruits, and decorative foliage in turquoise, yellow, and purple.

1231.title: Psychedelic Bird Feast
1231.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a colorful blue and orange bird perched on a ginkgo branch with white flowers, overlooking a woman with green face and yellow hand eating from a large pink bowl of noodles. The background features stylized mountains, a black sun with orange rays, floating white petals, and various fruits against a purple sky.

1233.title: Surreal Noodle Bowl Ritual
1233.description: Two women with elaborate hairstyles and colorful attire face each other while holding utensils over a large pink cracked bowl filled with steaming noodles, bread, and vegetables. The vibrant magenta background swirls with fish, orange slices, abstract patterns, and circular portraits of figures connected by colorful smoke-like streams.

1234.title: Alien Smoothie Ritual
1234.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a green alien with a pink scarf holding a glowing green orb that drips liquid, standing beside two smaller colorful aliens. To the left, a pink-skinned woman with a headwrap gazes at a large pink bowl overflowing with bananas, citrus slices, and a purple substance emitting psychedelic swirls.

1235.title: Elder in Ginkgo Dreams
1235.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of an elderly Asian man wearing glasses and a wide-brimmed hat labeled 'GODS GODS GODS'. A colorful blue and orange bird perches on his shoulder amid swirling ginkgo leaves and flowers.

1236.title: Psychedelic Cereal Explosion
1236.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large pink bowl overflowing with colorful cereal, spoons, and twisted candy-like forms erupting upwards in a dynamic braid. Orange slices, green serpentine shapes with faces, and paint splatters surround the bowl while a white rectangular panel in the upper right contains four overlapping blue circles with star-like patterns.

1237.title: Eternal Duality
1237.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face split between vibrant blue and a glowing green skull, with colorful paint dripping down her features. The background features a swirling cosmic vortex of glowing circles and abstract shapes amid splatters of neon paint.

1238.title: Melt + Float
1238.description: A vibrant graffiti-style mural featuring a woman's face split between blue and orange tones with dripping paint effects. A cartoon astronaut in a blue suit floats beside her, smoking a pipe while psychedelic swirls, paw prints, and concentric circles fill the background.

1240.title: Surreal Fruit Bowl Dream
1240.description: A vibrant pink bowl overflows with sliced oranges, kitchen utensils, and stylized female faces in profile with colorful hair. In the background, a weathered red-roofed barn stands in a misty field beneath a glowing sun, surrounded by swirling psychedelic trees.

1239.title: Psychedelic Portrait of Fluidity
1239.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with golden eyes and a blue and orange face, her features melting into colorful drips. Her hair and shoulders transform into swirling green and yellow patterns containing multiple smaller faces, set against a bright blue background with fluid paint splashes.

1241.title: Mushroom by the Mystic Pond
1241.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a large green anthropomorphic mushroom with big expressive eyes standing on a grassy bank beside a reflective pond. In the background, a group of silhouetted figures with intricate colorful patterns and headwraps gather under a swirling pink and orange sky next to a dark leafless tree.

1242.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Wonderland
1242.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a giant green mushroom with large expressive eyes and yellow spots in the foreground. In the background, women bathe in a swirling colorful pond while a tree with mushroom caps stands to the right under a pink and orange sky filled with flying fairies.

1243.title: Surreal Cosmic Hat Portrait
1243.description: A surreal painting depicts an elderly man with glasses wearing a large purple hat adorned with silhouetted figures in a circle. Above him floats a massive melting cosmic donut-like structure with starry patterns and black drips, set against a vibrant psychedelic background of colorful human silhouettes and swirling motifs.

1244.title: Cosmic Silhouette Visions
1244.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring black silhouettes of human profiles and a barren tree against a cosmic background. Swirling galaxies, nebulae, and glowing celestial patterns in pink, yellow, and green emerge from the figures and a central crescent moon adorned with stars.

1245.title: Psychedelic Sun and Moon
1245.description: A vibrant surreal painting split between a daytime scene on the left featuring a large red daisy with a black female silhouette profile inside its yellow center, and a nighttime scene on the right showing a pink spiral galaxy in a starry dark blue sky. A black leafless tree frames the composition, with two pink capsules floating between the sun and galaxy against a background of colorful swirls and shooting stars.

1246.title: Silhouettes and Cosmic Swirl
1246.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring black silhouetted trees framing a large pink and magenta spiral galaxy with yellow stars. Colorful human silhouettes in profile with elaborate curly hair patterns appear against a swirling sky of pink, orange, and blue, surrounded by translucent blue orbs containing smaller faces and butterflies.

1247.title: Spiral Women Portrait
1247.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring multiple overlapping female profiles with intricate spiral patterns filling their hair and faces. The composition includes layered heads in yellow, pink, green and blue tones set against swirling concentric circles on a textured orange and blue background.

1248.title: Psychedelic Blue Muse
1248.description: A vibrant portrait of a woman with blue skin and glowing orange eyes, her dark curly hair flowing with intricate yellow and black patterns. Her face and neck are adorned with swirling yellow facial designs against a colorful abstract background of overlapping circles and silhouettes.

1249.title: Vibrant Women at Sunset
1249.description: A colorful painting shows four women in profile facing right, with stylized faces in pink, green, purple, and orange. Behind them is a tropical landscape with a large red sun, reflective water, a green island with trees, and decorative blue bubbles and swirls across a vibrant sky.

1250.title: Braided Skull Island
1250.description: A large green skull with a thick braided cord wrapped around it dominates the foreground, featuring glowing pink and orange spiral eyes. In the background, a small island with silhouetted figures stands in a body of water beneath a large red sun against a vibrant psychedelic sky.

1251.title: Psychedelic Heart Island
1251.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a small island with stylized black trees dripping purple liquid into reflective water dotted with lily pads. A large pink heart containing three golden female profiles floats against a red and black splattered background under a glowing red sun in a swirling green sky.

1252.title: Neon Skull Island
1252.description: A glowing green translucent skull with purple accents and cybernetic patterns floats in the foreground above rippling water. In the background, a dark silhouetted island features carved faces on trees beneath a large red sun in a vibrant green and purple psychedelic sky.

1253.title: Hypnotic Skull Cult
1253.description: A massive glowing green skull with hypnotic spiral eyes dominates the scene from above, its teeth clenched on multiple glowing smartphones. A crowd of faceless purple figures reaches upward with bright yellow hands in desperate worship.

1254.title: Witch's Skull Portal
1254.description: A dark-robed witch with a crescent moon hat stands with arms outstretched beside a giant glowing green skull with pink eyes and golden teeth. The skull emerges from a swirling psychedelic portal of green, pink and yellow energy, set against a surreal landscape featuring a red sun, a silhouetted island with glowing trees, and reflective water.

1256.title: Tree Spirit by the Lake
1256.description: A surreal scene featuring a smiling tree-like creature with a flower crown raising its arms on the right, while two ornate birds perch on a bare branch extending over a green lake with ripples. In the background, a distant island sits beneath a large red sun with symbolic faces against a greenish sky.

1255.title: Surreal Green Skull Eye
1255.description: A large green skull with glowing pink spiral eyes dominates the left side, its surface dripping with green liquid. An ornate mechanical eye protrudes from its right socket containing a smaller skull, set against a vibrant sunset over reflective water with an island of dark trees.

1257.title: Birds and Oranges
1257.description: Two stylized white birds with intricate colorful patterns perch on a branch against a dark blue background, surrounded by vibrant orange fruits and green leaves. Floating stylized female faces in green, purple, and pink with elaborate headdresses appear near the birds amid decorative swirls and circles.

1258.title: Psychedelic Island Silhouette
1258.description: A surreal painting depicts a black silhouette of a woman's profile on a small forested island, her hair exploding into a vibrant, swirling mass of colorful psychedelic patterns and circles. A large red sun with radiating yellow rays dominates the green and grey sky above, its reflection mirrored in the calm blue water below.

1259.title: Mystical Island Castle
1259.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a dark gothic castle on an island surrounded by reflective water, with two colorful birds perched on a branch in the foreground and three stylized women in profile observing the scene. A large red sun with swirling patterns dominates the green sky above the forested island.

1261.title: Theater of Echoes
1261.description: A surreal digital painting shows three young Black women seated in a vibrant, patterned theater. The central figure stares forward with glowing green eyes and digital artifacts floating around her face, flanked by a woman in a patterned hat on the left and a woman with branch-like patterns on her clothing on the right, while two yellow birds perch on a bare branch above them amid a blurred audience with glowing orbs.

1260.title: Emerald Muse Over City
1260.description: A large surreal profile of a green-skinned woman with intricate glowing patterns and long braided hair that drips luminous yellow-green liquid into the water below. Her face overlooks a dark silhouetted city skyline at night, with the entire scene reflected in the rippling blue water.

1262.title: Cosmic Eye Oracle
1262.description: A surreal profile portrait of a woman with purple skin and an oversized, detailed eye for a head. Her hair is an intricate swirl of teal, blue, and yellow containing crystals, a small hand, and tiny human figures, set against a marbled background with colorful planets and paint splatters.

1263.title: Alien Oracle in Reflection
1263.description: A large green alien with purple eyes emerges from a circular turquoise pool, its head merging with a serene woman's face adorned in teal and purple patterns. Broken marble tiles and golden cracks surround the water, with classical ruins reflected in the background under a cloudy sky.

1265.title: Psychedelic Lake Visions
1265.description: A surreal psychedelic landscape depicts a large red sun setting over a reflective body of water with an island of dark trees in the distance. In the foreground, four women's faces with closed eyes emerge from swirling, dripping patterns of bright green and yellow hair that flow like liquid across the water's surface.

1264.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Maiden
1264.description: A vibrant green anthropomorphic mushroom figure with large yellow-green patterned eyes and a slight smile holds a bouquet of red and orange poppies. The background is a vivid pink field filled with concentric spirals, dots, and small circular portraits.

1266.title: Psychedelic Portrait
1266.description: A vibrant painted portrait of a woman with blue skin and intricate curly hair filled with swirling patterns and circles. Her face is partially overlaid with diagonal translucent stripes of blue, green, and yellow, with faded female figures and bubble-like motifs floating to the left.

1268.title: Psychedelic Spiral Women
1268.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring multiple stylized female profiles with green and purple skin tones arranged in a swirling vortex. Bright orange and yellow flame-like forms spiral inward toward a glowing center against a vivid green and pink background.

1267.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Vision
1267.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a large purple mushroom with glowing faces on its cap, standing on a grassy shore beside reflective water. In the foreground, three overlapping profiled female faces in yellow, teal, and purple emit a radiant starburst of colorful light, while a red sun sets over an island with stylized trees under swirling green skies.

1269.title: Psychedelic Spiral Goddess
1269.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring five stylized female faces with green and purple skin tones arranged in a circular formation, emerging from swirling hair patterns. The composition is dominated by a fiery orange and yellow spiral vortex at the center, surrounded by flowing red and orange bands against a pink and green background with circular motifs.

1270.title: Psychedelic Eye Vortex
1270.description: A surreal painting depicts a large cracked purple eye with a fiery golden iris emitting a swirling vortex of flame and energy. To the left, four green female faces with flowing hair emerge from a smoky green aura, all set against a dark starry background with ornate circular patterns.

1271.title: Stasis Vortex
1271.description: A psychedelic artwork depicts a green-skinned woman with blonde hair and glasses sitting in a transparent spherical pod on the left, connected by thin wires to a vertical stack of colorful spheres.
