1809.description: A red mouse wearing a blue cape stands on a sand dune overlooking a circular turquoise oasis filled with small green islands and palm trees. In the sky above, a large glowing orb resembling a purple eye with a slit pupil hovers over the surreal desert landscape.

1810.title: Stasis Paused Warrior
1810.description: A knight in teal armor stands on a floating hexagonal platform holding a glowing blue sword, facing ancient ruined Greek-style temple under a purple sky. The scene is overlaid with bright cyan, magenta, and green digital glitch artifacts and a large 'PAUSED' text with 'STASIS 100%' indicator.

1811.title: Mouse and Alien Nightscape
1811.description: A vibrant red mouse with white underbelly perches on a leafy branch in the foreground, gazing toward a luminous green alien with large black eyes that stands on a sand dune. Behind them stretches a surreal nighttime town silhouette with gothic spires under a glowing full moon and purple clouds.

1813.title: Dachshund Noble in Desert
1813.description: A surreal portrait of an anthropomorphic dachshund dressed as a nobleman with a gold chain and crescent moon pendant, standing in a desert landscape with footprints leading toward distant dunes. A giant detailed pink and brown eye with a reflection of the moon dominates the left side of the composition under a full moon where a rat rides a horse with a flag.

1812.title: Retro Game CRT Scene
1812.description: A nostalgic still life featuring a vintage beige CRT monitor displaying an 8-bit pixel art cityscape game with floating items like a lightsaber, pizza slice, and key. The screen shows 'HIGH SCORE 1616' and 'LODI 81043', surrounded by a pixelated map, a lit candle on a joystick, a green 'PIXEL PUNK' soda can, and tangled wires in a dimly lit room.

1814.title: Surreal Desert Eye
1814.description: A lone figure in a white robe walks across orange sand dunes accompanied by a large red rat. A massive cosmic eye with a red pupil floats in the starry sky above, surrounded by swirling blue nebulae and floating geometric shards.

1815.title: LODI #89 Pause State
1815.description: A pixel art scene from the game L.O.D.I. shows a knight in blue armor standing on a purple platform with a sword, surrounded by a colorful tiled floor. In the foreground, a large pause menu is open displaying RESUME, INVENTORY, MAP, and QUIT options alongside an HP bar and item icons.

1816.title: Crimson Current
1816.description: A large red rose with glowing heart petals floats on dark water beside a green sea turtle swimming toward a sunset. Small pink heart bubbles rise from the turtle while a tiny rose-turtle icon and progress bar appear at the bottom left.

1817.title: Stasis LOD1 #905 Paused
1817.description: A pixel art scene shows a young person wearing a large VR headset and holding a purple game controller while seated at a retro computer setup. A colorful 1980s-style sports car drives through the scene amid floating pixel hearts, a sword, and a diamond against a purple mountain backdrop with 8-bit graphics and text overlays.

1818.title: Holographic Wasteland Palm
1818.description: A weathered, stitched human hand extends toward the viewer, its palm displaying a glowing green holographic projection of a ruined landscape with broken structures and barren trees. The post-apocalyptic background features a desolate battlefield littered with wreckage under an orange and purple hazy sky.

1819.title: Wasteland Paused
1819.description: A detailed retro-futuristic scene depicts a first-person view of a gloved hand holding a yellow Pip-Boy displaying 'VAULT-808 // STASIS LOCKED' and 'PAUSED'. In the desert wasteland beside a ruined highway, a large Fallout Fighter 808 arcade cabinet stands under an orange-purple sunset sky, surrounded by scattered Game Boy, magazines, and Nuka-Cola bottles.

1820.title: Pixel Heart Stasis
1820.description: A large glossy pink pixelated heart dominates the center, dripping black liquid from its base against a vibrant red background. The composition features retro video game elements including a Pac-Man icon, HP bars, hearts, directional arrows, and digital glitch effects layered over horizontal green and purple stripes.

1821.title: Vault-Tec Online
1821.description: A lone figure in a blue and yellow Vault-Tec jumpsuit and helmet sits at a retro-futuristic control desk inside a dilapidated bunker, playing on a vintage computer. Through the cracked panoramic window, a desolate post-apocalyptic desert landscape stretches under a toxic purple and green sky, featuring a faded Nuka-Cola billboard, ruined water towers, and distant explosions.

1822.title: Nuka-Cola in the Wasteland
1822.description: A man in a blue and yellow Vault suit sits on a metal chair beside a weathered red Nuka-Cola vending machine. The dilapidated concrete wall behind them is covered in peeling paint, purple radiation symbols, and the text 'WAR NEVER CHANGES'.

1823.title: Pickles on Metal Tray
1823.description: A realistic still life painting shows a metal tray overflowing with wet, glistening green pickles, some whole and others sliced into rounds. The tray rests on a distressed, cracked surface with torn yellow 'Property of' labels and a 'Green Pickles - 404' sticker visible in the upper right.

1824.title: Crystal Sorceress Reflection
1824.description: A woman with flowing red hair and crystalline pink armor stands in a decaying ornate room, holding a key and purple flowers as she gazes at her fractured mirror reflection. Purple crystal formations and golden light beams illuminate the cracked walls covered in floral patterns.

1825.title: Three Pigs Huddle
1825.description: Three pink pigs lie closely together on a purple surface, their heads touching affectionately in the center with one pig resting its head on the others. The painting features expressive eyes and visible tails curled together.

1826.title: Winged Angel in Prayer
1826.description: A large female angel with expansive feathered wings stands in the foreground with hands clasped in prayer, gazing upward. Her wings and robe are adorned with glowing golden script and symbols against a dramatic twilight sky, with a smaller identical angel visible in the background over a dark, inscribed landscape.

1827.title: Embracing Angelic Sisters
1827.description: Two identical female angels with large white and gold wings tenderly embrace in the center, their faces touching and hands clasped around white lilies. They wear matching pale green robes with golden halos against a dramatic heavenly sky with light rays breaking through clouds over a distant landscape.

1828.title: Three Embracing Angels
1828.description: Three angelic figures with large white wings and golden halos stand closely embraced in the center of the composition, holding white lilies. They are set against a dramatic sky with dark clouds, a bright beam of light descending from above, and a distant landscape below.

1829.title: Three Winged Angels
1829.description: Three ethereal female angels with large white feathered wings embrace closely in the center of the composition, their heads touching. They wear ornate patterned robes adorned with bright orange fruits against a dramatic sunset sky with golden light rays breaking through dark clouds above a distant cityscape.

1830.title: Threefold Angelic Embrace
1830.description: Three winged angelic figures with golden halos stand intimately intertwined in the center, their heads touching and hands clasped around white flowers. They wear ornate blue robes patterned with large orange spheres against a dramatic stormy sky pierced by a radiant beam of golden light from above.

1831.title: Three Winged Angels
1831.description: Three female angels with large white and gold wings embrace closely in the center of the composition, their heads touching and hands clasped. They wear ornate blue robes decorated with orange spheres and white floral patterns, set against a dramatic sunset sky with golden light rays breaking through dark clouds above a distant cityscape.

1832.title: Trinity of Winged Angels
1832.description: Three ethereal female figures with large feathered wings stand closely embraced in the center of the composition, their heads touching. They wear ornate blue robes decorated with orange spheres and white floral patterns, set against a dramatic sunset sky with golden light rays breaking through dark clouds above a distant cityscape.

1833.title: Threefold Angelic Embrace
1833.description: Three winged angelic figures with golden halos stand closely intertwined in the center, their heads touching and hands clasped while holding white flowers. They wear ornate blue robes decorated with large orange spheres against a dramatic dark sky pierced by a bright orange beam of light, with dark dragon-like creatures visible in the background.

1834.title: Trinity of Winged Angels
1834.description: Three identical female angels with large white wings and golden halos stand embraced in the center, each wearing a blue robe adorned with large orange spheres. They hold white lilies while gazing at one another against a dramatic apocalyptic background of dark gothic spires, fiery red-orange sky, and dragon-like creatures.

1835.title: Threefold Angelic Trinity
1835.description: Three identical winged angels with golden halos stand embraced in the center, wearing ornate blue robes patterned with orange spheres. They are set against a dramatic apocalyptic sky with beams of light breaking through dark clouds over a fiery infernal landscape filled with gothic spires and shadowy dragon-like creatures.

1836.title: Threefold Angelic Embrace
1836.description: Three identical winged angels with golden halos stand closely intertwined in the center, their large white feathered wings spread wide and overlapping. They wear ornate blue and orange patterned robes against a dramatic apocalyptic background featuring a dark gothic city, fiery red-orange sky, beams of divine light from above, and shadowy dragon-like creatures in the foreground.

1837.title: Threefold Celestial Angels
1837.description: Three identical winged angels with golden halos stand closely intertwined in the center, their hands clasped together over a glowing orb. They wear ornate blue robes decorated with large orange circular patterns against a dramatic apocalyptic background of a burning citadel, dark dragons, and a fiery sky pierced by a golden beam of light.

1838.title: Trinity of Celestial Angels
1838.description: Three winged angelic figures with golden halos stand embraced in the center, their large white and pink-tinged wings spread wide. They wear ornate blue robes adorned with glowing orange orbs and floral patterns, set against a dramatic apocalyptic background of dark castles, flying dragons, and a fiery red-orange sky pierced by a golden beam of light from above.

1840.title: Trinity Angel of Apocalypse
1840.description: A majestic three-faced angel with six expansive white wings stands centrally, wearing ornate blue and orange robes. The figure holds a glowing heart-like object while dramatic beams of light pierce through a turbulent, fiery red and orange sky above a dark gothic cityscape.

1839.title: Trinity of Celestial Angels
1839.description: Three winged angelic figures with golden halos stand embraced in the center, their large white wings spread wide. They wear ornate blue robes adorned with glowing orange spheres against a dramatic dark fantasy landscape of silhouetted castles, fiery red-orange skies, and a radiant beam of light descending from above.

1841.title: Embracing Seraphim
1841.description: Two angelic figures with large white wings embrace in the center, their faces close together. They wear ornate blue robes adorned with glowing orange orbs against a dramatic apocalyptic background of dark castles, fiery skies, and serpentine creatures.

1842.title: Timekeeper's Surreal Throne
1842.description: A majestic winged queen with a golden crown and mechanical wings sits on an ornate throne that merges into a sprawling pink and green patterned dress across a vast landscape. The dramatic sky swirls with dark clouds, floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, clockwork mechanisms, and dragonflies while a hand in the foreground holds a pocket watch.

1843.title: Ethereal Throne of Time
1843.description: A majestic winged queen with golden crown and green ornate gown sits on an elaborate throne in a vast surreal landscape. Her dress flows into intricate patterned carpets covering the ground while floating bubbles, distant cities, and flying objects drift beneath a dramatic swirling cloudy sky, with a hand holding a pocket watch in the foreground.

1844.title: Fairy Keyhole Portal
1844.description: Three glowing fairies with purple and pink wings interact with a large ornate keyhole mechanism covered in moss and gears. The keyhole emits a bright pink magical light while the surrounding enchanted forest floor is dotted with colorful glowing mushrooms and flora.

1845.title: Psychedelic Green Ribbons
1845.description: A vibrant radial composition featuring undulating green ribbons that spiral outward from a bright pink and magenta center. Yellow oval shapes and dotted lines create a rhythmic pattern against the explosive background of radiating brushstrokes.

1846.title: Psychedelic Serpent Vortex
1846.description: A radial psychedelic composition featuring undulating green serpents spiraling outward from a bright central burst. Translucent white figures, glowing yellow oval forms, and dotted green lines float against a vibrant pink and magenta background.

1847.title: Serpentine Dragonflies
1847.description: A vibrant abstract painting featuring thick, winding green serpentine forms that snake across a radiating pink and magenta background. Yellow oval shapes containing small dragonfly-like insects are scattered throughout, accompanied by additional flying dragonflies and small green specks.

1848.title: Serpentine Dragonflies
1848.description: A surreal painting featuring thick, winding green serpents with dragonfly wings and heads, slithering across a vibrant red radiating background. Scattered throughout are yellow oval shapes containing smaller dragonfly-like insects and various green and orange specks.

1849.title: Cosmic Jellyfish Eye Vortex
1849.description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large central eye with a starry pupil, surrounded by jellyfish-like tentacles in a swirling vortex of colorful nebulae and space. Smaller jellyfish and orbs float around the composition against a dark starry background.

1850.title: Swirling Hair Portrait
1850.description: A stylized portrait of a woman with large spiral curls in vibrant orange and blue, set against a bright yellow background. White streaks and small snowflake-like details suggest wind or motion across the composition.

1851.title: Sinister Purple Pumpkin
1851.description: A large, menacing purple jack-o'-lantern with glowing orange eyes and a jagged mouth sits in a snowy landscape. Purple slime and icicles drip from its form as snow falls heavily against a vibrant green background.

1852.title: Speaker Pumpkin Beast
1852.description: A surreal blue pumpkin-like creature constructed from glowing speaker cones and orange fiery eyes, with a dark dripping tentacle horn on top. It sits in a vibrant abstract background of pink, orange, and yellow paint splatters with colorful drips and particles flowing across the scene.

1853.title: Psychedelic Spiral Hair Portrait
1853.description: A stylized portrait of a young woman with enormous, elaborate orange and blue spiral hair adorned with buttons, a marker, and a small cupcake. She wears a green turtleneck sweater under a yellow grid-patterned jacket against a bright yellow background.

1854.title: Steampunk Swirl Girl
1854.description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with enormous, elaborate swirling hair in orange and blue tones, adorned with metallic bolts and a small telescope. She wears a tattered yellow jacket over a green sweater, with large expressive eyes and a slight smile, set against a weathered industrial wall with faded stenciled text.

1856.title: Stasis Shelter 825
1856.description: A stylized portrait of a green-skinned girl with enormous swirling blue and green hair adorned with colorful spheres and a metallic cartridge. She wears a tattered yellow jacket against a concrete wall covered in paint drips, graffiti reading 'SHELTER 825' and 'NATURE'.

1857.title: Graffiti Wizard Girl
1857.description: A surreal portrait of a green-skinned female figure with enormous swirling yellow and blue hair styled in two large spirals adorned with numerous buttons and dripping paint. Her face features large detailed eyes, she wears a turtleneck sweater, and the entire composition is covered in layered graffiti tags and street art elements.

1858.title: Swirling Vortex Bloom
1858.description: An abstract painting featuring a central twisting knot of dark teal and blue surrounded by looping, petal-like forms in vibrant blue, green, and hints of pink. Thick paint drips heavily from the top and sides creating vertical streams of color against a white background.

1859.title: Vortex of Crimson Loops
1859.description: An abstract painting featuring swirling, interlocking loops and spirals in thick, textured strokes of red, yellow, black, and white. The composition has a distressed, cracked surface with prominent paint drips running downward from the forms.

1860.title: Serpent Vortex Graffiti
1860.description: A surreal abstract painting featuring a central swirling vortex of intertwined green, orange, and blue serpents with a metallic eyeball at its core. The composition is surrounded by dripping, concentric circular patterns in dark reds, greens, and yellows against a textured concrete-like background, with the word 'NIA' visible in an orange splatter at the bottom right.
1860.medium: spray paint and acrylic on concrete

1861.title: Melting Piano Symphony
1861.description: A grand piano merges with a violin floating above it, both dripping with glowing golden liquid as sheet music flies through the air. The surreal scene unfolds against a dark purple and teal background with swirling drapery and scattered musical notes.

1855.title: Shelter 325 Girl
1855.description: A stylized portrait of a young woman with enormous swirling blue and green hair adorned with metal bolts and a bullet casing. She wears a tattered yellow-green sweater with holes and has large, detailed blue eyes with a neutral expression.
1855.medium: spray paint and acrylic on canvas

1862.title: Melting Piano and Violin
1862.description: A grand piano with its lid open has yellow-green melting substance dripping down its keys and body, while a fiery orange violin floats above it emitting golden light rays. Sheet music floats and drapes around the instruments against a dark purple and teal draped background with glowing musical notes.

1863.title: Melting Piano and Violin
1863.description: A grand piano with yellow viscous substance dripping from its keys sits beneath a large glowing violin that appears to be melting or transforming. Sheet music floats through the dark surreal space against a dramatic draped background with golden musical notes and laurels.

1864.title: Melting Symphony
1864.description: A grand piano and a fiery violin float above a dark reflective surface, with golden liquid dripping from the piano keys. Sheet music swirls in a vortex of light and musical notes against a dramatic red and black draped background.

1865.title: Melting Piano and Violin
1865.description: A grand piano and violin merge in a surreal, melting composition with glowing teal liquid dripping from the keys and body. Sheet music floats through a dark, swirling stormy background with ethereal light rays and musical notes.

1866.title: Melting Melody
1866.description: A grand piano and a cello emerge from turbulent dark blue waters under a stormy sky. Golden musical notes, sheet music, and glowing green-yellow light swirl upward from the instruments in a surreal fusion of music and ocean.

1867.title: Desmos Graph Tablet
1867.description: An overhead view of a black tablet-like device displaying a colorful mathematical graph on a grid, featuring a magenta sine wave, green step function, blue curve, and multiple orange and pink spirals. The device appears to be melting or dripping with purple, teal, and pink paint against a textured background with faint mathematical notations.

1868.title: Mathematical Chaos on Tray
1868.description: An overhead view of a black tray containing a vibrant mathematical diagram with colorful plotted lines in pink, green, and orange against a grid. Blue and purple liquid-like forms spill across the surface while mathematical notations and equations frame the composition on a textured, paint-splattered background.

1869.title: Desmos #212 Stasis
1869.description: An overhead view of a glowing, tablet-like artifact floating above dark reflective water. The rectangular device displays a glowing blue-orange orb entangled in black wires and organic tendrils, resting on a purple grid with mathematical graphs, numbers, and a winding brown path resembling a Desmos plot.

1870.title: Desmos #212 Stasis Map
1870.description: An overhead view of an ancient, rectangular artifact resembling a weathered map or tablet, partially submerged in dark reflective liquid. A glowing orange orb sits at the center of a tangled nest of dark wires or roots, with a winding path, grid lines, symbols, and the text '#212 Desmos' visible on its surface.

1871.title: Desmos #212 Artifact
1871.description: An aged, rectangular metallic tablet floats above rippling liquid, displaying an intricate glowing map with winding paths, geometric symbols, and a prominent orange-green orb nestled in a nest of dark wires in the lower right. The tablet's surface shows signs of wear with visible grid lines and handwritten annotations.

1872.title: The Alchemists' Workshop
1872.description: A lively group of medieval scholars, alchemists, and wizards gather around a long wooden table covered in papers, maps, and candles inside a cluttered study. The purple-hued room is filled with hanging lanterns, walls covered in esoteric diagrams and artwork, while servants bring refreshments through a doorway in the background.

1873.title: Renaissance Gathering in Studio
1873.description: A lively group of people dressed in Renaissance and medieval attire gather around a long wooden table in a cluttered artist's studio. They examine large open books with anatomical drawings while surrounded by walls covered in sketches, diagrams, and an abstract painting, with a woman serving food in the background.

1874.title: Bohemian Artists' Supper
1874.description: A lively group of artists and intellectuals gather around a long wooden table laden with food and candles in a cluttered, red-walled studio. The walls are covered with numerous paintings, sketches, and papers while a woman serves drinks and a cat rests on a nearby stack of books.

1875.title: Chaotic Artist's Dinner Party
1875.description: A lively group of artists and eccentrics gather around a long wooden table laden with pizza boxes, candles, and scattered papers in a cluttered, warmly lit room. The walls are covered with numerous artworks, sketches, and a large colorful abstract painting, while a woman serves drinks and a cat rests on a stack of books nearby.

1876.title: Blue Green Infinity Swirls
1876.description: An abstract painting featuring intertwined, looping ribbon-like forms in vibrant blue and green. Thick paint creates fluid, swirling patterns with visible drips, splatters, and bubbles against a white background.

1877.title: Emerald Serpent Infinity
1877.description: A surreal painting of two intertwined green serpents forming an infinity symbol with swirling vortex patterns. The serpents have scaled textures, dripping viscous paint effects, and a small red creature visible at the center of the right spiral.

1878.title: Iridescent Beetle Ouroboros
1878.description: A large, vibrant painting of a metallic green and blue beetle intertwined with a massive green snake forming a twisted infinity loop. The composition features swirling orange, green and black forms with dripping paint effects over faint background sketches of figures and symbols.

1879.title: Contemplating the Wave
1879.description: A solitary figure in a light blue robe stands on a barren shore, gazing up at a massive curling wave that dominates the sky. The wave is intricately decorated with glowing orange and teal spiral and floral patterns against a soft gradient sunset background.

1880.title: Contemplating the Wave
1880.description: A robed figure stands on a grassy hill contemplating a towering stylized wave composed of large pink and yellow peonies with green leaves. The scene is set against a gradient sunset sky with scattered petals floating in the air.

1881.title: Contemplating the Wave
1881.description: A robed figure stands on a grassy hill, gazing upward at an enormous swirling wave composed of giant magenta and yellow peonies. The dramatic sky features a glowing orange and teal vortex with scattered petals floating throughout the surreal scene.

1882.title: Cosmic Peony Dreamer
1882.description: A lone figure in a dark robe stands on a petal-strewn ground, gazing upward while holding a large glowing peony. Massive magenta and cream peonies swirl into a luminous purple and gold cosmic nebula filled with stars and flowing light.

1883.title: Cosmic Peony Dreamer
1883.description: A lone figure in a dark robe stands in a field of enormous, vibrant peonies beneath a swirling purple and gold cosmic vortex in the night sky. An orange dragon-like creature emerges from the swirling portal above, surrounded by glowing flowers and floating petals.

1884.title: Glowing Orb Portal
1884.description: A large cracked green spherical orb rests on rocky ground, emitting a bright green glow from its base. Through a large irregular opening, a dark castle sits atop a mountain ridge against a fiery red and orange sunset sky.

1885.title: Oval Portrait with Red Bird
1885.description: A surreal painting rests within an ornate oval frame set into a decaying purple stone arch. Two women with long flowing hair—one dark with green highlights, one red—gaze in opposite directions while a vibrant red bird perches on their joined hands.

1886.title: Crimson Mirror of Duality
1886.description: A surreal painting featuring an ornate oval frame containing two intertwined women with long dark hair, one holding a red bird. The composition is dramatically slashed by a diagonal red beam with thick red liquid dripping down from the top and sides onto a dark surface scattered with red petals.

1887.title: Crimson Portrait of Duality
1887.description: A surreal painting features an ornate oval frame containing two women with contrasting appearances: one with dark hair and flowers, the other with red hair and a braid, both in pinkish-red attire. The frame is set against a dark, textured background with dramatic red liquid dripping from above and scattered red petals below, alongside floating geometric shapes.

1888.title: Crimson Mirror Portrait
1888.description: A surreal painting features an ornate oval frame containing two women with long dark hair and red floral elements, one holding a red bird. The frame is set against a dark stone arch with dramatic red liquid dripping down from above, surrounded by scattered red petals and floating hexagonal shapes.

1889.title: Crimson Portrait of Duality
1889.description: A surreal painting features an ornate oval frame containing two women with pale skin and dark hair, one in profile and one facing forward, both entwined with vibrant red flowers. The composition is set against a dark stone archway with dramatic red liquid dripping down from above, surrounded by floating golden and white geometric shapes.

1890.title: Crimson Twin Portrait
1890.description: A dramatic oval portrait featuring two women with dark hair and golden highlights, one in profile and the other facing forward, both in red attire. They hold a small red bird between them, set against a dark, chaotic background with dripping red paint, scattered gold coins, and broken stone arches.

1891.title: Vibrant Poppy Field
1891.description: A painting of numerous bright orange-red poppies with dark centers and green leaves and stems in the foreground. The background features a soft, abstract purple and yellow sky with geometric shapes and light rays suggesting sunrise or sunset.

1892.title: Ethereal Ear Symphony
1892.description: A pale woman in a flowing pink dress sits in an ornate wooden chair, gazing upward with her hands open as glowing energy emanates from her palms. Multiple disembodied ears and mouths float in the air around her, connected by thin glowing lines, within a decaying ornate room with blue curtains and an open book on a nearby table.

1893.title: Cocoon Emergence
1893.description: A surreal painting depicts a muscular human torso and arm breaking free from a large cracked iridescent chrysalis. The extended hand drips with blue liquid while various moths and geometric fragments float in the dark cosmic background.

1894.title: Painted Mystic Hand
1894.description: An upraised human hand with intricate, tree-like veins and lines is rendered in earthy brown tones. The palm features a glowing blue triangular symbol at its center, while the fingers and background display vibrant, colorful paint splashes in red, orange, green, and purple.

1895.title: Cosmic Fractured Hand
1895.description: A massive, intricately detailed hand dominates the composition, its surface cracked with glowing orange energy and covered in teal and purple textures. Smaller hands emerge from swirling cosmic clouds of magenta, teal, and dark blue, surrounded by floating golden symbols, leaves, and ethereal particles.

1896.title: Toxic Grasp
1896.description: A massive, decaying human hand dominates the foreground, its palm split open to release glowing green and purple toxic liquid that drips downward. The background shows a post-apocalyptic industrial wasteland with broken buildings, a water tower, chain-link fences, and a cracked sky glowing with orange and green hues.

1897.title: Cracked Hand with Pine
1897.description: A surreal painting of a human hand viewed from above, palm up with fingers spread. The hand shows deep cracks with green pine needles and branches emerging from within, while small pine cones and fragments float around it against an abstract background.

1898.title: Bleeding Heart Grasp
1898.description: A realistic human hand reaches upward from the bottom left, fingers pressing into a large, dripping heart shape that dominates the center. The heart appears fractured with black viscous liquid and red paint flowing downward from the point of contact.

1899.title: Bleeding Heart in Hand
1899.description: A realistic human hand is held palm-up with fingers spread, cradling a vibrant pink-red heart that drips thick black liquid. The background is a dynamic, colorful abstract composition with radiating light beams, paint splatters, and cracked textures.

1900.title: Bleeding Heart with Butterflies
1900.description: A surreal painting depicts a human hand held palm-up with a realistic anatomical heart resting in its center. The heart bleeds dark red liquid down the wrist while bright green and black butterflies emerge from the fingertips against a vibrant, dripping abstract background.
1900.medium: spray paint and acrylic on canvas

1901.title: Spiritbox Locked Transmission
1901.description: A surreal painting of an ornate, padlocked wooden chest floating in a dark cosmic void. The open lid reveals three distorted screaming faces in purple, red, and green tones, with white sound waves and radio signals emanating from the box.

1902.title: Mandala Eye Mosaic
1902.description: An overhead view of a large, elongated oval mosaic artwork featuring concentric circular patterns in teal, rust, and pink tones. The piece rests on a dark tiled surface with visible red paint drips along its lower edge and a smaller similar fragment in the upper left.

1903.title: Cosmic Mandala Portal
1903.description: An intricate, symmetrical circular mandala dominates the frame, featuring glowing geometric patterns, purple crystal-like forms, and layered sacred geometry. The entire composition appears to float in a swirling cosmic space with vibrant purple and orange light streaks radiating outward.

1904.title: Floating Celestial Citadel
1904.description: A massive ornate circular metallic platform floats above a patchwork agricultural landscape dotted with wind turbines. At its center, a glowing crystalline structure contains a dark silhouetted figure, surrounded by swirling energy rings under a dramatic sky with streaking meteors.

1905.title: Swamp Witch with Potion
1905.description: A green-skinned witch with pointed ears and a thorny crown sits in a murky swamp, grinning with her tongue out while holding a glowing green potion in a sack. She is surrounded by purple flowers, dead trees, and Spanish moss under a dramatic twilight sky.

1906.title: Cyber Witch Hacking
1906.description: An elderly witch with long stringy hair and a pointed hat sits at a vintage computer, typing with gnarled hands while a monitor displays 'ROOT... HAG BREACH...'. The scene is filled with floating runes, circuit patterns, and a thatched hut in a swirling purple vortex background.

1907.title: Enigmatic Celestial Throne
1907.description: A majestic faceless figure sits on an ornate golden throne, wearing a robe covered in esoteric symbols and blue gems. The figure's head is a luminous white orb with a star at its center, set against a cosmic sky with glowing halos and distant golden pyramids.

1908.title: All-Seeing Throne
1908.description: A solitary winged figure with a large all-seeing eye for a head sits enthroned on a stepped dais in a surreal landscape. The sky above is a dramatic vortex of orange, purple and black clouds pierced by a vertical beam of light, while Egyptian symbols, keys and geometric fragments float throughout the scene.

1909.title: Crimson Moon Sorceress
1909.description: A woman in an ornate black and red Victorian gown stands with her back to the viewer on a rocky outcrop, holding a small object in her raised hand. She gazes at a massive, blood-red full moon dominating a starry night sky above a desolate landscape of twisted dead trees and purple mountains shrouded in mist.

1910.title: Crimson Moon Gothic Scene
1910.description: A woman in an ornate black Victorian gown stands with her back to the viewer in a surreal night landscape. She gazes at a massive, detailed red blood moon dominating a starry purple and red sky, surrounded by twisted bare trees with hanging lanterns and scattered bones on the ground.

1911.title: Witch under Blood Moon
1911.description: A solitary witch in an ornate dark gown stands with her back to the viewer, arms raised in a ritual gesture as beams of light stream from a massive, textured blood-red moon dominating the starry night sky. The surreal landscape features twisted, gnarled trees with spiral symbols and glowing eyes, set against a colorful gradient horizon with scattered red petals on the ground.

1912.title: Sorcerer and Crimson Eclipse
1912.description: A lone hooded sorcerer in an ornate dark robe stands on a cracked purple path, gazing toward a massive red celestial body marked with a glowing cross that radiates intense light beams across a cosmic sky.

1913.title: Witch Under Blood Moon
1913.description: A solitary woman in an ornate dark gown stands with her back to the viewer in the center of a glowing magical circle on the ground. She faces a massive red blood moon featuring a glowing cross, surrounded by twisted barren trees, hanging lanterns, and a dramatic swirling night sky.

1914.title: Digital Skeleton Oracle
1914.description: A blue-skinned skeletal figure stands centrally with mouth open, one hand raised and dripping while the other holds a floral wreath and a small glowing orb. The background features fragmented geometric panels with circuit patterns, sheet music, fern leaves, and the numbers 41 and 11 under a dark cloudy sky.

1915.title: One Last Breath
1915.description: A golden skeletal creature with a melting skull head stands on a barren alien landscape, dripping viscous fluid onto a glowing mound where a small white caterpillar-like being with large eyes rests. In the background, a massive ringed planet looms over rocky formations under a hazy sky, with another small creature visible in the distance.

1916.title: Golden Skull Larva Dream
1916.description: A surreal desert landscape features a giant golden skull dripping honey-like liquid from above, while two large white larvae with oversized black eyes interact with the golden substance on a mound below. The background shows a purple sky with green aurora, ringed planets, and orange rocky formations.

1917.title: Heart Weaver
1917.description: A luminous woman with closed eyes gently releases a cascade of glowing hearts from her hands against a swirling purple background. Her form and flowing hair are composed of layered heart petals in warm and cool tones.

1918.title: Embracing Heartbreak
1918.description: A couple passionately embraces and kisses at the center of a vibrant, surreal composition. The man is covered in red heart-shaped leaves while a large cracked heart floats above them against a swirling, colorful sky, with faces visible in the dark water below.

1919.title: Knight of the Crimson Eclipse
1919.description: A solitary armored knight stands on an ornate balcony ledge, back turned to the viewer while holding a sword. Behind him swirls a massive hypnotic spiral of black and white patterns interwoven with olive green tendrils, set against a blood-red moon in a dark sky.

1920.title: Mystic Cat Figure
1920.description: A stylized anthropomorphic cat with blue hair and yellow eyes stands centered on a glowing circular platform. The cat wears a blue patterned pajama set with crescent moon and star symbols, has a long curved tail with a heart-shaped pendant, and is surrounded by floating purple cat-shaped silhouettes against a deep blue background.

1921.title: Cat Statue on Pedestal
1921.description: A stylized anthropomorphic cat figure with black hair, yellow eyes, and a long curved tail stands centered on an ornate circular pedestal. The cat wears a detailed blue patterned suit with a high collar, set against a dark background with peeling purple and green textured fragments.

1922.title: Cat Statue on Pedestal
1922.description: A stylized anthropomorphic cat with black hair and pointed ears stands upright on an ornate circular pedestal. The cat wears a detailed blue patterned suit with a high collar, has a long curved tail with a ring, and is surrounded by floating purple torn paper fragments against a dark smoky background.

1923.title: Cat Character Turnaround
1923.description: A 2D animated cat-girl character displayed in six sequential poses against a neutral gray background, showing front, three-quarter, side, and back views.

1924.title: Miles Morales Stasis Turnaround
1924.description: A digital character reference sheet displaying seven static poses of Miles Morales in a blue and black Spider-Man variant suit. The views include front, three-quarter front, side profile, rear, three-quarter rear, and additional angled stances against a plain beige background with alignment guides.

1926.title: Giraffe Character Turnaround
1926.description: A digital illustration showing a stylized anthropomorphic giraffe in six different poses and angles wearing a black and purple patterned outfit with glowing pink accents.

1925.title: Blue Uniform Character Turnaround
1925.description: A digital illustration showing eight sequential poses of a young male character with dark hair in a blue military-style uniform featuring a spider emblem on the back. The figures are arranged in a row displaying front, side, and rear views against a plain neutral background.

1927.title: Giraffe Character Turnaround
1927.description: A digital character design sheet displaying a stylized anthropomorphic giraffe in multiple angled poses wearing a patterned tunic, black belt, and boots against a plain background.

1928.title: THAW Character Turnaround
1928.description: A 2D animated character displayed in seven distinct poses against a neutral gray background, showing front, side, back, and three-quarter views. The young Black male figure wears a matching blue sweatsuit with white 'THAW' text, a padlock graphic, and repeating small icons, paired with black boots.

1929.title: Wizard Character Turnaround
1929.description: A series of eight posed views of a young wizard wearing a blue robe, pointed hat, and holding a staff with a glowing turquoise orb. The character is shown from front, side, back, and three-quarter angles against a solid light blue background.

1930.title: Wizard Turnaround Sheet
1930.description: A row of nine sequential poses showing a young wizard in a blue robe and pointed hat, holding a glowing staff. The character is depicted from multiple angles including front, side, and back views against a plain background.

1931.title: Wizard Character Turnaround
1931.description: A series of nine sequential poses showing a young wizard in a blue robe and pointed hat, holding a wooden staff topped with a glowing blue orb. The character is viewed from various angles including front, side, and back against a solid light blue background.

1932.title: Spider-Man Hoodie Turnaround
1932.description: A digital character design sheet displaying eight sequential poses of a young male figure in a purple and red Spider-Man themed hoodie with black pants and boots. The character is shown from front, side, and back angles against a solid dark blue background with a subtle purple glow outline.

1933.title: Miles Morales Suit Turnaround
1933.description: A digital character model sheet displaying eight sequential poses of Miles Morales in a purple and black Spider-Man variant suit with white spider emblem, hoodie, and glowing purple accents. The character is shown from front, three-quarter, side, and back angles against a solid dark blue background with a subtle purple outline glow.

1934.title: Spider-Man Hoodie Turnaround
1934.description: A digital character turnaround showing eight sequential poses of a young male figure in a purple and red Spider-Man hoodie with glowing white spider emblem, black tactical pants, and boots. The character is viewed from front, three-quarter, side, and back angles against a solid dark blue background with a subtle purple glow outline.

1935.title: Blue Superhero Turnaround
1935.description: A young male character with dark curly hair is shown in eight sequential poses against a solid blue-gray background, wearing a form-fitting blue superhero suit with glowing purple chest emblem and web-like pattern on the back.

1936.title: Spider-Man Noir Turnaround
1936.description: A digital character reference displaying eight sequential poses of a young male figure in a black trench coat with a large white spider emblem on the back, purple accents, and intricate chest armor. The views progress from front, three-quarter, side, and rear angles against a dark gradient background with a subtle glowing outline effect.

1937.title: Red-haired Character Turnaround
1937.description: A horizontal sequence of eight poses showing a red-haired figure in a blue plaid coat with purple accents, viewed from front, side, and back angles. The character is surrounded by glowing multicolored circular particles against a dark background.

1938.title: Spider-Man Costume Turnaround
1938.description: Eight sequential poses of a young male character in a blue and white Spider-Man inspired costume with web patterns and large spider emblem on the chest. The figure is shown from front, side, and back angles against a solid dark blue background.

1939.title: Spider-Man Blue Suit Turnaround
1939.description: A digital character model sheet displaying eight sequential poses of a young male figure in a blue and white Spider-Man inspired suit with spider emblems and web patterns. The character is shown from front, three-quarter, side, and back angles against a solid dark blue background.

1940.title: Spider Character Turnaround
1940.description: Eight sequential views of a stylized spider-like creature with a large blue patterned abdomen featuring web-like designs and a brown body with blue eyes. The figures are arranged in a 2x4 grid showing various angles from front, side, and three-quarter perspectives against a light textured background with purple glows.

1941.title: Blue Spider Sequence
1941.description: A 2x4 grid of eight sequential illustrations showing a large blue spider with patterned abdomen and light brown legs in slightly varied poses against colored backgrounds.

1942.title: Giraffe Butler Poses
1942.description: A 2x4 grid of illustrations showing an anthropomorphic giraffe character in a butler's uniform, posed in various angles from front to back views with its long neck curved in different positions.

1943.title: Spider-Human Hybrid Grid
1943.description: A 4x6 grid of twenty-four hand-drawn illustrations showing a humanoid figure with a large spider-like abdomen and multiple legs in various hunched, bent-over poses. The figures wear blue overalls and are depicted against a solid light purple background.

1944.title: Egg Spider Character Grid
1944.description: A 3x5 grid of identical cartoon illustrations featuring an anthropomorphic egg character with a spider-like lower body, wearing a blue dress with pink floral accents and holding a small brown bag.

1945.title: Egg Spider Character Grid
1945.description: A 3x6 grid of repeated cartoon illustrations featuring an anthropomorphic egg character with a spider body, wearing a blue dress and holding a book, shown in various poses against a plain gray background.

1946.title: Female Character Pose Sheet
1946.description: A grid of multiple static poses showing the same stylized woman with a black ponytail, wearing a tight grey top, blue shorts, and black high heels. The views include front, side, back, and three-quarter angles from various elevations against a plain background.

1947.title: Crocodile Character Turnaround
1947.description: A 4x4 grid of an anthropomorphic crocodile character shown in multiple angles and poses including front, side, back, and three-quarter views. The character wears a blue vest over a white shirt with a red neckerchief, blue jeans, and brown boots.

1948.title: Psychedelic Character Turnaround
1948.description: A 3x5 grid of cartoon illustrations showing a man with leafy hair in various poses and angles against vibrant tie-dye backgrounds. The sequence includes front, side, and back views with one larger distorted figure in the bottom row wearing a red plaid shirt and cape-like garment.

1949.title: Scarecrow Character Turnaround
1949.description: A 4x5 grid of illustrated poses showing a cartoon scarecrow from multiple angles including front, side, back, and three-quarter views. The scarecrow wears a red plaid shirt, blue jeans, brown boots, and a black cap with straw protruding from its neck and sleeves.

1950.title: Character Turnaround Sheet
1950.description: A 3x6 grid of a young man with curly dark hair wearing a red plaid shirt, blue jeans, and boots while holding a tall ornate golden staff. The character is shown in multiple angles including front, side, and back views with a consistent glowing red and green magical aura effect surrounding him against a plain gray background.

1951.title: Character Turnaround Sheet
1951.description: A 4x5 grid of 3D rendered character studies showing a middle-aged man with weathered features, stubble, and messy hair wearing a red plaid shirt and jeans. Multiple angles include close-up head views, front, side, and back full-body poses against a dark background with a glowing aura effect.

1952.title: Peacock Woman Grid
1952.description: A 3x6 grid of repeated illustrations showing a woman in a flowing yellow dress and matching headwrap, standing in various poses against a stylized teal and pink peacock feather backdrop.

1953.title: Repeating Mystic Figure Grid
1953.description: A 3x6 grid of identical stylized female figures with pale skin, long dark hair, green wide-brimmed hats, and flowing teal-and-black patterned dresses. Each figure is surrounded by a glowing golden aura against a muted mauve background.

1954.title: Crocodile Man Turnaround
1954.description: A 4x5 grid of posed views showing a male character with a reptilian tail wearing a long blue coat, white shirt, and dark trousers. The sheet displays front, side, and back angles across three rows with subtle background color variations from pink to blue-gray.

1955.title: Frog Officer Grid
1955.description: A 3x5 grid of identical cartoon frogs wearing military-style uniforms, black berets, and some with long blue braided hair, all posed against a solid red background.

1956.title: Stained Stratocaster Still Life
1956.description: An overhead view of a weathered Fender Stratocaster electric guitar covered in gold and beige paint splatters, resting on a worn wooden table. The scene includes a spray can, paintbrush, and stenciled papers with guitar silhouettes and text fragments scattered around it.

1957.title: Stasis Prop Guitar
1957.description: A weathered electric guitar with a cracked and peeling surface lies diagonally on a rough concrete ledge. The guitar features glowing cyan runes and symbols along its neck and body, with 'STASIS PROP - DO NOT MOVE' stenciled on the ledge above it.

1958.title: Stasis Guitar
1958.description: A dark blue electric guitar covered in white stenciled graphics including crossed wrenches, lightning bolts, a raised fist, and the text 'TOOL STASIS HOLD FAST'. It rests on a paint-splattered metal table with a cable plugged into its output jack. The background features projected blue graffiti and symbols including more lightning bolts and partial text.

1959.title: Pink Chalice Prop
1959.description: An overhead view of a mixed-media artwork featuring a large pink and yellow chalice with dripping yellow paint, resting on crumpled yellow paper covered in repeated lock and key symbols. The piece is surrounded by pink paper tags labeled 'PROP' and 'ASSET', with additional painted chalice silhouettes and chain motifs, all set against a vibrant pink painted background on a wooden surface.

1960.title: Torn Portrait Sculpture
1960.description: A surreal painted sculpture of a classical male profile in side view sits on a wooden surface, its face rendered in earthy tones with visible linework. The head is dramatically split by a vertically torn, aged paper-like structure bearing the text 'SPQR' and 'BOSCO', with broken fragments scattered in front and a sculpting tool nearby.

1961.title: Blueberry Lotus Chalice
1961.description: A surreal portrait of a dark-skinned woman with blueberries in her hair, emerging from a giant pink lotus inside a large green bowl filled with blueberries. She holds a silver chalice while surrounded by colorful translucent orbs containing silhouettes of figures and nature motifs against a swirling yellow-green background.

1963.title: Red 07 Race Car
1963.description: A detailed illustration of a sleek red, black, and white Le Mans-style race car with the number 07 prominently displayed on the hood and side. The vehicle features an aerodynamic body, large rear wing, prominent exhaust pipes, and Goodyear-branded tires against a plain neutral background.

1962.title: Formula 1 in Ancient Hall
1962.description: A vibrant red Formula 1 race car with number 70 drifts sharply around a curved track painted on the floor of a grand, decaying cathedral-like hall with frescoed walls and arched ceilings. Beams of light stream from an oculus above, illuminating swirling papers, tire smoke, and ornate black flourishes as the car speeds through the surreal scene.

1964.title: Porsche 917 Race Car
1964.description: A detailed side-profile painting of a classic blue Porsche 917 Le Mans race car with red and yellow stripes. The vehicle features the number 07, prominent sponsor logos including Shell, Bosch, and Goodyear, and casts a distinct shadow on the ground.

1965.title: Red Formula 1 Racer 77
1965.description: A detailed painting of a vintage red Formula 1 race car with the number 77 prominently displayed on its side and nose. The open-wheel vehicle features prominent rear wings labeled AERO, exposed mechanical components, and casts a distinct blue shadow on the neutral background.

1966.title: Porsche 911 Turbo Race Car
1966.description: A weathered and faded blue and beige Porsche 911 Turbo race car, prominently displaying the number 77 in dripping blue paint. The vintage racing livery features Shell, Goodyear, and 'TURBO' sponsor markings, captured in a detailed side profile against a plain background.

1967.title: Rusted Porsche 917 Turbo
1967.description: A heavily weathered and rusted scale model of a Porsche 917 race car with large rear wing. The model features faded racing decals including the number 77, Shell and Goodyear logos, 'TURBO' text, and various sponsor markings on its corroded metal body.

1968.title: Lunar Candy Lodge
1968.description: A vibrant, glowing treehouse complex named Lunar Candy Lodge built into a massive ancient tree, featuring multiple illuminated levels with crescent moon decorations and neon signage. A rope bridge with colorful lanterns connects to a wooden staircase while the night sky displays a crescent moon and green aurora borealis.

1969.title: Mogieway's Bugs Farm
1969.description: A dilapidated red barn covered in glowing butterflies and insects stands beside a cylindrical silo at twilight. A dirt road leads past a wooden warning sign reading 'BEWARE THE MOTH SWARM' through a misty, overgrown landscape with a stone wall and distant hills.

1970.title: Mogieway's Bug Farm
1970.description: A dilapidated wooden barn covered in glowing cyan graffiti of a toothy monkey mascot stands in a foggy, desolate landscape. A massive neon cyan monkey head with dripping paint hovers in the purple and teal night sky above the eerie scene.

1971.title: Mogieway's Bug Farm
1971.description: A surreal nighttime scene depicts a dilapidated wooden barn covered in glowing blue monkey graffiti under a dramatic purple and orange sky. A massive, dripping neon monkey face with pink eyes floats ominously above the structure while a warning sign reads 'BEWARE THE DAMN SNAKE' in the foreground.

1972.title: MosieWay's Bugs Farm
1972.description: A surreal psychedelic barn covered in glowing graffiti and cartoonish bug-eyed faces stands under a giant floating neon monkey head with dripping paint. The scene features a dirt road leading to the farm, surrounded by bioluminescent plants, swirling patterns, and a wooden warning sign that reads 'BEWARE THE BARN SNATCH'.

1973.title: Mosheway's Bug Farm
1973.description: A surreal nighttime scene depicts a dilapidated barn covered in glowing graffiti featuring monkey faces and psychedelic patterns. A massive dripping neon cyan monkey head with pink eyes floats in the swirling, colorful sky above the foggy farm landscape.

1974.title: Insect Haven at Dusk
1974.description: A whimsical glass greenhouse filled with glowing lanterns and insect-themed decorations stands on a wooden deck surrounded by beehives and flowers. In the misty background, a wooden barn labeled 'HIVE & HUM' connects via a string of lights while an 'INSECT EXHIBIT THIS WAY' sign points toward the scene under a colorful sunset sky.

1975.title: Hive & Hum Greenhouse
1975.description: A weathered glass greenhouse filled with glowing lanterns and bee boxes stands beside a wooden barn labeled 'HIVE & HUM'. A circular portal in the greenhouse reveals a vibrant sunset over water, while fireflies illuminate the misty twilight scene.

1976.title: Hive & Hum Greenhouse
1976.description: A glowing, ramshackle greenhouse filled with strange experiments and floating orbs sits beside a wooden barn labeled 'HIVE & HUM' under a dramatic twilight sky. The scene features lily pads on water, a sign reading 'INSECT TAXI', and surreal orbs containing miniature cityscapes and sunsets.

1977.title: Enchanted Greenhouse Sphere Pond
1977.description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a large glass greenhouse with glowing yellow cracks and a massive circular window showing a mountain sunset. In the foreground pond, two reflective spheres rest on lily pads, one displaying a futuristic city at dusk and the other a cracked white surface, surrounded by cattails and dragonflies.

1978.title: Enchanted Greenhouse Portal
1978.description: A mystical greenhouse structure with a large circular portal showing a mountain sunset, surrounded by glowing butterflies and crackling golden light. In the foreground pond, two reflective spheres display a cyberpunk cityscape at dusk while dragonflies and fairies hover throughout the surreal landscape.

1979.title: Portal Pond Gathering
1979.description: A surreal fantasy scene at dusk featuring a grey gremlin-like creature with large ears standing on a stone path beside a glowing spherical orb containing a red cityscape. In the foreground, a small white alien robot with multiple eyes stands on a lily pad near a large wooden building labeled 'INTO THE VOID COLLECTIVE' with a massive circular portal showing a mountain sunset, surrounded by glowing blue and purple flowers and floating dragon-like creatures.

1980.title: Mogwai and Alien at Portal
1980.description: A whimsical fantasy scene featuring a gremlin-like Mogwai creature standing on a stone path beside a large reflective sphere showing a cityscape at sunset. A small white alien robot with multiple eyes sits on a lily pad nearby, with a wooden building labeled 'INTO THE VOID COLLECTIVE' containing a glowing circular portal to mountains at sunset in the background.

1981.title: Insect Terrarium Room
1981.description: A cozy wooden room with skylights contains multiple glass terrariums housing cute anthropomorphic insects with large eyes. Through a large circular window and glass doors, a serene landscape shows a misty lake with two giant reflective spheres at sunset.

1982.title: Insectarium Display Case
1982.description: A weathered green wooden and glass display cabinet labeled 'INSECTARIUM' contains a curated collection of pinned beetles and moths arranged in rows. The antique entomological specimen case stands against a plain neutral background, casting a soft shadow.

1983.title: Insectarium Display Case
1983.description: A vintage green wooden insectarium cabinet with glass doors stands against a neutral background. Inside, various preserved insects including butterflies and beetles are meticulously pinned and labeled on a beige backing, with the word INSECTARIUM arched across the top.

1984.title: Anthropomorphic Rat Character Sheet
1984.description: A grid of multiple posed views of a single anthropomorphic rat character wearing a blue traditional outfit with pink accents. The rat is shown in various angles including front, side, back, and three-quarter views with a glowing ethereal aura around each figure.

1985.title: Anthropomorphic Mouse Grid
1985.description: A 4x6 grid of repeated illustrations showing an anthropomorphic mouse character in various poses and angles. The mouse wears a brown robe and stands in a stylized yellow street scene with glowing light effects.

1986.title: Gingerbread Man Turnaround
1986.description: A 4x6 grid of illustrated poses showing a cheerful gingerbread man character from front, side, and back angles. The brown cookie figure wears a blue jacket with white buttons, red belt, red bow, and brown boots with white icing details.

1987.title: Gingerbread Man Grid Study
1987.description: A 3x5 grid of detailed 3D-rendered gingerbread cookies featuring a female gingerbread character in various angles and expressions. Each figure wears a colorful dress with rainbow patterns and stands before a vibrant rainbow backdrop on a light surface.

1988.title: Gingerbread Wizard Grid
1988.description: A 4x4 grid of repeated digital illustrations showing a smiling gingerbread man in a green patterned coat standing on a wooden shelf. The background features large glowing green eyes, a rainbow, and small blue creatures, with one central panel enlarged showing the figure with hands on hips.

1989.title: Gingerbread Zombie Sprites
1989.description: A 4x6 grid of illustrated gingerbread cookie characters in various poses, showing front, side, and back views. Each cookie has green glowing eyes, a tattered grey lab coat, green pants, and a glowing blue-green aura against a solid grey background.

1990.title: Gingerbread Character Grid
1990.description: A 4x5 grid of repeated poses featuring an anthropomorphic gingerbread figure with a long purple tail, wearing a purple jacket and hat. The character is shown in various angles including front, side, and back views against a grey background with glowing multicolored auras.

1991.title: Gingerbread Man Turnaround Sheet
1991.description: A grid of multiple posed views of a single decorated gingerbread man cookie character with blue eyes, red bow tie, and icing details. The layout shows front, side, and back angles arranged in rows against a plain background.

1992.title: Character Turnaround Sheet
1992.description: A 3x5 grid of a young male character displayed in multiple angles including front, side, back, and three-quarter views. The character wears a long, colorful coat featuring cloud patterns, a blue dragon, and large stylized green and orange eyes.

1993.title: Character Turnaround Sheet
1993.description: A grid of multiple static poses showing a young boy in a green floral outfit from front, side, and back angles. The image is divided into three horizontal bands with different background elements including pink roses, orange fiery rings, and rainbows over purple flowers.

1994.title: Anthropomorphic Fox in Victorian Attire
1994.description: A repeated grid of an anthropomorphic red fox character with long flowing hair, wearing a black and gold Victorian-style dress with pink rose accents and black boots. The fox holds a bouquet of pink roses and stands beside a small blue creature in a colorful psychedelic landscape with rainbows and swirling patterns.

2009.title: Bearded Warrior Over Ruins
2009.description: A stern, heavily tattooed bearded warrior with a scarred face stares directly forward from the center of a cosmic composition. Below him lies a ruined cityscape with white flowers blooming in the foreground, all surrounded by swirling dark clouds, mechanical gears, and a starry purple nebula with dramatic light rays from above.

2008.title: Mystical Portal Conjurer
2008.description: A man in a dark coat stands centered within a glowing circular portal, holding two luminous orbs. The surreal scene is framed by swirling clouds, white flowers, twisted branches, floating mathematical equations, and ancient symbols under dramatic beams of light from above.

2007.title: Sorcerer in Shadowed Courtyard
2007.description: A lone warrior stands in the center of a dilapidated stone courtyard under a stormy sky. He holds a glowing magical circle of runes and lightning in his outstretched hands while dramatic light rays pierce through dark clouds above.

2006.title: Sorcerer in Stormy Ruins
2006.description: A lone sorcerer in a dark coat stands in the foreground, channeling swirling blue-white magic from both hands. Behind him, massive gnarled trees merge with towering gothic ruins under a roiling, ominous sky of turbulent storm clouds.

2005.title: Ornamental Orchard
2005.description: A dense, stylized composition of interconnected orange and red spherical fruits hanging from thin branches with green leaves against a dark navy background. Colorful swirling rainbow patterns in purple, green, and blue frame the left and right edges of the intricate, folk-art inspired pattern.

2004.title: Psychedelic Swirl Tapestry
2004.description: An abstract composition of flowing, interlocking wave forms and spirals in vibrant, layered colors. The patterns create a dynamic, rhythmic movement across the entire canvas with visible brushstroke texture.

2003.title: Art Crate
2003.description: A weathered metal art crate is shown at an angle against a neutral gray background. The crate features bold red stenciled text reading 'ART CRATE', 'STUDIO #802020', and 'STUDIO - 40 LBS'.

2002.title: Art Crate
2002.description: A weathered wooden shipping crate with blue stenciled text reading 'ART CRATE', 'STUDIO', '#802020', and 'STUDIO - 40 LBS'. The empty crate sits at a three-quarter angle on a neutral gray surface with soft directional lighting casting a distinct shadow.

2001.title: Wooden Art Crate
2001.description: A weathered wooden shipping crate stands at an angle against a plain gray background. The crate features black stenciled text reading 'ART CRATE', 'STUDIO #802020', and 'STUDIO - 40 LBS'.

2000.title: Vintage Banana Crate
2000.description: A weathered wooden banana crate from Houma, Louisiana, marked with stenciled text reading 'BANANA CRATES', 'HOUMA #802020', and 'HOUMA - 40 LBS' with a circular stamp. The empty slatted box sits at an angle on a plain gray surface, casting a soft shadow.

1999.title: Wooden Banana Crate
1999.description: A weathered wooden banana crate is shown at an angle against a plain gray background. The crate features stenciled text reading 'BANANAS', 'JAMAICA', '40 LBS' along with a circular 'Jamaica Bananas' logo.

1998.title: Vintage Banana Crate
1998.description: A weathered wooden banana crate with visible grain and slats, featuring bold orange stenciled text reading 'BANANAS' and 'JAMAICA - 40 LBS' on two sides. A circular 'Tropical Fruit Co.' stamp is also visible on the lower portion of the crate.

1997.title: Vintage Banana Crate
1997.description: A weathered wooden banana crate is shown at an angle against a plain background. The crate features stenciled yellow text reading 'BANANAS', 'JAMAICA - 40 LBS', and a circular 'Tropical Fruit Co.' logo.

1996.title: Psychedelic Dome Landscape
1996.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a large ornate purple dome structure on the left with intricate patterns and glowing elements, and a retro-futuristic orange and teal hover vehicle carrying two figures on the right. The foreground shows reflective water with purple vegetation while the sky is filled with colorful floating orbs, dripping orange liquid from above, and various mechanical elements.

1995.title: Neon Alien Dome Haven
1995.description: A vibrant surreal night scene featuring glowing purple geodesic domes with intricate patterns, set on a platform above reflective water with dripping magenta liquid. A sleek red and blue futuristic hovercraft with visible silhouetted figures floats to the right, surrounded by floating orbs, crescent moons, and a psychedelic starry sky with green aurora waves.

2018.title: Cosmic Brain Creature
2018.description: A surreal blue amphibian-like monster with a giant exposed brain floats above a barren mountain range. A solar eclipse looms in a dark, cloudy sky while purple electricity and mathematical symbols cover the creature's dripping, cracked skin.

2341.title: Psychedelic Visionary Overload
2341.description: A surreal psychedelic painting dominated by a massive red eye weeping blood-like drips from the top center. Below it, a blue woman's face with closed eyes and orange drips appears on the left, while a glowing green dog stands on its hind legs reaching toward a spiral; to the right, a procession of identical purple-faced figures with ornate headdresses and skeletal figures above them float amid swirling colorful patterns and floating pills.

2218.title: Celestial Faces in Light
2218.description: A surreal painting featuring multiple ethereal female faces floating amidst glowing orbs, golden crescent moons, and flowing ribbons. A bright vertical beam of light illuminates the composition, surrounded by sparkling particles and soft pastel clouds.

2342.title: Celestial Faces in Light
2342.description: A symmetrical surreal painting featuring four ethereal female faces with closed eyes and colorful freckles, floating among clouds, planets, and crescent moons. A bright vertical beam of golden light with dripping effects runs down the center, dividing the composition.

2343.title: Vibrant Dripping Color Fairy
2343.description: A surreal painting of a crowned skeletal fairy with large multicolored wings, seated in an elaborate pink dress adorned with clock faces. The scene features dripping rainbow paint circles overhead and floating transparent bubbles containing tiny figures against a dark swirling background.

2344.title: Cosmic Robot and Friends
2344.description: A whimsical surreal scene featuring a large metallic robot with a screen displaying a glowing Jesus figure on its chest, standing beside a translucent purple jellyfish-like creature with large blue eyes and a small round blue character with a cross necklace. They stand on a circular rug with astrological symbols as galaxies and stars float above and a colorful ethereal stream flows from a stained-glass doorway in the background.

2345.title: Cosmic Mirror of the Cosmic Lyra
2345.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman with flowing teal hair and closed eyes kissing a skeletal figure wearing an ornate golden headdress. A vibrant red bird flies across the scene while a cosmic galaxy swirls above and a red laser-like beam cuts diagonally through the composition, all framed in an ornate golden oval dripping with red liquid.

2190.title: Surreal Cosmic Desert
2190.description: A surreal desert landscape features a flat-topped mesa with cacti under a turbulent sky filled with dripping, eyeball-covered orbs. A massive central orb displays a single red eye while a green monstrous creature with sharp teeth and purple fiery hair emerges from lava on the right.

2346.title: Surreal Swamp Reflection
2346.description: A dark purple wolf with glowing yellow eyes stands on the bank of a reflective pond, facing a green fiery monster with purple flames. Floating eye-covered orbs hover above the water which mirrors the scene under a dramatic, colorful sky.

2347.title: Celestial Dancer at Twilight
2347.description: A vibrant, fantastical painting depicts a cosmic dancer in flowing, multicolored robes spinning on a golden path under a massive red moon. In the foreground, a crowd of women wearing colorful African-style headwraps and garments watches the performance beside a dark, illuminated castle.

2348.title: Spiral Path to the Sun
2348.description: Three colorful female figures with flowing hair stand on the left side of a cracked desert landscape, observing a large spiral ramp structure. Small yellow human figures run and dance along the spiraling path that ascends toward a vibrant red sun surrounded by psychedelic concentric patterns in the sky.

2355.title: Lotus Dreamer
2355.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with closed eyes and pale blue skin, her head crowned by a large blooming lotus flower. Vibrant flowers, grapes, and colorful paint splashes surround her against a dramatic, stormy sky with swirling red and grey clouds.

2239.title: Wind Chimes and Beasts
2239.description: A surreal dark painting depicts a white sheep and a dark bull standing amid swirling vortexes. Above them hangs a grid of metal wind chimes and bells against a stormy, swirling night sky with floating fabric-like shapes.

2356.title: Celestial Ritual Dance
2356.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four women in matching green and yellow dresses holding hands in a circle dance above a swirling vortex of water. They are flanked by a white sheep and a black bull while a massive stained-glass sun with a smiling face dominates the sky, surrounded by wind chimes against a dramatic mountain landscape.

2350.title: Cosmic Octopus Portal
2350.description: A man in a black shirt steps through an ornate golden picture frame onto a grey lunar surface. A large magenta octopus with blue eyes and tentacles emerges from a crater filled with colorful flowers and dripping purple liquid, set against a starry space background with a large yellow moon.

2357.title: Gingerbread Portal
2357.description: A whimsical night scene on a wooden deck features a boy in overalls with a donkey, two robot figures with glowing gingerbread chest panels, and a large purple octopus emerging from a golden picture frame dripping magenta liquid. The background shows a starry sky with a large yellow moon and string lights.

2321.title: Surreal Camouflage Dreamscape
2321.description: A man in military camouflage and cap stares forward from a rocky shore, with turbulent ocean waves crashing behind him and a serene lakeside castle in the distance. A worried blue cartoon creature stands on a colorful patterned rug surrounded by floating iridescent bubbles and ceramic vases.

2358.title: Surreal Turtle Rider
2358.description: An elderly man in military attire sits on a patterned rug atop a large glowing turtle emerging from turbulent psychedelic waves. A black bird with orange drips perches on the turtle while a yellow bird sits on the man's shoulder, all set against a chaotic sky with floating skulls, orbs, and a distant castle.

2235.title: Wind Chimes and Thunder
2235.description: A surreal painting depicts multiple glowing wind chimes hanging from strings against a pale, swirling sky. Ethereal white bovine and ovine heads float among yellow halos, lightning bolts, and cloud forms in the background.

2359.title: Surreal Psychedelic Wanderer
2359.description: A pink-skinned figure with blue hair and spiral patterns stands in a vibrant landscape, holding a large centipede that carries a red flower. A bright green dog rests on their shoulder while wind chimes hang from the sky above a swirling cosmic portal and rolling green hills.

2331.title: Jester Playing Chess
2331.description: A young man in colorful jester attire crouches over a glowing yellow and pink chessboard, reaching for a piece. The surreal scene is filled with floating blue spheres, glowing yellow lines, and vibrant flowers in an ornate architectural setting.

2360.title: Jester on Chessboard
2360.description: A jester in a purple and yellow costume crouches on a large glowing chessboard, reaching toward a white chess piece. The scene is filled with floating blue orbs connected by golden lines, surrounded by colorful flowers and set within an ornate palace with arches overlooking a twilight sky.

2361.title: Cosmic Pink-haired Muse
2361.description: A surreal portrait of a young woman with flowing pink hair and glowing golden cracks across her face and shoulders, set against a fantastical mountain landscape at sunset. A swirling pink and purple cosmic portal with ethereal figures floats in the sky above a winding golden river that flows through a field of purple flowers, with a vibrant red flower resting near her chest.

2248.title: Piano of the Damned
2248.description: A dark surreal painting depicts a melting grand piano with black liquid dripping from its keys and body. Ethereal musical notes float above it while a crowd of shadowy, robed figures with pale faces watches from the darkness, two pigs visible in the foreground.

2362.title: Cosmic Piano Dragon
2362.description: A massive black dragon formed from a melting grand piano stretches across a pink road between storefronts labeled 'Eternal Score' and 'Damned Keys'. A teal whale with a keyboard on its back carries a silhouetted figure while a purple snake and floating orbs with faces swirl around a glowing yellow vortex in a starry cosmic sky.

2363.title: Surreal Piano Dragon
2363.description: A massive black dragon coils around a grand piano in the center of a cracked pink street, its body extending toward a giant blue whale floating in a swirling cosmic vortex sky filled with musical notes. Hooded figures stand on both sides while two pigs observe from the foreground amid melting piano elements and glowing signs.

2364.title: Medusa's Lament
2364.description: A melancholic Medusa with green snake hair and tears sits inside a grand piano that has merged with a cascading waterfall. The surreal night landscape features a ruined castle, distant mountains, a crescent moon, and swirling green water at the base.

2365.title: Bear Playing Piano
2365.description: A whimsical brown bear with rosy cheeks sits at a gray upright piano, wearing a vibrant magenta dress. Its long, flowing hair streams behind it in swirling patterns of pink, purple, and blue, filled with colorful fish and bubbles against a textured gray background.

2366.title: Jester Playing Cello
2366.description: A jester in a colorful purple and yellow costume with a matching hat sits cross-legged while playing a large wooden cello. He is positioned on a glowing pink and yellow chessboard with golden chess pieces, surrounded by vibrant flowers, floating blue bubbles, and floating musical notes in an ornate palace hall.

2367.title: Astronaut Cellist with Skeleton Dog
2367.description: A surreal painting depicts a blue-suited astronaut playing a cello while seated, with colorful smoke emanating from the helmet visor. A skeletal dog with an orange collar and protruding tongue walks beside on a leash, under a floating circular portrait of a crying child with glowing eyes and dripping tears against a swirling purple cosmic background with vines.

2368.title: Ouroboros Sorceress v0.8
2368.description: A surreal digital artwork depicts a purple-skinned sorceress with circuit-patterned robes standing beside a shadowy horned figure with glowing pink eyes. An ornate golden Ouroboros dragon forms an infinity loop around them, while a small red-cloaked wizard stands on the dragon's body holding a staff.

2369.title: Specimen #52-583
2369.description: A surreal purple fungal or plant-like creature with large teary eyes, a slight smile, and ornate frilled patterns dominates the center. It is surrounded by swirling dark smoke, ghostly faces, and glowing purple energy tendrils against a background of aged parchment diagrams.

2370.title: Surreal Eternal Scream
2370.description: A central woman's face with a golden laurel wreath screams in agony as blood streams from her eyes, surrounded by multiple hands pointing at her and covering her eyes. Below her an infinity symbol burns in orange flames above a melting smiley face emoji reflected in rippling water, set against a backdrop of a burning Colosseum under a swirling colorful sky with dripping paint effects.

2371.title: Alien Angel Scholar
2371.description: A surreal scene featuring a grey alien with red dragon wings and a blue headpiece holding a bowl of colorful eggs, embraced from behind by a golden-winged angel figure with a halo. They stand at an ornate blue and gold pedestal with an open glowing book, surrounded by scattered papers, lit red candles, Easter eggs, and lilies under a dramatic sky with teal light beams.

2335.title: Midnight Match Shadow Garden
2335.description: A man in a vibrant blue suit with a 'Christian vs. Legion' sash stands confidently amid large pink peonies and yellow flowers against a dark background. A menacing shadowy creature with glowing white eyes and a jagged grin hovers behind him, all framed within a vintage television screen.

2372.title: Surreal Portrait with Red Hair
